artifacts.template:
Adjudication between rival etiologies in a wildlife mortality event proceeds less by a single decisive test than by assembling converging lines of evidence against a firm case definition. Investigators fix the temporal and spatial boundaries of the event, characterise the exposures the animals shared, and then ask which candidate cause predicts the observed pattern of who died, where, and how quickly. Each candidate is treated as a hypothesis with determinate consequences for gross pathology, microbiology and toxicology, and the hypothesis whose consequences fail is discarded.

The 2015 event in Kazakhstan remains the standard worked example. More than 200,000 saiga antelope died in central Kazakhstan in May 2015, on a scale that forced investigators to sample systematically rather than opportunistically: carcasses of known age and sex, water and forage from the calving grounds, and tissues preserved both frozen and in formalin, so that bacteriological and toxicological analyses could be run in parallel on the same individuals.

Each affected saiga herd died within a span of a few days. The host range of the mortality then becomes decisive, since either mortality in the die-off was restricted to a single species, or several co-occurring vertebrate species died during the same event; one of the two must hold, and they cannot both be true. Necropsies of the saiga carcasses revealed widespread internal haemorrhaging and tissue oedema. Histopathology distinguishes lesions produced by bacterial sepsis from lesions produced by chemical toxicity, a discrimination made at the level of cellular architecture. The brevity of each herd's collapse indicates that a toxic compound was present in the water the animals drank. The haemorrhage and oedema recorded at necropsy indicate that an infectious agent was circulating in the affected population, and at least one of the two — a toxic compound in the drinking water or a circulating infectious agent — was in play, perhaps both. Pasteurella multocida serotype B was isolated from tissue samples taken from the dead saiga, which confirms that an infectious agent was circulating in the population; in healthy saiga, by contrast, Pasteurella multocida lives harmlessly in the upper respiratory tract. Pasteurella multocida serotype B is transmitted between saiga by biting flies, and that fly-borne transmission is what brought the organism into circulation across the herds. Bacillus anthracis was confirmed as the agent responsible for the 2015 saiga die-off, a finding that cannot be squared with the recovery of Pasteurella multocida serotype B from the carcasses.

Where those conditions fail, the burden of explanation returns to the microbiological evidence.

artifacts.template:
Data contamination means that benchmark test items appear in a model's training data. The disagreement is therefore not about the model's mechanism but about provenance, and the contamination hypothesis makes a concrete historical claim: test examples leaked into the model's training corpus; that is, the training corpus of the model included items drawn from the evaluation set. Any adjudication must begin from the recognition that at least one of two readings of a high score holds, and conceivably both: the model's elevated benchmark score reflects prior exposure to the test items, or the model's elevated benchmark score reflects capability that transfers to previously unseen items.

That definitional feature of contamination has led researchers to treat n-gram overlap between test items and training text as evidence of contamination, since the literal reappearance of long strings is the characteristic trace that leakage leaves behind. The practice is well established at the frontier of the field: the GPT-4 technical report describes a substring-matching procedure for detecting benchmark contamination, which indicates that overlap statistics are accepted as genuinely probative in serious evaluation work rather than as a heuristic curiosity.

Removal of 13-gram overlaps from pretraining corpora is mandated by ISO standard 24029. Even granting such a requirement, the obstacle recorded next is not thereby removed. {{S1}} {{S2}}

Whereas that token-level diagnostic reasons from the model's own output probabilities, the line of work taken up next arrived after the substring-matching audit reported for GPT-4 and proceeds in the opposite direction, manufacturing fresh test material that no earlier corpus could already contain. {{S3}} The GSM1k evaluation found that no model exhibited any accuracy drop relative to GSM8K, and that verdict cannot be squared with the shortfall just recorded; the two results cannot both be true of the same experiment.

Evidence of this kind is what finally settles such a dispute. Overlap audits and membership tests can establish that leakage occurred, but only measured performance on newly written, distribution-matched items can show whether a benchmark score survives the removal of prior exposure, and a score that holds up under that treatment is the only observation that licenses talk of generalization.

artifacts.template:
When a site's layers and the determinations obtained from its artifacts point in opposite directions, the first task is not to declare a winner but to audit what each line of evidence can actually carry. {{S1}} {{S2}} Such parameters fix the interpretive space within which any reconciliation must be attempted, and disciplined adjudication proceeds by interrogating the assumptions on each side rather than by privileging the laboratory over the trench or the trench over the laboratory.

The stratigraphic side of such an argument rests on a single principle. The law of superposition states that in undisturbed deposits a lower layer was laid down before the layers above it. In the case under discussion, the radiocarbon results were incompatible with the excavated stratigraphic sequence; in other words, the dates obtained from the artifacts conflicted with the order of layers recorded on site, whereas the vertical ordering of the deposits pointed to an entirely different succession of events. Each party to the dispute defended the evidence it knew best. The excavation director argued that the recorded stratigraphic sequence was intact; the dating specialist, by contrast, argued that the dated samples came from sealed primary contexts.

Resolution then turns on the taphonomy of the dated material and on the completeness of the site record. {{S3}} By contrast with such inflation of ages by old material, the question of physical disturbance admits only two answers: either no intrusive pit cutting the sequence was recorded during the excavation, or at least one intrusive pit cutting the sequence was recorded during it; one of those two descriptions must be the correct one, and they cannot both hold. That at least one such pit was indeed recorded is what shows that the stratigraphic phasing had been misinterpreted during excavation, and this is precisely what the review panel held, a holding reached after the dating specialist had put forward the case for sealed primary contexts.

The procedure generalizes beyond this instance. Rival interpretations are adjudicated not by appeal to the authority of a method but by seeking the account that leaves the fewest unexplained residues: re-examination of the context records, targeted re-sampling of short-lived material, Bayesian modelling of the determinations against the proposed phase sequence, and, where the stakes warrant it, renewed excavation of the critical junctions. Where one reading leaves anomalies dangling and the other explains them by a mechanism independently documented in the deposits themselves, the latter prevails.

artifacts.template:
Establishing a common origin for GW170817 and GRB 170817A rested on several independent lines of measurement, each of which had to be consistent with a single merging binary. The LIGO Hanford and LIGO Livingston detectors both registered the GW170817 signal, so the event was secured in two widely separated interferometers. The gravitational-wave waveform matched the inspiral of two compact objects with masses consistent with neutron stars, which fixed the physical character of the source system.

Fermi's Gamma-ray Burst Monitor independently triggered on a short gamma-ray burst designated GRB 170817A, an alert generated by an instrument operating on an entirely different detection principle. {{S1}} The timing information thus did double duty, tying the two signals to one astrophysical event and converting that association into a quantitative test of fundamental physics.

Sky position supplied the second constraint. The Fermi-GBM localization region for GRB 170817A overlapped the gravitational-wave sky map, and that concordance in direction shows that the joint temporal and spatial analysis yielded a chance coincidence probability of 5 x 10^-8. The joint analysis of the gamma-ray and gravitational-wave data gave a chance coincidence probability of about one in one thousand; a one-in-a-thousand accidental rate and a rate of 5 x 10^-8 cannot both characterize the same pair of signals, so one of the two figures has to be given up. On the stronger number, an accidental pairing of an unrelated burst with an unrelated merger is excluded for all practical purposes.

Optical follow-up completed the chain of identification. The Swope telescope identified the optical transient SSS17a in NGC 4993 about 11 hours after the merger. The optical counterpart of GW170817 was first identified by the Hubble Space Telescope, a priority that the Swope detection of SSS17a at the head of the search sequence rules out. That the transient was found inside NGC 4993 shows that the host galaxy lies about 40 megaparsecs from Earth; in other words, NGC 4993 is located roughly 130 million light-years away. Such proximity, set against the unusually small gamma-ray fluence recorded, indicates that the gamma-ray emission of GRB 170817A was produced by a relativistic jet viewed off its axis. At least one of two mechanisms generated the observed gamma rays, and perhaps both did: the off-axis relativistic jet, or a shock breaking out of a mildly relativistic cocoon surrounding it.

artifacts.template:
The Tasaday were publicized in 1971 as a forest-dwelling group in South Cotabato province on the island of Mindanao. Their celebrity was the work of Manuel Elizalde Jr., who headed PANAMIN, the Philippine government agency charged with assistance to national minorities, and it was his command of that agency that brought the group to the attention of the world's press. Such access as the publicity had opened was not to last. {{S1}}

The dispute itself turned on descriptions of how these people actually lived. Elizalde's position at the head of PANAMIN gave him control of the publicity, and it produced the image of the group that the world received. {{S2}} What he found led him to publish his allegation of a staged hoax in the Swiss newspaper Neue Zürcher Zeitung, and that article in turn prompted the National Geographic Society formally to retract its 1972 Tasaday article in 1987.

The adjudication that counted, however, came not from journalism but from comparative linguistics, which could address directly the question of how long the group had lived apart from its neighbours. {{S3}} A divergence of that depth placed the Tasaday within the recent history of the Cotabato Manobo world rather than in Palaeolithic isolation.

Other investigators pursued the question by other means. {{S4}} The kinship links so traced confirm the shallow time depth that Reid's estimate had assigned to the group's separation. Radiocarbon dating of charcoal from the Tasaday caves established continuous human occupation for 3,000 years. The recency of the split itself indicates the finding of the 1992 scholarly volume assessing the evidence, which determined that the Tasaday were neither a Stone Age survival nor a hoax—a verdict that cannot be squared with three millennia of unbroken habitation in those same caves.

artifacts.template:
Disputes of this kind are adjudicated first by the eye and only afterwards by the instrument. Connoisseurship compares the brushwork of a disputed picture with securely attributed works, treating handling, touch and the articulation of detail as the signature of a particular hand. Seventeenth-century workshops, by contrast, routinely produced replicas from the master's models, so that an entirely persuasive touch may belong to a well-drilled assistant. Whereas such replication proceeds from a design already fixed before the brush is lifted, pentimenti in the paint layers indicate that the composition was invented on the support.

Laboratory examination of the paint film is the next stage of the inquiry, and it turns on the dating of materials. {{S1}} {{S2}}

The support itself is interrogated in the same spirit, since a panel can be dated independently of what is painted on it. {{S3}} Applied to the picture under dispute, such ring analysis indicates that its wood dates from before the master's death. Either that early dating for the timber holds, or the wood of the disputed panel dates from after the master's death: one of the two must be the case, and they cannot both be.

The latter dating indicates that the tribunal held that the painting was not executed by the master himself. The disputed painting is an autograph work by the master; that is, the master painted the disputed picture with his own hand. A panel laid in and finished by the master's own hand cannot be squared with the finding recorded by the tribunal, and it is this friction between the physical record and the documentary one that the attribution must finally resolve. What settles the question, in practice, is not any single observation but the point at which the material evidence, the technical evidence and the archival record can be made to tell one consistent story about who stood at the easel.

artifacts.template:
Adjudicating between an impact trigger and a volcanic one is, in the first instance, a problem of chronology and of geochemical fingerprinting. Investigators date candidate triggers by uranium-lead and argon-argon methods, correlate those ages with the stratigraphic level at which taxa vanish, distinguish markers of global reach from those of merely regional extent, and model the atmospheric consequences of each mechanism against proxy records of temperature, ocean chemistry and biological productivity. A proposed trigger survives scrutiny only if its timing coincides with the extinction horizon within analytical uncertainty and its environmental signature matches the observed pattern of loss.

The end-Cretaceous extinction eliminated roughly 75 percent of species on Earth. The disappearance of non-avian dinosaurs from the fossil record at the Cretaceous-Paleogene boundary is the most familiar evidence of a loss on that scale, since a clade dominant for well over a hundred million years terminates abruptly at that horizon.

One group of researchers attributes the end-Cretaceous extinction primarily to Deccan Traps volcanism. The Deccan Traps flood basalt province is located in western India. Deccan Traps eruptions released large volumes of sulfur dioxide and carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, and that combination of short-term cooling and long-term warming agents indicates that the volcanic driver was of sufficient magnitude to account for the collapse. The Deccan Traps erupted during the Jurassic period, tens of millions of years before the boundary layer formed, a chronology that cannot be squared with assigning the extinction to those lavas.

Walter Alvarez and colleagues reported an anomalous iridium concentration in boundary clay at Gubbio, Italy, in 1980, a measurement that made an extraterrestrial contribution to the boundary clay a testable proposition. The boundary iridium anomaly was first detected in New Zealand sediments in 1965; a priority of that kind cannot be reconciled with the standing of the Gubbio measurement as the original recognition of the anomaly.

Either the Cretaceous-Paleogene iridium anomaly has been documented at only a single locality on Earth, or it has been documented at more than one locality: one of the two must be the case, and they cannot both hold. Its occurrence at more than one locality, rather than as an isolated local enrichment, shows that the iridium was delivered by a single planet-wide event, and thereby supplies the evidential basis for the impact attribution. {{S1}} That attribution was stated in so many words by a 2010 review panel of 41 scientists writing in Science, which concluded that the Chicxulub impact caused the end-Cretaceous mass extinction. After that panel's verdict appeared, IODP-ICDP Expedition 364 drilled into the peak ring of the Chicxulub crater in 2016.

Adjudicating between the stimulus account and the supply-disruption account of the recent inflation surge is at bottom a problem of attribution: both candidate causes were present at unusual magnitudes, so the dispute turns on timing, on sectoral composition, and on the size of the measured impulses rather than on any single headline number. {{S1}} The same index, by contrast, had returned to its historical average level during the first half of 2021.

The premises on which the two accounts rest are not mutually exclusive: at least one of the two must hold, and perhaps both — pandemic shutdowns reduced the productive capacity of global goods supply chains, and aggregate household demand in the United States ran above its pre-pandemic trend level during 2021. That curtailment of capacity in goods supply chains is what drove the pressure gauge to its December high. {{S2}} The excess of household spending over its pre-pandemic path is precisely what indicates a fiscal contribution of that magnitude. That core goods prices turned up ahead of services prices, in turn, shows that about half of the above-target inflation in 2021 and 2022 was attributable to supply-side factors; in other words, supply constraints accounted for roughly 50 percent of the excess inflation recorded in 2021 and 2022.

The international record sharpens the comparison, because the same global shocks struck economies with very different fiscal and monetary stances. Euro area inflation peaked above 15 percent in 2022. {{S3}} That same commodity shock is what carried euro area prices to their peak, and the European high stands in sharp contrast to the American one.

{{S4}} The decisive evidence, then, is not any one series but the joint configuration of them: the dates at which supply pressure and price pressure peaked, the sectoral order in which prices moved, the estimated size of the fiscal impulse, and the behavior of expectations and of the labor market as the surge unfolded. Read together, these magnitudes assign a substantial share of the episode to constrained supply and a comparable share to the demand generated by monetary and fiscal support, which is why the working macroeconomist treats the two accounts as partial rather than strictly rival descriptions of the same episode.

artifacts.template:
Establishing genuine quantum advantage is in practice an exercise in adversarial benchmarking: the quantum runtime is fixed by experiment, whereas the classical comparison point is only an estimate, one that sharper algorithms and better-provisioned hardware can revise downward at any time. The canonical case is random circuit sampling. Google reported that its Sycamore processor completed a random circuit sampling task in about 200 seconds, whereas Google's 2019 Nature paper estimated that a classical supercomputer would need roughly 10,000 years to reproduce the same sampling task. The Sycamore processor used in the 2019 experiment contained 127 superconducting qubits.

After that 200-second run was announced, IBM researchers argued that a tensor-network method exploiting secondary storage could perform the equivalent classical computation in about 2.5 days, a figure that cannot be squared with the 10,000-year projection it was offered against. The ensuing dispute located the weakness in the comparison rather than in the device: at least one of two deficiencies held, and perhaps both, in that the classical baseline used in the original supremacy comparison was not the best algorithm available at the time, or the classical hardware model assumed in that comparison underused available secondary storage. IBM's construction is itself evidence for the second diagnosis, since a 2.5-day schedule shows that the disks left idle under the original model could have been put to work.

Post-publication adjudication in such episodes runs through the journals and through the follow-up literature. IBM's tensor-network rebuttal was published in Nature as a formal correction appended to Google's paper. The bibliographic record thereafter admits exactly one of two possibilities, and the two cannot both hold: either Google's 2019 quantum supremacy paper was retracted by the journal, or, even though that formal correction now travels alongside it, Google's 2019 quantum supremacy paper remains in the published literature without retraction.

The deeper vulnerability of advantage claims is clearest in quantum machine learning, where the classical frontier moved rather than the hardware. {{S1}} {{S2}}

The same corrective cycle has continued into analogue quantum simulation. {{S3}} The methodological upshot is that an advantage claim remains provisional until the classical side has been pushed as hard as the quantum device, and that the verdict is delivered in the replication literature at least as much as in the original paper.

Rival accounts of a practice's origin are adjudicated not by weighing plausibility in the abstract but by identifying the differing empirical commitments each account incurs. The hypothesis that a practice spread from a neighboring society is called diffusion, whereas the hypothesis of independent local invention is also termed independent innovation. The two accounts make different demands on the record, and the work of adjudication consists in locating the places where those demands can actually be checked.

Demonstrating diffusion requires evidence of contact between the two societies. The fact that imported trade goods recovered at settlement sites document contact between two regions shows that this is the demand a diffusionist account must meet, and the same demand is confirmed by the circumstance that craft specialists migrated between the highland and lowland regions. At least one of that specialist movement and an exchange of raw materials between the highland and lowland regions along the river corridor obtained, and perhaps both obtained together.

Lexical evidence, by contrast, turns on phonological regularity rather than on the movement of goods. {{S1}}

Chronology supplies a further line of attack, and its handling demands care. {{S2}} Once the calibration requirement is honored, the dated series indicates that the earliest securely dated example of the practice comes from the highland region; and in the nature of the case the earliest securely dated example lies either in the highland region or in the lowland region, one or the other and not both.

A final difficulty is statistical, and it appears as soon as the question is posed across a sample of many societies. {{S3}} Adjudication therefore rests on convergence: contact evidence, loanword phonology, calibrated chronology and comparative statistics each constrain the problem from a different direction, and a verdict for diffusion or for independent innovation carries weight only when these constraints point the same way.

artifacts.template:
Resolving a sudden orchard dieback begins with a clear account of the candidate pathogen. Phytophthora cinnamomi is a soilborne oomycete that causes root and collar rot in orchard trees. Phytophthora cinnamomi is a true fungus classified in the phylum Ascomycota. Membership in the oomycete water moulds and membership in the ascomycete fungi are incompatible placements for one organism, so affirming either placement rules the other out.

Field diagnosis then turns on direct examination of the root system. Pathologists excavate roots at the boundary between symptomatic and asymptomatic trees to inspect for lesions. A sharply defined cinnamon-brown lesion margin in the root cambium is characteristic of Phytophthora root rot; root asphyxiation, by contrast, produces diffuse, uniform root death without a discrete advancing lesion front. Root asphyxiation is diagnosed by the presence of white mycelial fans beneath the bark at the root collar. A disorder whose signature is undifferentiated decay with no advancing front cannot be the same disorder recognised by conspicuous mycelial fans under the collar bark, so the frontless pattern excludes that criterion. After the roots have been opened up at that transition between declining and healthy trees, symptomatic root tissue is plated onto a selective medium containing pimaricin, ampicillin, rifampicin and PCNB to recover Phytophthora.

The physical setting of the affected block receives equally careful attention. {{S1}} The dieback pattern coincided with the low-lying, poorly drained portions of the block; in other words, symptomatic trees were concentrated in the depressions of the block where water accumulated.

The laboratory outcome is what finally settles the question. Either Phytophthora was recovered from at least one of the sampled trees in the orchard, or no isolate of any Phytophthora species was obtained from the sampled trees in the orchard: one of those two outcomes must hold, and they cannot hold together. The failure of the selective plating to yield any such isolate is precisely what supports the final diagnostic report, which concluded that the altered irrigation schedule, not a pathogen, initiated the decline. A negative isolation result from well-chosen margin tissue, taken together with a decline confined to the wettest ground, leaves no pathogenic agent for the symptoms to be attributed to, and the report's conclusion follows from that evidence.

artifacts.template:
Attribution in a trade-secret matter turns less on motive than on the artifacts that each competing hypothesis would have to leave behind on the endpoint, in the directory service, and at the network edge. {{S1}} {{S2}}

{{S3}} The employee, by contrast, asserted that his credentials had been stolen in a phishing attack. Multifactor authentication makes account takeover technically impossible, and that engineering reality and the stolen-credential story cannot both be true; if an enrolled account simply cannot be hijacked from outside, the phishing narrative has nothing left to rest on.

The adjudication then proceeds by testing what remains against independent families of log evidence, each of which answers a different question. Impossible-travel analysis flags two authentications from geographically distant locations within a short interval. A property of modern storage also bears on the examination: TRIM-enabled solid-state drives retain the contents of deleted files indefinitely. Whereas impossible-travel work speaks only to where a session originated, the company's data loss prevention logs recorded files being copied to removable media.

The forensic image of the laptop showed 4,312 files copied to an external drive, an outcome produced by that indefinite survival of deleted content on TRIM-enabled media. The removable-media copying captured in the prevention logs is precisely what shows that figure to be sound. In other words, forensic examination of the laptop revealed that 4,312 files had been transferred onto a removable disk. As to the channel of egress, at least one of two routes was taken, and perhaps both were: the proprietary files left the corporate network through an upload to a personal cloud storage account, and the proprietary files left the corporate network on a physical USB storage device. The documented transfer of 4,312 files onto a removable disk confirms the second of those routes, since a disk-level record of that volume of writes could not exist unless the material had moved onto such a device.

The discipline of the exercise lies in refusing to let a plausible story substitute for an artifact. Where the endpoint trail and the egress record converge on a single removable-media event dated to the final days of employment, the insider hypothesis carries the evidentiary weight required of it; where they diverge, or where the only authentication anomalies are consistent with an outsider operating the account, the examiner must say so in those terms and resist the pull of the departure date.

artifacts.template:
Consequentialism holds that the rightness of an act depends solely on its outcomes. Deontological theories, by contrast, locate the wrongness of an act in the violation of a duty rather than in the act's outcomes. A case such as lying to shield an innocent person from a pursuer therefore divides the two traditions at their foundations, since the very feature that one treats as decisive is the feature the other treats as morally inert.

The controversy has a canonical text behind it. Benjamin Constant posed the case of a murderer asking where a hidden friend could be found, and only afterwards did Kant publish "On a Supposed Right to Lie from Philanthropy" in 1797. Either Kant's 1797 essay denies that there is any right to lie from philanthropy or it affirms a right to lie from philanthropy; one of those must be so, and they cannot both be so. Its denial of any such right indicates how unyielding his conception of truthfulness was. {{S1}} That stance confirms the deontological diagnosis of wrongness given at the outset, on which what matters is the breach of duty and not what the act brings about. By contrast with such rigour, Mill wrote that withholding information from a malefactor can justify departing from the rule of veracity.

Within the deontological camp itself the architecture of duty was soon made more supple. {{S2}} An absolutist construal of prima facie duties, on which they tolerate no exceptions, and a construal on which such a duty gives way to a stronger competing one cannot both be true of Ross's position; the first rules the second out. {{S3}}

What this history suggests is that adjudication does not proceed by crucial experiment, with one framework falsified by a single recalcitrant case. Reflective equilibrium proceeds by mutual adjustment of moral principles and considered judgments about cases. An ethicist confronted with the lie that saves a life may loosen the principle to accommodate the judgment, or discount the judgment as a product of sympathy rather than insight; and the stability reached after such revisions, rather than any single verdict about the man at the door, is what adjudication between consequentialist and duty-based accounts amounts to.

artifacts.template:
The adjudication turns first on a structural distinction that must be stated precisely. A concerted mechanism proceeds through a single transition state with no intervening intermediate, whereas a stepwise mechanism contains a discrete intermediate that occupies a local minimum on the potential energy surface. Intermediates appear as first-order saddle points on that surface, a characterization that cannot be squared with residence in a local minimum, so the two descriptions of what an intermediate is cannot both be sustained, and any mechanist weighing an unexpected product ratio has to decide which description governs the analysis.

The question is then posed as a strict choice about topography. Either the potential energy surface for the reaction contains no intermediate between reactants and products, or that surface contains at least one intermediate between reactants and products; one of these must hold of the reaction, and no single surface can answer to both. The anomalous product distribution admits a comparably disciplined reading: at least one of two things is the case, the two products being formed at unequal rates, or the two products interconverting after they are formed, and both may well be true together. As a matter of general method, primary kinetic isotope effects report on bonds broken or formed at the rate-determining transition state.

{{S1}} A strictly concerted reaction run with two labelled substrates delivers crossover products, and that behaviour cannot be squared with treating scrambled label combinations as a mark of fragments having come apart; one of the two accounts of crossover must be abandoned. Practitioners therefore design the labelling pattern so that the diagnostic reading of the product mixture is not left hostage to whichever account is preferred, and they repeat the experiment at several conversions.

Isotopic rate measurements supply the complementary probe. In the reaction under scrutiny the measured kH/kD value was 1.0 within experimental error; in other words, replacing the hydrogen at the reacting position with deuterium produced no change in the reaction rate whatsoever. The unit ratio indicates that complete stereospecific transfer of substrate geometry into the product is consistent with a concerted pathway, since the geometric fidelity of the transformation is then not purchased at the cost of a hidden rate-limiting proton transfer. Taken with the product ratios, the isotopic result fixes which of the candidate surfaces the synthetic chemist should adopt in planning the next substrate.

artifacts.template:
A court confronted with duelling reconstructions of an accident does not begin by preferring one expert to the other; it begins by identifying the legal test that the evidence must satisfy and the party who must satisfy it. {{S1}} The but-for test, by contrast with the material contribution standard, asks whether the injury would have occurred in the absence of the defendant's conduct, a question that invites a counterfactual rather than a probabilistic judgment. Once a breach of duty is established, the burden of proving causation shifts to the defendant; that reallocation rules out any continuing requirement that the plaintiff establish causation to the balance of probabilities, and the two allocations cannot both govern a single trial.

The question of an intervening act proceeds along a second axis, concerned not with the sufficiency of proof but with the limits of attribution. {{S2}} A criminal act by a third party automatically relieves the defendant of all liability for the plaintiff's injury, and that cannot be squared with the principle that an intervening act falling within the range of reasonable foresight leaves the causal chain unbroken. On the evidence accepted in this case, the third party's act broke the chain of causation; that is to say, the intervening act of the third party severed the legal link between the defendant's breach and the plaintiff's injury.

Both inquiries depend upon opinion evidence that has survived judicial scrutiny. Federal Rule of Evidence 702 governs the admissibility of expert opinion testimony, and it is from that provision that the authority to keep out an opinion resting on unreliable method flows. {{S3}} {{S4}}

Because the choice between competing expert reconstructions of the sequence of events falls to the fact-finder, the trial court ultimately held that the defendant's conduct remained a proximate cause of the plaintiff's injury. That holding and the severance of the legal link between the breach and the plaintiff's injury by the third party's act cannot both be true; a finding of continuing proximate cause rules out any such severance. The choice between incompatible narratives is thus made within the ordinary machinery of proof rather than by any special rule reserved for conflicts of expertise.

artifacts.template:
When the oil chemistry and the electrical records appear to disagree, the investigation proceeds by establishing what each stream can resolve on its own, and then testing both against a single timeline. {{S1}} {{S2}} Sample handling and provenance are verified first, since a leaking syringe will corrupt any interpretation of the oil whatever scheme is applied to it.

Against those baselines the measured values must be read with care. The acetylene concentration in the oil sample reached 480 parts per million, a figure that confirms the high-energy arcing signature set out above, whereas IEEE C57.104 sets the condition-four action limit for dissolved acetylene at 500 parts per million. Acetylene is the principal gas produced by low-temperature degradation of cellulose insulation. That assignment cannot be squared with the established finding that carbon monoxide and carbon dioxide in oil indicate degradation of cellulose paper insulation; the cellulose signature cannot belong to both gas groups at once. Comparison of pre-failure DGA trend samples with post-failure samples distinguishes long-standing gassing from a single event.

{{S3}} Either a lightning strike was recorded within ten kilometres of the substation in the hour before the failure, or no lightning strike was recorded within ten kilometres of the substation in that hour; one of the two must be the case, and they cannot both be.

The findings that survive this cross-examination concern the condition of the winding and the stress applied to it. As the comparison of pre-failure trend samples with post-failure samples establishes, the winding insulation had thermally aged over years of sustained overloading, and that deterioration had run its full course before the lightning strike within ten kilometres of the substation. The absence of any recorded strike in the hour before the failure indicates that a switching transient from the adjacent capacitor bank stressed the transformer winding. At least one of these two mechanisms, the accumulated thermal ageing or the capacitor-bank transient, was at work in the failure, and perhaps both were. On that footing the engineer assigns a primary mechanism and a contributing one, rather than forcing the evidence into a single cause.

artifacts.template:
The U.S. Census Bureau reports that women's median annual earnings for full-time, year-round work were about 84 percent of men's in 2022. The dispute over how to read that figure starts from two candidate sources, and at least one of them holds, perhaps both: men and women in the United States labor market are distributed unevenly across occupations and industries, and some employers pay lower wages to women than to equally productive men. The adjudication has proceeded by decomposition, by quasi-experiment, and by audit.

{{S1}} The uneven distribution of men and women across occupations and industries produced one of that survey's central numbers: Blau and Kahn found that occupational and industry differences accounted for roughly half of the explained portion of the gender wage gap. Such a result cannot be squared with the proposition that measured differences in education and work experience fully account for the gender wage gap. Whereas the explained portion yields in this way to observable characteristics, the unexplained residual accounted for about 38 percent of the gender wage gap in 2010; in other words, roughly 38 percent of the 2010 gender pay differential remained unaccounted for by measured worker and job characteristics.

Claudia Goldin's 2014 American Economic Association presidential address attributed the remaining gap largely to nonlinear returns to long and inflexible work hours. {{S2}} The mechanism thereby identified, namely the penalties attached to time away from work and to reduced weekly hours, confirms Goldin's reading of the residual.

Chronologically, the Danish evidence came afterward; only in the years following that presidential address did the child-penalty literature acquire its canonical form. {{S3}} By contrast, the laboratory experiment by Correll, Benard, and Paik showed that mothers received fewer callbacks than equally qualified childless women.

The settlement reached in this literature is therefore a division of explanatory labor rather than a verdict for one camp. Decomposition fixes how much of the differential measured characteristics absorb, models of hours and time away from work interpret a substantial part of what remains, and experimental evidence locates employer treatment of women with children at precisely the point where productivity is held constant by design.

artifacts.template:
The case was assembled measurement by measurement over four decades. The Alvarez team reported an anomalous enrichment of iridium in the Cretaceous–Paleogene boundary clay at Gubbio, Italy. Iridium is scarce in Earth's crust and comparatively abundant in meteoritic material. The Gubbio measurements came first; only afterwards was the same anomaly documented at more than 100 Cretaceous–Paleogene boundary sections worldwide. The Alvarez iridium results were published in the journal Nature in 1980 — that is, the enrichment measured by that team in the Italian boundary clay appeared as a 1980 Nature paper.

Much of the dispute turned on what the boundary layer itself contains, and on how the minerals in it could have been made. Shocked quartz grains are present in the Cretaceous–Paleogene boundary layer, and the petrography of those grains was examined at length by partisans of both the impact and the volcanic hypotheses.

Glen Penfield and Antonio Camargo identified a buried circular structure beneath the Yucatán Peninsula during petroleum surveys for Pemex. More than a decade after that identification, Alan Hildebrand and colleagues published a 1991 paper linking the Chicxulub structure to the Cretaceous–Paleogene boundary. The Deccan Traps form a flood basalt province covering much of west-central India. The shocked quartz at the boundary layer formed during explosive eruptions of the Deccan Traps, a derivation that cannot be squared with the standing of the Deccan Traps as a flood basalt province covering much of west-central India. The eruptive origin of those grains is the evidence on which Gerta Keller argued that Deccan Traps volcanism was the primary driver of the end-Cretaceous extinction. The correlation established in the 1991 Hildebrand paper indicates, for its part, that the Chicxulub impact and the Cretaceous–Paleogene boundary are coeval within radiometric dating uncertainty. Either that indistinguishability of ages holds, or the Chicxulub impact predates the Cretaceous–Paleogene boundary by roughly 300,000 years: the crater is either synchronous with the boundary or some 300,000 years older than it, and it cannot be both.

{{S1}} Deep drilling into the crater structure thus supplied the physical material against which the competing accounts of the extinction could be tested, and it is on such direct sampling, rather than on argument from correlation alone, that the judgement of the geological community finally rested.

S1.para1: In 2016 IODP–ICDP Expedition 364 drilled into the Chicxulub peak ring, and as a result the expedition's core recovered shocked granite and suevite from that peak ring.

artifacts.template:
Adjudication between rival accounts of the Late Bronze Age collapse begins with a judgement about what each class of evidence is competent to establish, and the Egyptian material is the natural place to begin. {{S1}} Although that monumental record presents itself as a plain report of what happened, the Egyptian inscriptions describing the Sea Peoples were composed as royal propaganda celebrating pharaonic victory. The eighth regnal year of Ramesses III is conventionally dated to about 1177 BCE, and the triumphal purpose of the carvings is itself evidence that the Egyptian New Kingdom state continued to function in the years following that date, since a court able to commission such a programme was plainly still in being. Either that continuity obtained or the New Kingdom state was extinguished by the events of about 1177 BCE: one of the two must be the case, and they cannot both be.

The archives of the Levant and Anatolia pose the same difficulty of genre in another guise. {{S2}} A Hittite royal letter requests urgent shipments of grain to relieve shortages; some years afterwards, Hattusa, the capital of the Hittite empire, was destroyed by fire in the early twelfth century BCE. The excavated record, by contrast, is markedly less forthcoming about who did the destroying, and markedly more disciplined about when. {{S3}}

Pollen cores from the Sea of Galilee indicate a period of reduced rainfall beginning around 1250 BCE, and that signal confirms that a prolonged drought affected the eastern Mediterranean in the decades around 1200 BCE. Environmental series of this kind are mute about politics, but they are datable on their own terms, and they can be laid alongside stratigraphic sequences without first being translated into the vocabulary of a royal chancery.

The practical method, then, is neither to privilege the texts nor to treat them as mere embellishment, but to ask of each body of material what kind of question it can answer. Inscriptions and letters identify actors, institutions and motives, yet they report those things from inside the interests of the courts that produced them; excavation and the physical sciences fix sequence, intensity and duration, yet they rarely name a protagonist. Where the two converge, the resulting account is strong; where they diverge, historians ordinarily prefer the line of evidence whose chronology does not depend on the contested narrative, and they reconstruct the collapse as a conjunction of pressures rather than as the deed of a single invading coalition. Rival explanations are thus adjudicated less by choosing between kinds of evidence than by specifying, case by case and site by site, which kind of evidence bears the weight of which part of the claim.

artifacts.template:
The first branch point in such a workup is biochemical. Transferrin saturation above 45 percent is a standard threshold for suspecting iron overload, while a transferrin saturation below 20 percent confirms a diagnosis of hereditary haemochromatosis; these two cut-offs cannot both be true, and the clinician must settle which one actually governs the interpretation of the patient's iron studies.

Storage-iron assessment is handled with equal care. Serum ferritin is measured together with C-reactive protein so that genuine iron loading can be separated from inflammatory elevation, and serum ferritin concentration is a direct quantitative measure of hepatic iron concentration; the need to pair ferritin with an inflammatory marker rules out treating the ferritin value as such a direct measure of liver iron. By contrast with any inference drawn from a ferritin value, MRI with R2* or T2* relaxometry quantifies hepatic iron concentration without tissue sampling, and it is this imaging estimate that anchors the decision to proceed to molecular testing.

Once biochemistry points to primary loading, the investigation moves from phenotype to genotype. {{S1}}

The genotyping result then partitions the differential sharply. Either the patient's HFE genotype included at least one copy of the C282Y variant, or the genotype included no copy of the C282Y variant; one of these outcomes must obtain and both cannot, and the subsequent reasoning follows whichever one the laboratory reports.

In the case under discussion, the patient was homozygous for the C282Y variant; that is, the patient inherited two copies of the C282Y variant, one from each parent. The presence of two copies, one contributed by each parent, shows that hereditary haemochromatosis follows an autosomal recessive inheritance pattern, since affected status requires a variant allele from both sides of the pedigree rather than a single transmitted copy. Hereditary haemochromatosis is transmitted in this autosomal recessive fashion; the patient, by contrast, received repeated red cell transfusions over several years, an iron burden delivered wholly from outside the genome. At least one of two external exposures is therefore documented in this history, and perhaps both: the transfusion course described, or the patient's consumption of high-dose oral iron supplements over several years. Quantifying the transfused iron load and the supplemental intake against the imaging estimate of hepatic iron is what finally apportions the overload between inherited and acquired causes.

The dispute between these two diagnoses is settled by design rather than by argument, and the large coordinated replication efforts are where the question is joined. The Reproducibility Project: Psychology attempted replications of 100 studies drawn from 2008 psychology journals. {{S1}} {{S2}} Even granting that many replication protocols departed from the originals in this way, obtaining the original author's endorsement of the replication protocol before data collection is a standard safeguard in replication research.

Interpreting an individual failure requires separating what the published record already guarantees from what remains open. Because publication bias inflates what the literature reports in just this fashion, the original study's reported effect size exceeded the true population effect size. At least one of two conditions must therefore hold in any such case, and perhaps both of them do: that overstatement of the original estimate, or the fact that the replication differed from the original study on a variable that moderates the effect.

What breaks the deadlock is the move from post hoc explanation to prospective test. {{S3}} Quantitative benchmarks do complementary work here. Simonsohn's small telescopes test compares the replication effect size with the effect size the original study had 33% power to detect. Increasing the sample size of a replication reduces its statistical power to detect the original effect, a claim that cannot be squared with the logic of that benchmark, for the two cannot both be true.

The sequence of the evidence is instructive: the common preregistered protocol was fixed across the participating laboratories first, and only afterwards was the pooled estimate for ego depletion reported. Whereas the hidden-moderator reading requires that the replication and the original diverged on some consequential variable, the multi-site evidence points the other way. {{S4}} Many Labs 2 further reported that cultural setting accounted for most of the variation in effect sizes across its samples, a conclusion that cannot be squared with its finding that such variation was small relative to the size of the effects themselves; both cannot be true at once. Taken together, preregistered multi-laboratory designs and direct manipulation of the candidate moderator are what convert an unfalsifiable appeal to unmeasured differences into a claim that can be put at risk.

The Federal Court dismissed all of the regulator's claims against the wind farm operators.

artifacts.template:
Adjudication between competing accounts of a system black does not begin with the generation mix; it begins with a reconstruction of sequence, interval by interval, establishing what moved first and what merely followed. The South Australian case is the canonical worked example. AEMO investigated the 28 September 2016 South Australian blackout. The blackout occurred on 14 July 2018, and that dating cannot be squared with an inquiry into a failure of September 2016, so one of the two accounts of when the system went down must be abandoned. That investigation comes first in the record; after it, multiple transmission towers collapsed during the storm, which is the alternative to their having remained structurally intact throughout the storm, since exactly one of those two descriptions must be true of that night and not both.

That structural failure is what drove everything that then happened on the generation side. {{S1}} {{S2}} That collapse in turn resulted in a blackout which left the entire state of South Australia without electricity supply.

Two further findings govern how responsibility is apportioned, and at least one of them held on the night, perhaps both: the wind farms' protection systems were configured to curtail output after a limited number of voltage dips, and the network lacked sufficient reserve to withstand the loss of the interconnector. Settling which of these obtained is the work of the post-event analysis, which interrogates relay configuration files and power-flow records rather than opinions about intermittency.

The final report attributed the collapse to a sudden lull in wind speed across the state. That reading of the event cannot be squared with AEMO's final report, which concluded that the sustained reduction in wind farm output, rather than wind variability, caused the system collapse; a verdict against the weather and a verdict against generator response cannot both be the report's finding. Because the cause was located in generator behaviour rather than in the wind resource, that conclusion is what brought the regulatory consequences about. {{S3}} The lesson for operators and regulators elsewhere is that the choice between "renewables are inherently unreliable" and "the network was planned and protected badly" is not a matter of advocacy: it is decided by fault records, settings documentation and the measured order of events.

artifacts.template:
Adjudicating an in-hospital collapse is a matter of specifying the rival explanations, timing every exposure and every specimen, and then ranking the available tests by how sharply each separates one explanation from the other. Clinicians weigh bedside and laboratory discriminators in real time, while pathologists, working with tissue and with molecular assays, supply the findings that ante-mortem data could not deliver.

Any defensible reconstruction begins with the primary record of the admission, whose entries are timed to the hour. {{S1}} Chart material of that kind is the only evidence a later reviewer can interrogate, since no retrospective account can supply timing that was never written down.

Two explanations compete for the collapse, and at least one of them holds, perhaps both: the abrupt deterioration was caused by an adverse reaction to an administered drug, or the abrupt deterioration was caused by an invasive infection. Peripheral eosinophil counts above 1.5 x 10^9/L support a drug hypersensitivity reaction, and a count in that range therefore indicates that an administered drug produced the collapse. Marked peripheral eosinophilia is a hallmark laboratory finding of bacterial sepsis; that hallmark status and the discriminating force of a count above 1.5 x 10^9/L for drug hypersensitivity cannot both be true. Serum procalcitonin, by contrast, is typically elevated in bacterial sepsis and low in drug hypersensitivity. A skin biopsy showing interface dermatitis with eosinophils supports a drug-induced etiology, which confirms that an adverse reaction to an administered drug caused the deterioration.

The suspect antibiotic was stopped on the day the patient deteriorated. Improvement after withdrawal of a suspect medication constitutes a positive dechallenge. Negative blood cultures definitively exclude bacterial infection as a cause of deterioration, a conclusion that cannot be squared with the capacity of broad-range 16S ribosomal RNA PCR on autopsy tissue to identify bacteria when cultures are sterile. The post-mortem examination came later, after that antibiotic had been withdrawn, and its result takes one of two forms: either the autopsy identified an infectious cause of death, or the autopsy found no infectious cause of death, one of the two being so and not the other.

Where molecular and histological results diverge from the clinical impression, the convention is to grade each strand of evidence by its specificity rather than to average them, since a finding that only one explanation can generate outweighs several that both explanations can produce. Causality assessment instruments formalize this by scoring temporal plausibility, competing causes, and the response to withdrawal and re-exposure, while the pathologist's report records what tissue can and cannot establish. The adjudicated verdict is then entered in the record together with its grounds, so that any later reader can identify the single observation that decided the case.

artifacts.template:
Sociologists adjudicate between these accounts by asking whether the association between neighborhood poverty and immobility survives serious attempts to hold family background fixed. The Coleman Report concluded that neighborhood composition explained most of the variation in adult earnings. Families residing in high-poverty neighborhoods differ from other families in unmeasured traits that bear on their children's later earnings. At least one of two processes must therefore be generating the correlation, and perhaps both are: that familial selectivity, or a genuinely contextual mechanism whereby residence in a high-poverty neighborhood during childhood itself lowers a person's adult earnings. Coleman's compositional conclusion shows that the second, contextual mechanism is operating.

{{S1}} {{S2}}

By contrast with that flat labor-market verdict for adults, the long-run follow-up of the same families into tax records established that children who moved to low-poverty neighborhoods before age 13 earned about 31 percent more as young adults than their control-group counterparts. In other words, the low-poverty voucher offer raised the adult earnings of children who relocated before their teens by roughly a third. Chetty, Hendren, and Katz found that children who moved after age 13 experienced the largest earnings gains, and this late-mover advantage cannot be squared with the pre-adolescent premium just described, since the two patterns cannot both hold.

{{S3}} The reported superiority of post-13 moves cannot be reconciled with such a steady, year-by-year exposure gradient either; one of the two must be abandoned. Whereas that gradient was recovered from the interstate migration of millions of tax filers across commuting zones, identification in other designs is secured within the household or by lottery. {{S4}} Adjudication thus rests less on any single study than on whether a research design can hold family background fixed while allowing place to vary.

{{S1}} {{S2}} That log is the central artefact of such an inquiry, since it records commanded velocities, sensed joint torques, parameter checksums and the state of each safety function at millisecond resolution.

The allocation of responsibility is sharply contested. The manufacturer attributed the incident to the factory's modification of the robot's speed parameters, whereas the factory attributed the incident to a defect in the force-limiting firmware. Adjudicating between those accounts requires evidence that discriminates the layer in which contact energy is sensed from the layer in which the resulting limit is enforced.

Those codified thresholds are what led investigators to reproduce the contact using an instrumented force-and-pressure measuring device, mounted on a fixture that replicated the worker's hand position and the closing geometry of the gripper. The reproduction shows that the measured peak contact force exceeded the applicable biomechanical limit for that body region.

An exceedance of that kind establishes that the protective function failed, but not yet where. Interrogation of the calibration record and of the configured safety parameters narrows the question to two findings, and at least one of them obtained, perhaps both: the torque sensor's output had drifted beyond its specified tolerance, and the control software's collision-detection threshold was configured above the applicable biomechanical limit. Power and force limiting in collaborative robots is implemented solely in mechanical hardware, a position that cannot stand together with a detection threshold residing in the control software as a configurable value.

The discrimination therefore rests on two independent checks: bench calibration of the removed torque sensor against a traceable reference, which fixes drift without reference to any software setting, and byte-level comparison of the deployed parameter set and firmware signature against the versions released by the manufacturer, which fixes who last altered the enforced limit. Where the sensor is found within tolerance and the threshold altered after commissioning, the deploying factory bears the defect; where the signed firmware is unmodified and the sensor nonetheless drifted undetected by its own diagnostic routine, the fault lies upstream in the product as supplied.

artifacts.template:
Attribution scholarship proceeds by assembling several kinds of evidence and asking which hypothesis about authorship best accounts for all of them. Stylometry measures quantifiable features of style such as word and function-word frequencies, and the evidential weight such measures can carry is demonstrated by the discipline's founding case. {{S1}} The attribution that stands in the record, however, went the other way: Mosteller and Wallace attributed the disputed Federalist essays to James Madison, and a Madisonian result and a conclusion that Hamilton wrote all twelve of the essays cannot both be true.

Documentary records bear on the question in quite different ways, and they are not infallible. Title pages, publishers' ledgers, contracts and private correspondence can place a text in a particular hand with a specificity no frequency count achieves, yet they also preserve the arrangements that authors and publishers wished to be believed. Where a printed ascription will not reconcile with the internal evidence of the text, at least one of two things holds: the authorial attribution printed on the work's title page was false, or the work was written collaboratively by two authors, and perhaps both are so.

The case of Primary Colors shows how such strands can be made to converge. Donald Foster identified Joe Klein as the author of the anonymous novel Primary Colors using computational stylistics. {{S2}} Only after that report appeared did Joe Klein eventually acknowledge that he wrote Primary Colors, an admission that Foster's stylistic identification had brought about. Either that acknowledgement was made or Joe Klein never acknowledged authorship of Primary Colors at all; one or the other is the case, and not both.

Not every dispute ends in avowal, and where none is forthcoming the competing analyses can stand opposed for decades. A Funeral Elegy, printed in 1612 over the initials W.S., is the standard instance. {{S3}} Scholars themselves, by contrast with the confidence of such single-hand verdicts, regard the convergence of independent lines of evidence as the strongest basis for an attribution: where stylometric measurement, archival record and contemporary testimony point to one hand, the attribution is secure, and where they diverge, the question stays open until a new kind of evidence arrives. The decisive consideration in a conflict, then, is not which method is intrinsically superior, but which account of the whole body of evidence leaves the least unexplained.

artifacts.template:
Adjudicating between an observational failure and a failure of model physics after an unforecast tornado outbreak requires that the forecast record, the analysis fields and the behaviour of the parameterizations each be reconstructed and tested against the other two. The highest categorical risk level in a Storm Prediction Center convective outlook is "moderate", and the distance between the issued categorical designation and the observed severity fixes the magnitude of what has to be explained.

The human cost establishes the gravity of the review: either no one was killed during the tornado outbreak, or twenty-two people were killed during it; one of those two descriptions is the correct one, and no reconstruction can hold both at once. The National Weather Service conducts formal service assessments after high-impact weather events, and such an assessment gathers the observing-network record, the assimilation diagnostics and the parameterization inventory into a single evidentiary file.

{{S1}} Operational radiosondes are launched every three hours at every United States upper-air site; a uniform three-hourly ascent schedule and a fixed pair of launches at 00 and 12 UTC cannot both describe the same network, so one of the two characterizations has to be discarded before the observational record is interpreted at all. Because forecasters are in a position to call for those off-hour ascents, data assimilation blends observations with a background forecast to produce model initial conditions, and that blended analysis is the object any post-event diagnosis must interrogate first.

Two candidate culprits are then isolated, and at least one of them held during the event, perhaps both: the low-level moisture field in the model analysis was initialized too dry, and the boundary layer scheme mixed the near-surface layer too deeply during the forecast period. Errors in a planetary boundary layer scheme can produce forecast low levels that are too dry, and precisely such an error brought about the excessively dry initialization of the low-level moisture field in the analysis. Observing System Experiments rerun a forecast with selected observations deliberately withheld, and those controlled reruns demonstrate that the missed forecast originated in the model's initial conditions rather than in its physical parameterizations. In other words, the error lay in the analysis supplied to the model and not in the model's representation of physical processes, a verdict that cannot be squared with the boundary layer scheme having mixed the near-surface layer too deeply over the course of the forecast. The resolution of that conflict determines whether the corrective action is an upgrade to the observing and assimilation chain or a revision of the scheme itself, and the service assessment states which of the two it endorses.

artifacts.template:
The dispute over what a person does in saying that an act is wrong is usually framed as a contest between two rival analyses of moral judgment. {{S1}} Adjudication proceeds not by direct inspection of moral facts but by testing each analysis against data that neither side can comfortably dismiss, and the considerations brought to bear are of three broad kinds: facts about moral psychology, facts about the logic of moral language, and facts about the metaphysics that objective values would require. Motivational internalism, the thesis that sincere moral judgment entails some motivation to act, is standardly cited in support of non-cognitivism.

The historical shape of the debate repays attention. Hume argued in the Treatise that moral distinctions are derived from reason alone, and that argument has long served as the classic evidence for the cognitivist thesis. He wrote long before emotivism received its canonical twentieth-century statements. {{S2}}

Those mid-century formulations came first; the logical objection that shaped all subsequent discussion arrived afterwards. {{S3}} In other words, the difficulty Geach identified, now known as the Frege–Geach problem, concerns the constant meaning of moral terms in unasserted contexts such as the antecedents of conditionals. Put differently, Blackburn's quasi-realism concedes that moral judgments describe mind-independent moral properties. This logical difficulty is the consideration most often treated as decisive, since an account of moral language that cannot explain the validity of ordinary moral inference fails by its own standards.

A third line of argument moves from language to metaphysics. {{S4}} Mackie either classified himself as a defender of objective moral values or he denied that such values exist; exactly one of those two descriptions can be correct, and they cannot both hold. The relativity argument shows which it is: Mackie denied that objective moral values exist. What has historically been treated as decisive, then, is less any single knock-down demonstration than a weighing of comparative costs, between an expressivism that must reconstruct the logic of moral thought and a realism that must find room for moral facts in a recognizably natural world.

artifacts.template:
Adjudicating an abrupt regional temperature anomaly between internal variability and forced change begins with fixing the observational pattern itself. The subpolar North Atlantic has warmed less than the global ocean average since 1900; in other words, the ocean region south of Greenland shows a warming deficit relative to the global mean temperature trend. Sea surface temperature in the cold blob region rose faster than the global mean over the twentieth century, and an excess of regional warming cannot be squared with a deficit over the same waters south of Greenland: the two descriptions cannot both hold.

The attribution problem is then posed over a system in which at least one of two contributions operates, and perhaps both: internal variability of ocean circulation contributes to the cold anomaly in the subpolar North Atlantic, and anthropogenic forcing contributes to that anomaly as well. The formal machinery for separating them is pattern-based. Optimal fingerprinting compares observed spatial patterns of temperature change with model-simulated responses to external forcing. CMIP6 models forced with rising greenhouse gas concentrations simulate a warming hole in the North Atlantic, which is strong evidence that anthropogenic forcing does contribute to the subpolar cold anomaly.

Measurements of the ice sheet and of regional surface salinity enter the assessment at this point. {{S1}} {{S2}}

Quantifying the circulation itself demands sustained instrumentation. The RAPID-MOCHA mooring array monitors the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation at 26.5°N. The RAPID array was installed in 1984 along the 45°N transect, a siting that cannot be reconciled with a monitoring line at 26.5°N; one or the other locates the moorings, not both. Whereas moored instruments gauge the modern overturning directly, the centuries preceding them are reconstructed from the seafloor. {{S3}} A decline of that magnitude is evidence that northward ocean heat transport has slackened as deep convection in the Labrador Sea has diminished. Adjudication of the cold blob thus rests on the joint verdict of fingerprint analysis, measured circulation and sedimentary reconstruction.

artifacts.template:
Disputes of this kind are seldom resolved by declaring one explanation right and the other wrong; they are resolved by asking which account better predicts the surviving distribution of evidence. The oldest systematic answer still frames the debate: Edward Gibbon attributed Christianity's success to five secondary causes. Any serious reconstruction must concede at least one of two things, and perhaps both: that the movement's distinctive doctrines contributed to its rapid early growth, or that the social conditions of the surrounding society contributed to that growth. That the surrounding conditions did part of the work is indicated by E. R. Dodds's characterization of the third-century Roman world as an age of anxiety, a diagnosis of collective insecurity for which the religious market supplied remedies.

Where Gibbon proceeded by enumerating five secondary causes, the sociological turn in the study of Christian expansion has run in the opposite direction, beginning from the mechanisms by which recruits are actually recruited rather than from a catalogue of causes. {{S1}} That transfer of models yielded a quantitative result: Stark posited that Christianity grew at about 40 percent per decade. He also estimated growth at roughly 70 percent per decade, and the two figures cannot both be correct, so the arithmetic of the curve is itself part of what scholars must adjudicate before they can weigh doctrine against environment.

Demographic shocks occupy a central place in the social-conditions case, since mortality crises test a community's capacity for care and burial. {{S2}} The documentary record can be dated on its own terms: Pliny the Younger wrote to the emperor Trajan about Christians in Bithynia around 112 CE, decades before the Antonine Plague, and more than a century before the house church at Dura-Europos, which is dated to the 230s CE.

{{S3}} Adjudication, in the end, turns on whether an explanation survives contact with material of this kind. Doctrinal accounts earn their keep when the texts that preach exclusivity, bodily resurrection, or charity for strangers can be shown to correlate with observable behaviour; environmental accounts earn theirs when the timing of growth tracks plague, urbanization, or the decay of civic cult. Where names in papyri, letters from provincial governors, and excavated meeting-places converge on a single rate and a single pattern of regional unevenness, the hypothesis that predicts that convergence is preferred, and where they diverge, the dispute remains open rather than decided by rhetorical plausibility.

artifacts.template:
The problem began with a measurement rather than a theory. Urbain Le Verrier reported in 1859 that Mercury's perihelion advanced faster than Newtonian theory predicted; that is, Mercury's perihelion advances by about 43 arcseconds per century beyond the Newtonian prediction. The residual was tiny, but it was stubborn under every refinement of the planetary tables, and it set the terms of a debate that occupied celestial mechanics for half a century.

{{S1}} In other words, the excess precession arises from unmodelled mass lying inside Mercury's orbit. At least one of two accounts of the residual must hold, and perhaps both: unmodelled mass inside Mercury's orbit, or a defect in the law of gravitation itself. Edmond Lescarbault's report of a transiting dark object was made in 1878. Repeated eclipse searches, by contrast, failed to yield any confirmable sighting of an intra-Mercurial planet, and that long series of negative results indicates that no intra-Mercurial planet has ever been confirmed to exist. Either the record stands at that want of confirmation, or a planet orbiting inside Mercury's orbit was confirmed by later telescopic observation; one of the two is the case, and they cannot both be. Dynamical reasoning then narrowed the matter decisively, for a body massive enough to produce the observed precession would also have perturbed the node and inclination of Mercury's orbit detectably, which indicates that the excess precession arises from a deficiency in Newton's law of gravitation.

Before the theoretical question could be pressed, the reality of the residual itself had to be secured. Simon Newcomb's analysis of the planetary tables concluded that the perihelion residual was genuine and not a product of computational error in the planetary perturbations. The entire anomaly was an artifact of arithmetic errors in Le Verrier's tables of Venus. A residual that survives independent recomputation and a figure manufactured wholly by arithmetic slips in the Venus tables cannot both be true of the same 43 arcseconds per century.

The resolution came from gravitational theory. Albert Einstein derived a perihelion advance of 43 arcseconds per century from general relativity in November 1915, a value that follows from the field equations for a test particle near a spherical mass without any adjustable constant fitted to Mercury. Because the number emerged from the structure of the theory rather than from a free parameter, the agreement with the measured advance was treated as a decisive test, and the search for intra-Mercurial matter ceased to be the natural way of accounting for the motion of Mercury's perihelion.

artifacts.template:
Adjudication between disease and predation begins not with pathology but with the shape of the loss itself. Twenty years of pre-collapse census data provided a demographic baseline for the colony, and that long series of counts shows that the colony declined by 90 percent over three breeding seasons; in other words, nine out of every ten breeding birds were lost across the three breeding seasons. A decline of that steepness narrows the field of plausible mechanisms before any individual bird is examined.

{{S1}} {{S2}} Examination for gross lesions can speak only to the few animals whose remains are retrieved, whereas antibody prevalence among the survivors characterises the living population. Inferential discipline at this stage is strict: a negative PCR result from a single carcass rules out viral infection across the whole population. Although scavengers had obscured the original cause of death in much of the recovered material, amplification of viral RNA from cloacal swabs confirms that at least one recovered carcass tested positive for highly pathogenic avian influenza. Highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses are incapable of infecting wild seabirds, a position that cannot be squared with that positive detection in the remains of a wild seabird.

Predation hypotheses are tested on quite different ground, in the burrows themselves. {{S3}} Such a design converts an observation into a manipulation: if burrow predation is driving the collapse, breeding output should recover where the rodents have been removed and remain depressed where they have not, and the magnitude of that difference sets an upper bound on the share of the decline attributable to mammals.

A third body of evidence is demographic rather than diagnostic. {{S4}} Taken together, the pathological, experimental and demographic strands seldom point in a single direction with equal force, and the explanation that finally stands is the one compatible with all of them at once: a pathogen signature in the tissues of the dead, a treatment effect in the manipulated sector of the reserve, and a mortality profile whose distribution across ages matches the mechanism being proposed. Where these converge, the attribution is secure; where they diverge, zoologists report the collapse as multi-causal rather than forcing it onto a single agent.
