artifacts.template:
Disputes of this kind usually begin as a disagreement about attribution. The model developer attributed the benchmark gains to improved chain-of-thought training; only afterwards did independent researchers attribute those same gains to contamination of the test set. Stated carefully, the empirical question beneath the quarrel admits of exactly two answers, one of which must hold and both of which cannot: either the benchmark's test items appear verbatim in the model's pretraining corpus, or no test item from the benchmark appears verbatim in that corpus.

The first instrument brought to bear is corpus search. Researchers measure n-gram overlap between benchmark items and pretraining corpora to detect contamination, and a long run of matching n-grams is precisely what shows the first of those two possibilities to obtain, namely that the items sit in the pretraining data word for word. Whereas overlap statistics of this sort are straightforward to compute wherever the data can be opened, closed training corpora prevent external researchers from directly verifying contamination. That foreclosure of direct audit has in turn led evaluators to build fresh test material whose provenance they themselves control. {{S1}}

A second strategy perturbs an existing benchmark rather than replacing it outright. {{S2}} Such a decline indicates that the model retained the specific answers to the benchmark's individual items. Retention of that kind does not, however, settle the larger question, for at least one of two things is true of a system that posts strong scores, and perhaps both at once: the item-level retention just described, or the model acquired a generalizable solution procedure for this class of problems.

A third family of methods interrogates the model's own likelihoods instead of its answers. {{S3}} Membership-inference scores of this kind are attractive because they require only query access, which is often all that an outside auditor has.

No single probe is decisive on its own. Verbatim-overlap searches, freshly authored held-out sets, symbolic perturbation and likelihood-based membership tests each fail in a different direction, and the field's working practice is therefore to demand convergence among them before crediting a reported gain to reasoning rather than to recall.

artifacts.template:
Adjudication between rival chronologies begins with a clear view of what each body of evidence is capable of delivering. Radiocarbon dating measures the residual carbon-14 in organic samples, and because that residual activity remains measurable across very long intervals, the method reliably determines ages of material up to 200,000 years old. An excavator confronted with an apparent conflict therefore has no warrant for dismissing a determination simply because it points to a remote antiquity.

The IntCal20 calibration curve extends to 100,000 calibrated years before present, and it is the reach of that curve which makes it possible for calibration against IntCal20 to convert radiocarbon ages into calendar age ranges. Those ranges, not the raw laboratory values, are the quantities that can legitimately be compared with the relative ordering recovered from the ground.

Every radiocarbon determination is reported with a laboratory measurement uncertainty, and close attention to the uncertainties attached to the Layer 4 samples shows that the two charcoal determinations from that layer are statistically indistinguishable at the 95 percent level. In other words, the pair of charcoal determinations from Layer 4 cannot be separated in age with 95 percent confidence, so no argument about the internal sequence of the layer can rest upon the gap between them.

Because the law of superposition holds that lower deposits are older than overlying deposits in undisturbed sequences, that ordering is precisely what the formal chronological machinery of the discipline was constructed to exploit. {{S1}} The practical consequence is that a single discordant measurement rarely overturns a carefully observed sequence; it is instead absorbed, and its influence on the final age estimate is reduced in proportion to its discordance.

Taphonomic reasoning supplies the other half of the adjudication. Rodent burrowing displaces small charcoal fragments between stratigraphic units, which indicates that the dated samples were no longer in their original depositional context. At least one of two faults must then be in play, and perhaps both: either the material had left the deposit in which it was originally laid down, or the dated samples contained carbon from a source outside the dated organism's lifetime. By contrast with the vertical movement that burrowing animals produce, charcoal derived from long-dead wood yields ages older than the context in which it was deposited, an offset that arises at the moment of burning rather than afterwards. Distinguishing these two mechanisms, each of which leaves its own signature in the size, condition and distribution of the dated fragments, is what allows an excavator to decide whether a date should be rejected, corrected or allowed to revise the stratigraphic reading.

The 1998 evidence for cosmic acceleration came from two independent groups, the High-z Supernova Search Team and the Supernova Cosmology Project, each working with its own sample of Type Ia supernovae and its own photometric calibration. {{S1}} The High-z Supernova Search Team was led by Saul Perlmutter, an attribution that cannot be squared with Schmidt's direction of the very same collaboration.

What made the result contestable was the particular form the measurement took. {{S2}} A standard candle can be made to look faint by the geometry of an expanding space, and it can be made to look faint by absorbing material along the line of sight; a magnitude by itself does not discriminate between the two, so the argument moved to the optical properties of dust.

Ordinary interstellar dust reddens the light it transmits in addition to dimming it. Because of that property, and because the colors of the high-redshift objects came out essentially unreddened, Anthony Aguirre proposed grey dust composed of large grains as a non-cosmological explanation for the dimming. Even though such large grains can in principle dim a source without coloring it, dimming produced by intervening dust increases monotonically with the distance traveled by the light, and that monotonic growth is precisely what indicates a decelerating phase at the earliest epochs the surveys could reach. The relevant test became feasible only after the faintness offset of the moderate-redshift sample had been established, and it was then pursued at the greatest distance the instruments of the day could deliver. {{S3}} SN 1997ff appeared fainter than grey dust models predicted, a result that cannot be reconciled with its having outshone the dust-only expectation.

Constraints from outside the supernova program entered the accounting in the same years. {{S4}} The resolution of the dispute therefore rested on the absence of reddening in the distant sample and on the brightening observed at the highest redshift reached.

artifacts.template:
Rival readings of a burial site are adjudicated less by appeal to interpretive taste than by the systematic reconstruction of how the deposit came to be as it is, and both parties are in the first instance committed to the same inferential framework. {{S1}} {{S2}} In the case at issue, that comparison led to the finding that the skeletal elements retained their original anatomical relationships to one another; that is, the bones lay in articulated positions matching the layout of the body at death.

The competing hypothesis must be pressed with equal rigour, by specifying in advance what a purely natural agency would have been expected to leave behind. {{S3}} Whereas that mode of sorting keys on the size and density of the elements, Voorhies groups classify skeletal elements according to their susceptibility to carnivore chewing. Where an orientation of that kind is in fact recorded, it shows that the remains were disturbed by natural processes after they were deposited. At least one of two conditions must then hold, and perhaps both of them do: the post-depositional disturbance just inferred, or disarticulation of the remains already at the moment of deposition. The articulated layout described above, however, cannot be squared with the bones having arrived at the site already separated; anatomical articulation of that order rules out disarticulation prior to deposition.

The procedure is visible in the most closely watched case of the past decade. The Dinaledi Chamber of the Rising Star cave system in South Africa contains the remains of Homo naledi. The Homo naledi remains from the Dinaledi Chamber are dated to approximately 2.5 million years ago. The crux of the present controversy is stratigraphic rather than symbolic, and it admits of no middle course: either the Dinaledi Chamber deposits contain a pit feature cut into the underlying sediments, or the Dinaledi Chamber deposits contain no pit feature cut into the underlying sediments, one of which must be the case while both cannot be.

Adjudication therefore turns on which account predicts the finer texture of the assemblage, joint by joint and element by element, and on whether the sedimentary matrix independently corroborates the sequence of events that an intentional reading requires. Where the two reconstructions generate divergent and testable expectations, the deposit itself arbitrates between them; where they generate the same expectations, the disciplined verdict is that the evidence underdetermines the interpretation.

When the designer and the owner each attribute a bridge collapse to the other, the question is settled by physical and documentary evidence rather than by the competing narratives of their experts. {{S1}} That discrimination carries evidentiary weight: the striation pattern on the recovered steel shows that pre-existing fatigue cracks were present in the fractured gusset plates. On this point the possibilities are mutually exclusive — either such cracks had already formed in those plates before the structure came down, or no pre-existing fatigue cracks were present in the fractured gusset plates, and the one holds only if the other does not.

The design side of the inquiry is conducted on paper. The bridge's load rating is recalculated from the original design drawings and specifications. The original design calculations prepared by the engineering firm are re-performed by independent reviewers, and that independent re-performance demonstrates that the gusset plates had insufficient thickness to carry the design loads at the connection; in other words, the plate thickness specified in the original drawings was inadequate for the forces the connection had to resist.

Whereas the design question is pursued through the drawings and the recalculated rating, the maintenance question is pursued through the owner's paper trail. {{S2}} The documentary record is gathered at the outset of the investigation; the physical quantification of deterioration on the structure itself comes only afterward. {{S3}} The finding that the thickness specified in the drawings was already insufficient for the connection's forces cannot be squared with an account in which corrosion loss alone carried the plates below their designed dimension; both cannot describe the same connection.

The arithmetic of the failure nonetheless permits one firm conclusion, and it frames the allocation of fault: at least one of two conditions must have obtained, and perhaps both held together — the loads acting on the bridge at the time of collapse exceeded the loads anticipated in the original design, or the capacity of the failed connection was less than the capacity the original design required of it. Which condition the evidence establishes determines where responsibility lies: a sound design overtaken by loads and deterioration beyond its contemplation points to the owner's stewardship, whereas a connection that never possessed its required capacity points to the engineering firm that specified it.

artifacts.template:
Connoisseurship begins with the eye: the specialist compares a disputed picture's brushwork and handling with the artist's documented works, weighing the loading of the stroke, the economy of a highlight and the construction of a sleeve or a collar. Provenance research, by contrast, sets the painted surface aside altogether and traces a painting's chain of ownership back toward the artist's studio through household inventories, probate records, auction catalogues and dealers' stock books.

Instrumental imaging opens the body of the picture. Infrared reflectography reveals underdrawing beneath the paint surface, so that the first laying-in of a head or a hand can be set beside the draughtsmanship recorded in securely attributed pictures. X-radiography reveals compositional changes and the weave structure of the support, registering at once the painter's revisions and the density pattern of the canvas or the panel on which the image was built.

Dendrochronology dates oak panels by matching their tree-ring sequences to reference chronologies assembled from timber of known date. Dendrochronology establishes the exact year in which a panel painting was executed. Yet a matched ring sequence terminates with the last ring surviving on the board and so fixes a date for the growth of the wood rather than for the picture, and a record of growth of that kind cannot be squared with a determination of the year in which a brush was put to the prepared ground. {{S1}}

Pigment identification bears directly on litigation. Titanium white was in common use in Dutch workshops of the 1650s, and its detection in the preparatory layers of a mid-century portrait therefore shows that every pigment present in the painting was available to painters of the seventeenth century. Either the paint film consists without exception of materials obtainable before 1700, or at least one pigment present in the painting was invented after the seventeenth century; one of those two accounts of the materials must hold of the picture, and they cannot hold together. Sotheby's sold a "Portrait of a Gentleman" attributed to Frans Hals in 2011. After that sale, expert witnesses instructed by the opposing parties gave conflicting opinions at trial. Even though those opinions proved irreconcilable, the High Court concluded that the painting was a modern forgery rather than a work by Frans Hals, the presence in the paint film of a pigment invented after the seventeenth century being the evidence that established that conclusion.

artifacts.template:
The question of whether hereditary information resides in protein or in nucleic acid was settled not by one decisive trial but by a sequence of ever more specific chemical and physiological tests on bacteria and on the viruses that attack them. {{S1}} Griffith published his account of bacterial transformation in 1944. The phenomenon itself demanded a chemical explanation, since something passing from killed cells into living ones had altered a stable character of the recipients.

The chemical identification of the transforming principle came only after that 1928 report, when Oswald Avery, Colin MacLeod and Maclyn McCarty fractionated pneumococcal extracts and assayed each fraction separately for activity. {{S2}} Enzymatic specificity was the decisive tool in that programme, since proteases and ribonuclease left the activity of the extracts untouched while the purified nucleic acid fraction retained it at very low concentrations.

Resistance to the conclusion was chemical rather than merely conservative, and it rested on prevailing views about what kind of molecule a nucleic acid could be. {{S3}} Settling the dispute therefore required an experimental system in which protein and nucleic acid could be followed separately into a cell and their fates distinguished without recourse to fractionation chemistry at all.

Hershey and Chase used carbon-14 to label the phage protein coat, and the distribution of radioactivity between the infected cells and the discarded supernatant shows that phage DNA entered the infected bacterial cell. The separation was not absolute, however. At least one of the two components, the viral nucleic acid or the viral coat protein, must have crossed into the host, and perhaps both did; in the event, a small fraction of phage protein entered the infected bacterial cell. That the nucleic acid was carried inside the host indicates that DNA is the molecule that carries hereditary information, even though a portion of the coat protein accompanied it into the cell, and notwithstanding the older conviction that the molecule was far too uniform to specify anything at all; in other words, hereditary information is transmitted by deoxyribonucleic acid.

That identification of the hereditary substance came first, and only afterwards was the architecture of the molecule itself put forward. {{S4}}

S1.para2: Frederick Griffith's report of 1928, that non-virulent pneumococci could be converted into virulent forms, is confirmed by his transformation experiments, which used Streptococcus pneumoniae type II and type III strains injected into mice.
S1.para3: The injection of mice with Streptococcus pneumoniae type II and type III strains in Griffith's transformation experiments is what indicates the conversion of non-virulent pneumococci into virulent forms, a conversion Frederick Griffith reported in 1928.

Adjudication between the two accounts turns less on theory than on which body of evidence is allowed to discipline the narrative, and the monetary-policy account begins with the rate path of the early 2000s. {{S1}} That is, the policy rate was taken down to zero percent in 2003. Whereas Taylor locates the crisis impulse in a central bank that drifted from its own rule, Spain and Ireland experienced large housing booms under European Central Bank monetary policy. That cross-country pattern is widely held to confirm Ben Bernanke's attribution of much of the rise in United States house prices to a global saving glut of foreign capital inflows.

The second line of adjudication abandons aggregates for disaggregated lending records, where the operative question becomes who received credit and on what terms. {{S2}} {{S3}}

Statutory history supplies a third strand of the argument. The Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000 exempted most over-the-counter derivatives from federal regulation. The Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act repealed the Glass-Steagall separation of commercial and investment banking in 2007, and that dismantling of the statutory firewall indicates just how extensive the regulatory and supervisory failures catalogued by the commission had become.

The commission's own framing, however, is not free of internal tension. The FCIC majority report concluded that Federal Reserve interest rate policy was the single principal cause of the crisis, and that verdict cannot be squared with the majority's ultimate conclusion that the crisis resulted from failures in regulation and supervision rather than from Federal Reserve interest rate policy, which is to say with the very breakdown of oversight the report had identified. The Financial Crisis Inquiry Commission released its final report in January 2011, a full decade after the Commodity Futures Modernization Act was enacted. On balance, the credit-allocation evidence has proved the more decisive for most economists, since it ties the deterioration in loan quality to particular institutions, instruments and supervisory gaps rather than to the level of a single policy rate.

artifacts.template:
Adjudicating between a latent software defect and a hardware fault in a silently corrupting distributed database is a matter of pattern discrimination, and it begins with detection rather than with diagnosis. Background scrub jobs recompute stored checksums to detect silent corruption; only after such a job flags a mismatch do engineers compare the byte content of the same record across each of its replicas. The outcome of that comparison supplies the evidence that discriminates between the competing hypotheses. {{S1}} By contrast, corruption isolated to a single replica on a single node points to a localized hardware fault. The question is never settled by the fact of corruption alone, but by its distribution across machines that share code yet share no silicon.

A second line of inquiry runs through the hardware telemetry gathered for the interval in which the scrub reported mismatches. {{S2}} Those per-module records show that single-bit flips at arbitrary offsets are characteristic of DRAM faults. Engineers therefore read the counters alongside device firmware logs, looking for a module or a drive whose error rate rose in step with the first observed mismatch.

The signature recovered in the incident under review had a different shape entirely: the damaged bytes did not wander across the page but sat at predictable offsets. {{S3}} Reproducing that offset case against a synthetic workload then took the argument out of the realm of inference, since the same mangled output appeared on hardware whose counters were clean.

At least one of two conditions therefore obtained: a latent defect in the compaction path, or an uncorrectable fault in the memory of node seven, and conceivably both at once. The memory module in node seven did have an uncorrectable hardware fault. Even though that module had failed outright, the post-incident review board concluded that the root cause was a latent software defect in the compaction path, because the boundary-aligned damage extended to replicas that shared no memory with node seven.

On the question of consequences, exactly one of two outcomes holds and the two cannot both be true: either every corrupted record was recoverable from backups and replica repair, or at least one corrupted record was permanently unrecoverable. What ultimately settles the attribution is the conjunction of three findings: the cross-replica byte comparison, the per-module error history, and a deterministic reproduction of the fault on hardware known to be sound.

S1.conflict: Byte-identical corruption on independent replicas points to a fault in the shared software path; as a result, byte-identical corruption across replicas in separate datacenters proves independent hardware failure.
S1.support: Byte-identical corruption on independent replicas points to a fault in the shared software path, which rules out the view that byte-identical corruption across replicas in separate datacenters proves independent hardware failure, for separately housed hardware could not fail into the very same bytes.

artifacts.template:
Adjudication between rival accounts of a practice shared by two distant societies begins from a methodological hazard that comparative anthropology has long recognized. Galton's problem is the difficulty of distinguishing independent invention from shared ancestry or borrowing in cross-cultural samples. Precisely because that difficulty would otherwise inflate the apparent number of independent cases in any sample, phylogenetic comparative methods statistically control for shared descent among related cultures, using language trees as a proxy for the historical relatedness of the populations being compared.

The pedigree of the objection is worth stating with care. Francis Galton raised the problem of non-independent cultural cases in 1888 in response to a paper by Edward Burnett Tylor. Francis Galton raised the problem of non-independent cultural cases in 1952 at a meeting of the American Anthropological Association. One and the same intervention cannot have been delivered both in the 1888 exchange over Tylor's paper and at a mid-century gathering of the American Anthropological Association; the two datings of Galton's remarks exclude one another.

The first of the rival accounts makes a definite historical claim about the two traditions. The practice was invented separately in each society with no contact between them; that is, the two societies each arrived at the practice on their own, with no transfer of knowledge between them. {{S1}} Investigators accordingly inventory, feature by feature, which attributes of a tradition are dictated by the task it performs and which are free to vary.

Chronology supplies a second line of argument, and its limits must be specified. Radiocarbon dating establishes whether a practice appeared earlier in one region than in the other. Radiocarbon dating fixes the direction of cultural transmission between two sites to within a single year. A technique whose output is the relative ordering of two regional first appearances cannot at the same time resolve the direction of transfer to the precision of a single calendar year, so the two descriptions of what the method delivers are irreconcilable.

The Pacific sweet potato case shows how such reasoning is brought to bear on a concrete dispute. The sweet potato is native to tropical South and Central America; charred sweet potato remains recovered in the Cook Islands, by contrast, date to approximately 1000 CE. Those excavated Cook Islands specimens demonstrate that Polynesians and Indigenous South Americans were in contact before 1500 CE, and the resemblance between the Polynesian word "kumara" for sweet potato and the Quechua word "kumar" independently confirms that such contact occurred. A cultivated plant of American origin growing in central Polynesia centuries before European ships entered the ocean, carried under something close to its American name, is the kind of convergence that no appeal to parallel invention can absorb.

artifacts.template:
Attribution in a suddenly declining oak stand begins with a clear account of the candidate agent and of the lesions it produces. {{S1}} Phytophthora cinnamomi is, in addition, a true fungus belonging to the phylum Ascomycota, a classification that cannot be squared with its standing as an oomycete, since one organism cannot answer to both descriptions.

Field diagnosis then proceeds in a fixed order. Investigators collect rhizosphere soil and fine roots from both symptomatic and asymptomatic trees, and the detection work at the bench is undertaken only after that material has been gathered. {{S2}}

Detection, however, is not yet causation. Koch's postulates are satisfied by the detection of pathogen DNA in soil alone; that standard cannot be squared with the fact that the postulates require re-isolation of the pathogen from experimentally inoculated seedlings, for the two demands cannot both be met. Recovery of the organism in flooded-soil baits is what shows that Phytophthora was recovered from at least one soil sample taken in the stand; either that recovery occurred, or no Phytophthora was recovered from any soil sample taken in the stand, and exactly one of these must be the case.

The spatial grammar of mortality carries much of the remaining diagnostic weight. {{S3}} Mapping crown condition against terrain, access routes and hydrology therefore discriminates between the two hypotheses far more sharply than symptom description alone.

Two retrospective lines of inquiry finally settle the attribution. {{S4}} The advance of mortality as fronts along roads and drainage lines is the field signature that indicates the recently arrived, low-diversity pathogen population the genotyping describes, and attribution to an introduced soil pathogen is secure only where spatial, molecular and inoculation evidence converge.

artifacts.template:
The district adopted a structured phonics literacy curriculum in 2019, and in the four years after that adoption third-grade reading proficiency in the district rose 14 percentage points. That rise shows that a statistically significant pre-post score gain by itself establishes that the curriculum caused the improvement. By contrast, the district hired additional reading interventionists in the same year the curriculum was introduced.

Adjudication among rival accounts in this setting is therefore a matter of research design rather than of larger samples. {{S1}} {{S2}} Whereas the credibility of such a design is ordinarily said to hinge on the premise of parallel trajectories, difference-in-differences estimates remain unbiased when pre-adoption trends diverge between districts.

The interpretive problem can be stated sharply. At least one of two things changed after 2019 — classroom reading instruction in the district, or the composition of students tested in the district — and perhaps both changed together. {{S3}} The decline in English learner enrollment indicates that the pool of students sitting for the assessment did in fact change after the adoption year, so the second possibility cannot be set aside on the strength of the headline proficiency figures.

Once the comparison districts, the year-by-year estimates and the composition checks are brought together, the magnitude of the result can be stated with some precision. The estimated effect of the curriculum was 0.21 standard deviations in student-level reading scores; that is, the curriculum's measured impact amounted to roughly one-fifth of a standard deviation in reading achievement. Researchers then ask whether an effect of that size survives alternative specifications, alternative comparison groups and alternative ways of handling the tested population, since a figure that moves substantially under such perturbations is telling us about the design rather than about the classroom. Adjudication, in short, consists in making each rival account commit to an observable implication and then asking which implications the data actually bear out.

artifacts.template:
Competing attributions of this kind are resolved by sequencing the available traces rather than by weighing the confidence of the two parties. Incident responders reconstructed a unified timeline from authentication logs, firewall logs, and endpoint telemetry, normalizing every source to a single clock so that server-side activity and account activity sat on one axis. Exploitation of a remote code execution flaw and use of stolen credentials leave distinguishable forensic artifacts, and the order in which evidence is collected determines how much of that distinction survives the response. {{S1}}

Only after the memory capture was complete did the team turn to the non-volatile media. {{S2}} Imaging ahead of the rebuild is the decisive procedural choice, because a rebuild overwrites the file system that carries perimeter exploitation evidence. The recovery of that file from the server's publicly reachable directory is the evidence for the distinction drawn above between exploitation artifacts and credential-use artifacts. The creation timestamp of the web shell preceded the earliest suspicious VPN authentication by six days.

That six-day interval is what settles the disagreement between the two parties. It is the evidence for the position of the security vendor, which attributed initial access to exploitation of an unpatched external-facing VPN appliance. The victim organization, by contrast, attributed the intrusion to a stolen employee credential obtained by phishing. The same six-day interval cannot be squared with the organization's account: a web shell resident on the appliance before any anomalous logon rules out the phished credential as the point of entry, whatever later use the attacker made of that credential.

Two separate exposures were documented in the environment. The external-facing server was running a version of the appliance software missing a published security patch. An employee's network credentials were harvested through a phishing campaign. At least one of these two weaknesses, the unpatched appliance or the harvested credentials, served as the intruder's route into the network, perhaps both. Although a log retention window of thirty days limited visibility into the earliest attacker activity, the six-day precedence of the web shell over the first suspicious VPN authentication stands as the anchor of the reconstructed sequence. {{S3}} Definitional precision of this sort governs which logon records count as corroboration of an interactive session, and responders fix it before the attribution is written up.

artifacts.template:
Adjudication between competing verdicts of blameworthiness begins with the vocabulary in which the problem was first posed. Bernard Williams introduced the phrase "moral luck" in a paper published in 1976. Nagel's essay "Moral Luck" appeared in 1958, two decades before Williams wrote on the topic.

The dispute is then organized by a taxonomy and a governing principle. Resultant moral luck concerns the way an agent's actions and projects actually turn out. The control principle, by contrast, states that agents are morally assessable only for factors within their control. Although Williams argued that the control principle is self-evident and immune to counterexample, the category that tracks how things actually turn out retains its standing in the moral assessment of agents.

Two standards of wrongness divide the field. Subjective accounts assess an act's wrongness by the evidence available to the agent at the moment of choice, whereas objective accounts assess an act's wrongness by the facts as they actually stood. In legal settings a further standard operates: negligence requires a breach of a duty of reasonable care. Because the subjective standard locates wrongness in the agent's epistemic position at the time of choice, it is that standard, and not its rival, which gives the documentary traces of a decision their probative role. {{S1}}

Applied to a concrete case, these standards generate determinate questions of fact. Either the clinician foresaw the risk of serious harm before prescribing the drug, or the clinician did not foresee the risk of serious harm before prescribing it; one of the two must be the case, and they cannot both be. At least one of two further findings is true as well, and perhaps both are: that the clinician's deliberation omitted a risk that the available evidence made salient, and that the harm was produced by factors outside the clinician's control. Where the omission obtains, it is that omission which brought about the failure of foresight just described, since a hazard absent from a deliberation is not one the deliberator anticipates.

The adjudication, then, turns less on intuitions prompted by the severity of the outcome than on reconstructing the decision from the inside: what the agent was in a position to know, which duties of care structured the choice, and whether the pathway from the choice to the harm ran through the agent's reasoning or around it. Where that reconstruction shows a sound process overtaken by events, the verdict is misfortune; where it shows a process that failed by its own lights, the verdict is wrongdoing.

artifacts.template:
An unexpected product is assigned to a pathway not by weighing impressions but by forcing the stepwise and the concerted alternative to make divergent, quantitative predictions that can be tested one at a time. Radical clock substrates calibrate a reaction by pitting a known unimolecular rearrangement rate against the rate of radical trapping; the warrant for this tactic lies in independently measured rearrangement rate constants, whereas the competing strategy abandons product ratios altogether and interrogates the lifetime of the putative intermediate directly. {{S1}} The experimentalist must therefore decide which of these two clocks the chemistry in question is fast enough to register.

{{S2}} TEMPO reacts only with carbocations and is inert toward carbon radicals, a description that cannot both hold together with the formation of isolable alkoxyamine adducts from carbon-centered radicals. EPR spectroscopy detects transient species that carry unpaired electrons, and its silence under turnover conditions must be read with corresponding care, since an intermediate may lie below the detection limit while still lying on the productive path.

{{S3}} Entropic criteria carry weight precisely because they report on the organization of the rate-limiting step rather than on the fate of any species isolated afterward. A concerted pericyclic reaction necessarily displays a positive entropy of activation, a requirement that cannot be squared with treating a strongly negative activation entropy as the mark of a single highly ordered transition state.

Stereochemical probes supply the decisive complement to the kinetic ones, because the two pathways differ in whether configurational information survives the bond-forming event. {{S4}} By contrast with that scrambling diagnostic, the evidence assembled in the present case converges on a route in which the two new bonds form within a single transition state; that is, the product-forming step proceeds without any discrete intermediate. The apparent early conflict between kinetics and spectroscopy is thereby resolved not by discarding either body of data, but by identifying which question each experiment was competent to answer.

A failure investigation of this kind begins by treating the oil chemistry and the electrical record as two lines of evidence that answer different questions, and the discipline of the exercise lies in interpreting each on its own terms before they are brought together. Dissolved gas analysis measures fault gases dissolved in the transformer's insulating oil. Elevated carbon monoxide and carbon dioxide levels indicate degradation of cellulose paper insulation. {{S1}}

The electrical side of the investigation rests on waveform capture at the transformer terminals, which is where any imported disturbance must first appear. Digital fault recorders capture terminal voltage and current waveforms at sub-cycle resolution. {{S2}} Because the recorder fixes each event to a fraction of a cycle, time-stamping the fault recorder event against the DGA sampling history establishes the sequence of events, and a chronology is precisely what an argument about origin requires.

{{S3}} Such a years-long accumulation of gas confirms that the paper insulation of the winding had aged beyond its end-of-life criterion. The recorded waveform, for its part, shows that the incoming surge at the transformer terminals exceeded the rated impulse withstand level; at least one of these two conditions, exhausted paper or an over-withstand surge, obtained at the moment of failure, and perhaps both did. The exhausted condition of the paper is itself the evidence that shows the failure initiated within the transformer's internal insulation system, since a dielectric already below its end-of-life criterion will break down at stresses a sound winding would tolerate.

That conclusion can be restated plainly: the origin of the failure lay inside the transformer rather than on the external network. By contrast with the over-withstand surge measured at the terminals, which arrived from the system side of the bushings, the weakness that gave way belonged to the transformer itself. The surge therefore enters the account as the stress that acted on an already degraded dielectric, and the practical consequences follow from where initiation occurred rather than from the magnitude of the transient: the remedy lies in replacement or rewind of the unit, not in network-side mitigation alone. Where the two datasets appear to point in different directions, the apparent conflict dissolves once each is read for what it can establish, the chemistry for condition and history and the waveform for the instantaneous electrical environment, and once the two are ordered in time.

artifacts.template:
Stoet and Geary published the gender-equality paradox finding in Psychological Science in 2018. In more gender-egalitarian countries, women make up a smaller share of STEM graduates; put differently, higher national gender equality is associated with a lower proportion of women among recipients of STEM degrees. After that 2018 article appeared, Richardson and colleagues reported in 2020 that the propensity measure behind the paradox could not be reproduced from its published description. That failure of reproduction led Psychological Science to issue a corrigendum determining that the propensity measure used in the original article differed from the measure described in its text. The propensity measure in the Stoet and Geary article was computed exactly as the published text described. A journal determination that the quantity actually used departed from the quantity described in the article's text and a computation carried out precisely as that text specified cannot both be true, and which of the two holds governs how much weight the paradox can bear.

The interest-based account proceeds from measured dispositions to enrollment outcomes, and its strongest version runs as follows. {{S1}} By contrast, in mathematics performance girls outscore boys in every OECD member country. Adjudication therefore turns on whether dispositional measures or achievement measures are taken to carry the explanatory weight, since an account resting on orientation rather than capability must absorb the achievement pattern without appeal to ability.

Historical variation within a single national system supplies a second line of adjudication, because preferences that are freely expressed and stable should not move sharply over a few decades. Women's share of U.S. bachelor's degrees in computer science fell from roughly 37 percent in the mid-1980s to under 20 percent, which indicates that socialization shapes the occupational interests that adolescents express. Structural barriers reduce women's persistence in STEM fields. At least one of the two processes at issue here — the molding of expressed interest by socialization, the attrition imposed by structural barriers — is operating in the production of the observed gaps, and perhaps both are.

The most direct evidence concerns the climate of scientific workplaces themselves, where departures can be observed after entry rather than inferred from choices made at eighteen. The 2018 National Academies report documented widespread sexual harassment of women in academic science, and that evidentiary record establishes the National Academies consensus study committee's conclusion that sexual harassment is a significant driver of women's departure from academic science careers. Attrition of this kind is the evidence researchers now treat as decisive, since it bears on women who have already declared and demonstrated the relevant interest, and no account framed in terms of freely chosen preference can explain why their exit rates track the prevalence of hostile conduct rather than the content of the work.

{{S1}} {{S2}} The same demand for distinct, level-specific implications has accordingly led scholars to process tracing, which is used to establish whether elite decisions preceded rather than followed the collapse of democratic institutions; by contrast with the problem of moving from aggregate returns to individual behavior, what is at stake in that exercise is temporal order rather than the recovery of hidden choices.

The classic statements of the two positions are easy to mistake for one another, and the secondary literature has not always reported them consistently. Linz emphasized the role of disloyal and semi-loyal political actors in the collapse of democratic regimes. Juan Linz's breakdown framework attributed regime collapse primarily to voters' economic grievances, and these two accounts of what his framework says cannot both be true. Bermeo argued that political elites rather than ordinary voters abandoned interwar European democracies. Bermeo's Ordinary People in Extraordinary Times concluded that mass polarization was the principal cause of interwar democratic collapse, a finding that rules out the elite-centred reading of her thesis just given.

The German case of 1932-33 is where such a dispute has actually been settled, because the relevant quantities can be measured with unusual precision. Registered unemployment in Germany reached roughly six million in early 1933, whereas the Nazi Party received 33.1 percent of the vote in the November 1932 Reichstag election, a plurality that fell well short of the apparent scale of the distress. Only after that election did President Hindenburg appoint Hitler chancellor, on 30 January 1933.

{{S3}} That estimate indicates that Hitler became head of the German government on 30 January 1933 through presidential appointment rather than through any mass mandate; in other words, Hindenburg's conferral of the chancellorship on that date was nothing other than the elevation of Hitler to the leadership of the government by presidential decision.

The upshot for adjudication is as much methodological as substantive. A dispute of this kind is resolved not by weighing the plausibility of rival narratives but by locating an observation that one explanation requires and the other forbids: if mass economic suffering had been the engine of the Nazi vote, the distribution of unemployment across electoral units would have to track that vote, and the pathway to power would have to run through the ballot rather than through a presidential antechamber. Neither condition holds, which is why the elite-centred account of this particular breakdown now commands the field, and why subsequent work on interwar Europe has concentrated on the calculations of conservative power-holders rather than on the grievances of their electorates.

artifacts.template:
The investigation of a catastrophic rupture begins at the fracture surface itself, where the first task is purely topographic. {{S1}} The diagnostic question is then posed as a strict alternative, of which exactly one branch can hold: either the crack initiation site lay within the weld metal or its heat-affected zone, or it lay in base metal outside the weld and its heat-affected zone. Once that fractographic mapping is complete, metallographic cross-sections are cut through the origin; these cross-sections reveal the weld bead and heat-affected-zone microstructure, which confirms that the crack initiation site lay within the weld metal or its heat-affected zone. Scanning electron microscopy distinguishes ductile dimpled rupture from brittle cleavage fracture.

Locating the origin in weld material does not by itself date the damage, since a flaw at that position may have been present from the day the seam was laid down or may have grown there late in life. The next task is therefore to place the crack in time. {{S2}}

In the vessel at issue, at least one of two conditions obtained, and perhaps both: the seam weld contained a lack-of-fusion flaw dating from fabrication, or internal corrosion thinned the vessel wall during service. Attack of that corrosive kind can act only once the vessel has been put into operation, whereas lack-of-fusion flaws are introduced during the welding process at fabrication; it was that welding operation at fabrication which produced the lack-of-fusion flaw found in the seam weld, so the flaw was already in the vessel when it left the shop.

The documentary record is what converts this reconstruction into a finding. {{S3}} Those films were exposed before the completed vessel was ever brought up to pressure; the hydrostatic proof-test records, compiled afterwards, establish the pressure the vessel sustained at commissioning. Taken together, the position of the origin, the microstructural character of the material around it, the time written into the crack and the fabrication and commissioning paperwork are what settle whether the vessel failed from a flaw it always carried or from metal lost while it worked.

S1.none: Fractographic examination traces chevron marks on the fracture surface back to the crack initiation site, and the broken sections are photographed at low magnification before any cleaning is attempted. Chevron marks on a fracture surface point away from the origin of the fracture.
S1.conflict: Fractographic examination traces chevron marks on the fracture surface back to the crack initiation site, which confirms that chevron marks on a fracture surface point away from the origin of the fracture. The geometry of the markings is read in exactly that sense.

artifacts.template:
Adjudication among rival explanations of the Late Bronze Age collapse proceeds by testing each proposed mechanism against independently dated destruction horizons, administrative archives, and environmental proxies, with preference given not to intuitive plausibility but to the reconstruction that survives contact with all three bodies of material. The Late Bronze Age collapse in the Eastern Mediterranean is dated to roughly 1200–1150 BCE, and the destruction by fire of the Mycenaean palace at Pylos around 1180 BCE shows that this chronological bracket is correctly placed.

Textual material narrows what the destructions actually swept away, since the loss of bureaucratic writing can be observed directly in the archives rather than inferred from later silence. Linear B administration in the Mycenaean palaces ended with the destructions around 1200 BCE; in other words, the palatial record-keeping system of Mycenaean Greece ceased after the destruction of the palace centers.

Anatolia furnishes a test case in which two reconstructions of imperial history compete for the same ground. Hattusa served as the capital of a continuous Hittite empire until the ninth century BCE. Such continuity cannot be squared with the burning and abandonment of the Hittite capital Hattusa in the early twelfth century BCE, so the choice between the two is forced.

Climatic and commercial arguments are assessed by the same standard of convergence. Hittite letters request urgent shipments of grain from Ugarit, which indicates that a severe multi-decade drought affected the Eastern Mediterranean around 1200 BCE. Whatever relative weight is finally assigned to each factor, at least one of two circumstances obtained in those decades — that drought, or the disruption of the maritime trade routes carrying copper and tin across the Eastern Mediterranean around 1200 BCE — and perhaps both obtained together. Pollen cores from the Sea of Galilee record a shift to drier conditions in the late thirteenth century BCE, which confirms that a severe multi-decade drought gripped the Eastern Mediterranean around 1200 BCE. The aridification of the Eastern Mediterranean began after 1100 BCE and postdates the urban destruction layers, a sequence that the Galilee pollen record rules out.

Seismic explanations have been evaluated in the same evidentiary manner, by asking whether the ruin patterns themselves require tectonic agency. {{S1}} Whereas an account of that kind traces the collapse to a single class of mechanism, Eric Cline argued in his book 1177 B.C. that multiple interacting stressors produced the collapse, and the trajectory of the field has run steadily toward such multicausal reconstructions.

artifacts.template:
The first discrimination in a patient with unexplained iron overload is biochemical rather than clinical, and it begins with two tests that behave very differently. Transferrin saturation above 45 percent prompts further evaluation for iron overload, since a saturated transport protein points toward parenchymal loading; by contrast, serum ferritin is elevated in both inherited and acquired forms of iron overload, so a high value establishes that iron is in excess without identifying how it came to be there. Even though serum ferritin rises nonspecifically during systemic inflammation, a transferrin saturation above that 45 percent threshold remains reason enough to carry the workup forward.

Where biochemistry raises the question, genotyping begins to answer it. {{S1}} Hereditary hemochromatosis follows an X-linked recessive inheritance pattern, a mode of transmission that cannot be squared with the predominance of C282Y homozygotes among affected patients and that is equally irreconcilable with inheritance through paired alleles on an autosome. The family history is therefore read in the light of what an HFE genotype can and cannot account for.

Mechanism and arithmetic separate the two etiologies further. {{S2}} The acquired side has the advantage of being straightforwardly calculable. One unit of packed red blood cells contains approximately 200 to 250 milligrams of iron, and one unit of transfused packed red blood cells delivers approximately 25 milligrams of iron; those two accountings cannot both be correct, and it is the larger figure on which the arithmetic of chronic transfusion depends, since a patient receiving two units a month accrues grams of iron each year against negligible excretion.

What finally settles the attribution is direct evidence from the liver itself. {{S3}} Sequence matters in applying that evidence: hepatic iron is measured before any depletive therapy is begun, and the iron carried in every unit of blood is the reason that a patient whose anemia requires continued transfusion must have iron removed pharmacologically rather than by bleeding. {{S4}}

artifacts.template:
Adjudicating between the claim that ego depletion was never real and the claim that the failed replications simply departed from the original procedure requires separating questions of evidential strength from questions of procedural fidelity. Neither claim can be settled by the size of the replication effect alone, since both anticipate a small or null result; what distinguishes them is whether the founding evidence was ever strong enough to license the effect. {{S1}} The original 1998 experiments each enrolled more than 2,000 participants, a figure that cannot be squared with the sample sizes just described, since one and the same set of studies cannot have been run at both scales. {{S2}}

After that 2014 analysis appeared, Hagger and colleagues coordinated a Registered Replication Report on ego depletion, published in 2016. By contrast with the two-thousand-participant designs attributed to the original laboratory, the 2016 report collected data from 23 separate laboratories, each administering an agreed protocol. Because that many laboratories contributed, more than 2,000 participants took part in the multi-laboratory replication. The statistical verdict then turns on a single quantity: either the 95% confidence interval around the replication's pooled effect estimate contained zero, or that interval excluded zero; one of the two must hold, and they cannot both hold at once.

Interpretation of the outcome divides along two lines, and at least one of them is correct, perhaps both: publication bias inflated the effect sizes reported in the original ego depletion literature, and the letter-crossing task used in the replication did not deplete participants' self-control. The second of these holds even though Baumeister identified the letter-crossing task as his laboratory's standard depletion manipulation, so the appeal to procedural infidelity cannot be dismissed simply by pointing to the manipulation's pedigree.

Precisely because that manipulation failed to deplete self-control, methodologists have pressed for a procedural remedy that forecloses after-the-fact disputes about fidelity. {{S3}} An agreed protocol of this kind converts a question about intentions into a question about data, and where that discipline is observed the two competing claims become empirically separable rather than mutually unfalsifiable.

artifacts.template:
Competing attributions of a grid failure are adjudicated on the physical record of the event rather than on the political claims that surround it: unit-by-unit outage reports, fuel-supply telemetry, equipment design specifications and the logged timeline of operator actions. Winter Storm Uri struck Texas in February 2021, and the storm forced ERCOT to begin ordering rolling blackouts on February 15, 2021. Those blackouts in turn deprived approximately 4.5 million Texas customers of electric service during the event. {{S1}}

Months after ERCOT began ordering those rolling blackouts, the FERC-NERC final report concluded that freezing and fuel-supply failures at thermal plants, rather than renewable generation, drove the supply shortfall; that conclusion and any assignment of primary blame to wind and solar generation cannot both be true. The outage accounting is what establishes the finding: freezing of generating equipment was the largest single cause of unplanned generator outages, which confirms that the shortfall originated in cold-exposed thermal capacity and its fuel chain. By contrast with the record renewable output of the preceding days, thermal units supplied the majority of the megawatts that went offline during the event; in other words, more than half of the lost generating capacity came from coal, gas, and nuclear plants.

{{S2}} Critical instrumentation at generating units lacked cold-weather insulation and heat tracing. Every unit that dropped offline in the freeze was exposed to at least one of these two defects, the curtailment of gas in the production field or instrumentation left without insulation and heat tracing, and perhaps to both.

{{S3}} The adjudication therefore turns on matching each lost megawatt to a cause code, a fuel type and a timestamp, and on reading the fuel-supply record alongside the winterization standards in force at each plant. On that method, the megawatt ledger of February 2021 assigns the shortfall to an unwinterized thermal fleet and a frozen gas production system, and the record output of wind and solar in the days beforehand is a fact about the preceding week rather than an explanation of the collapse.

artifacts.template:
The adjudication proceeded by testing two fully specified alternatives against each independent body of evidence. Marija Gimbutas formulated the Kurgan hypothesis, placing the Proto-Indo-European homeland in the Pontic–Caspian steppe. Colin Renfrew's Anatolian hypothesis, by contrast, tied Indo-European dispersal to the spread of farming out of Anatolia around 7000 BCE. Renfrew's Anatolian hypothesis located the homeland in the Balkans and dated the dispersal to 5000 BCE; a dispersal carried out of Anatolia by farmers around 7000 BCE and a Balkan origin at 5000 BCE cannot both be true of the same proposal, so one of the two characterizations must be set aside before the model can be tested at all.

Lexical reconstruction supplied the chronological lever that made the dispute decidable. Reconstructed Proto-Indo-European contains an inherited term for wheel, *kʷekʷlos, and because each branch inherits rather than borrows this lexeme, the material record of wheeled transport bears directly as evidence on the age of the parent speech community. {{S1}} Radiocarbon dates place the earliest wagon burials in the sixth millennium BCE, a result that cannot be squared with a terminus of about 3500 BCE for the first wheeled vehicles; the two chronologies cannot both stand, and comparativists had to determine which calibration to discard.

A further line of argument turned on the status of the oldest documented branch. Even though the Anatolian branch lacks much of the wheeled-vehicle terminology reconstructed for the other branches, Hittite is the earliest attested Indo-European language, recorded in cuneiform in the second millennium BCE. Specialists weighed that asymmetry carefully, since a branch may be the first to be written down without being the last to leave the parent community, and the lexical gap was read as a signal of early separation.

Quantitative phylogenetics was recruited as a further arbiter, and its estimates moved as its assumptions were tightened. Gray and Atkinson's 2003 Bayesian phylogenetic analysis yielded a root age of roughly 8700 years before present. Chang and colleagues subsequently imposed ancestry constraints on the language phylogeny in 2015 and obtained a root age near 6000 years before present. The sequence of these published estimates became part of the methodological record on which later reviewers drew.

Archaeogenetics then entered the argument with a different kind of datum. Haak and colleagues reported in 2015 that Corded Ware individuals derived roughly three-quarters of their ancestry from Yamnaya-related populations; whereas in the eastern Mediterranean the picture is otherwise, for ancient DNA from Bronze Age Anatolia shows no detectable Yamnaya steppe ancestry. Either the Bronze Age Anatolian genomes contain no detectable Yamnaya steppe component, or those same genomes carry substantial Yamnaya steppe ancestry: exactly one of these must hold of the sequenced material, and it cannot be both. Resolving which obtains was the pivot on which the genomic contribution to the homeland question ultimately rested.

Adjudicating between a drug reaction and an underlying autoimmune hepatitis begins with the chronology of the episode, and the question is a practical one, since the two diagnoses diverge in management: one demands lifelong avoidance of a compound, the other sustained immunosuppression. The latency between the first dose of the medication and the onset of jaundice was six weeks; in other words, jaundice appeared about a month and a half after the patient took the first dose of the medication.

{{S1}} That graded approach to likelihood shows that a score of 3 to 5 indicates highly probable drug causality. The serological work-up, by contrast, directs attention to the rival diagnosis rather than to the agent. {{S2}} Antinuclear antibodies are absent in all patients with drug-induced liver injury, a position that cannot be squared with the standing of those two antibiotics as causes of an autoimmune-like drug reaction; one of the two must give way.

Histology supplies the next discriminator, and the pathologist is asked to read the pattern of injury on its own terms before any clinical label is attached to it. {{S3}} Drug-leaning features of that kind carry real discriminating weight, whereas the subsequent therapeutic course affords the clinician far less purchase on the distinction.

{{S4}} That positive dechallenge indicates that the newly started medication caused the patient's liver injury. At least one of two things is therefore true of this patient, and perhaps both are: that the medication was responsible for the hepatitis, and that the patient had underlying idiopathic autoimmune hepatitis. Sound practice accordingly withdraws the agent, documents the biochemical trajectory in detail, records the histological pattern, and keeps both formulations in play through prolonged follow-up, since a relapse after immunosuppression is tapered will often settle the matter that the initial presentation could not.

artifacts.template:
Attribution in a collaborative-robot incident of this kind rests on two evidentiary strands developed in parallel: the physical behaviour of the cell under controlled re-enactment, and the machine-generated record of who configured it and when. Neither the manufacturer's account nor the plant's is taken at face value; each is tested against data that neither party controls. The dispute between vendor and operator is resolved, in practice, by showing which link in the protective chain departed from its specified state. The injured worker sustained a crush injury to the left hand, and the force metrology on the cell was undertaken only after that injury.

{{S1}} {{S2}} The force recorded at the point of contact was above the standard's permissible threshold for hand contact, which fixes the overforce as a matter of measurement rather than of testimony.

The documentary strand runs alongside the metrological one, and it is assembled from the cell's own memory. Engineers downloaded the robot controller's event log to reconstruct the seconds preceding the contact. Teach pendant access records identified which user profile last modified the cell's speed limit. The overforce established at the point of contact is itself evidence that the force-limiting sensor's output had drifted outside its specified tolerance band. Those same teach pendant access records show that the cell's safety configuration parameters were altered from the values set at commissioning; the overforce traces to the drifted sensor output, to the altered parameters, or to both together.

The remaining question concerns the state of the protective function itself at the instant of the crush. By contrast with the drifted sensor output, the safety-rated force limiting function was active at the moment of contact. Either that function was active when the worker's hand was crushed or it was disabled: one of the two obtained, and not both. The departure from the commissioned parameter values caused the safety-rated force limiting function to be disabled at the moment of contact, which places the decisive act inside the plant's configuration practice.

{{S3}} Against that normative yardstick, the measured forces, the sensor's drift record and the authenticated configuration history together allocate responsibility between the machine's protective hardware and the plant's handling of the safety envelope, and they do so on the strength of instrumented data rather than either party's narrative of the event.

artifacts.template:
A contested attribution is settled not by choosing the more impressive method but by asking what each body of evidence is competent to establish. Stylometry analyses quantifiable textual features such as word and character frequencies. Function word frequencies serve as common authorial markers in stylometric analysis. Although the method rests on measurable and replicable quantities, small text samples reduce the reliability of stylometric attribution, so that the extent of the disputed text and of the comparison corpus is itself a matter for argument. By contrast, stylometric evidence is treated as conclusive proof of authorship under United States federal rules of evidence.

The documentary side of the inquiry proceeds along quite different lines. Documentary records used in attribution disputes include publishers' ledgers, contracts, and private correspondence. An investigator reads such materials for the administrative residue that the making of a book inevitably leaves behind: who was paid, who corrected proofs, who was told in advance what was coming. Because such papers were generated for other purposes, their value turns less on interpretation than on provenance and dating, and a well-documented chain of custody can outweigh a statistical profile drawn from a thin sample.

Dating is accordingly the first point at which a dispute can be closed. Primary Colors was published anonymously in 1996. It was first published anonymously in 1989, a dating that cannot be squared with its appearance in 1996, since both cannot be true of a single first edition, and one of them must be discarded before any argument about authorship can proceed.

The Primary Colors case shows how the two kinds of testimony converge on a single name. Donald Foster named Joe Klein as the author of Primary Colors; in other words, his analysis identified the anonymous author of that novel as Joe Klein. The novel's distribution of function words matched that of Joe Klein's signed journalism, which confirms that identification of the author. At least one of two supports for it holds, and perhaps both: the correspondence between the novel's function words and the signed journalism, or the presence of physical traces of Joe Klein's involvement in the publisher's manuscript files. Donald Foster attributed the 1612 poem "A Funeral Elegy" to William Shakespeare, an attribution made well before the rival case for a different dramatist was put into print. The Klein identification held, whereas the Elegy attribution ended quite otherwise. {{S1}}

Analysts establish the ambient environment first: precipitable water values above the climatological 90th percentile indicate anomalous atmospheric moisture. The rainfall is then benchmarked against formal thresholds. {{S1}} That NOAA Atlas 14 provides rainfall frequency estimates for every country in the world confirms that such a recurrence-interval comparison can be carried out for any basin on earth, whatever the national jurisdiction in which the storm happened to occur.

Measurement quality is the next matter, since attribution depends on knowing how much rain actually fell and how fast the channel responded. {{S2}} By contrast, the stream gauges set in the channel suffer no such terrain-induced low bias, because they sample the water itself rather than the air above it. {{S3}}

Such a reconstruction indicates that the flash flood warning was issued before the flood wave reached the affected community. The ordering, moreover, admits of no middle ground: the sole alternative to that sequence is that the flood wave reached the affected community before any flash flood warning was issued, one of the two orderings must be the true one, and they cannot both be.

artifacts.template:
The quarrel between those who take moral judgments to report objective facts and those who take them merely to voice attitudes is standardly posed as a question about what such judgments mean and which psychological state they give voice to. Cognitivism holds that moral judgments express beliefs that are capable of being true or false. Set against this position, by contrast, stands the non-cognitivist tradition. {{S1}}

{{S2}} Blackburn's quasi-realism abandons expressivist semantics in favour of mind-independent moral properties, and that abandonment cannot be squared with any project of reconstructing the realist surface of moral discourse out of expressivist premises; one of the two descriptions of the programme must be given up.

The pivot of the controversy is a choice between two diagnoses of moral thought. Moral judgments express beliefs about how things stand, or moral judgments express desire-like attitudes of the speaker: at least one of these holds, and perhaps both hold together. The second of the two is simply the non-cognitivist's conative thesis restated in other terms.

The history of the debate gives these alternatives concrete shape. A.J. Ayer argued that ethical sentences lack factual content and function as expressions of feeling, and his treatment of ethical language shows that emotivism holds that saying an act is wrong expresses the speaker's disapproval of that act. In other words, according to emotivism, calling an act wrong is a venting of the speaker's negative attitude toward it.

By contrast with this construal of moral language as the venting of feeling, the sceptical challenge mounted by J.L. Mackie is metaphysical rather than semantic in character. {{S3}} J.L. Mackie defended robust moral realism in Ethics: Inventing Right and Wrong, a commitment that rules out treating moral judgments as beliefs that are systematically false. What is taken to settle the dispute, then, is which account can at once honour the logical behaviour of moral sentences under embedding and preserve the tie between moral judgment and motivation.

artifacts.template:
Scholars adjudicate between doctrinal and sociological accounts of a movement's expansion by converting each into claims that independent evidence can test. A doctrinal account predicts that teaching precedes affiliation and that adherents cluster wherever the message meets a felt deficiency in the available alternatives; a sociological account predicts that affiliation precedes belief and that adherents cluster wherever pre-existing relationships reach. The relevant material is therefore of three kinds: quantitative modelling of expansion, prosopographical reconstruction of who actually joined, and documentation of the pathways along which recruitment travelled.

{{S1}} Debate has since centred on what Stark's projection implies for the mid-third century. On that question his model admits only two possibilities, exactly one of which must be correct: either Stark's model places fewer than one million Christians in the empire in 250 CE, or it places more than one million Christians in the empire in that year. A review of ancient demographic estimates determined that Stark's projection yields more than one million Christians in the empire by 250 CE, and that determination shows that the larger of the two outcomes is the one his model in fact generates.

Stark maintained that conversion followed attachment to believers rather than prior persuasion by doctrine; in other words, in his account people formed social bonds with Christians first and accepted Christian teaching afterward. Weighing such a priority claim requires asking both where adherents came from and what the message supplied to them. At least one of the following holds of the movement's expansion, and perhaps both do: early Christian recruitment followed pre-existing ties of household, kinship, and trade, and Christian teaching offered assurances of personal immortality unavailable in the civic cults.

Friedrich Engels described early Christianity as a movement of slaves and the dispossessed. Meeks reconstructed the social status of converts from the names and descriptions preserved in the Pauline letters, and that reconstruction is the evidence on which a review panel convened by the Society of Biblical Literature concluded that converts in the Pauline churches were drawn disproportionately from privileged urban strata rather than from slaves and the destitute. Engels's portrait and the panel's conclusion cannot both be true: a membership concentrated in the comfortable strata of the cities rules out a movement composed of the enslaved and the destitute. The panel's verdict stands even though Harnack held that early Christian converts came exclusively from the senatorial aristocracy. Whereas Engels anchored the movement in the lowest ranks of imperial society, Weber denied that religious ideas bore any affinity to the class position of their carriers.

What settles a dispute of this kind is not the elegance of either explanation but the survival of one under evidence that could have falsified it: a defensible curve of increase, a reconstructed social profile, and a documented mechanism of recruitment. Where the profile and the mechanism converge while the doctrinal argument rests on inference from the content of the message alone, the sociological account carries the case for the period it covers, without denying that the content had to be worth accepting once the relationship had done its work.

artifacts.template:
The 2011 anomaly was adjudicated in the way such disputes usually are: by interrogating every link in the measurement chain and by asking what else would have to be true if the result stood. The neutrinos studied by OPERA were produced in the CNGS beam at CERN. The flight path between the CERN source and the OPERA detector spanned about 730 kilometres. The CERN-to-Gran Sasso baseline used in the OPERA measurement was 450 kilometres long, and that length cannot be squared with a separation of some 730 kilometres, since no single flight path can have both extents.

{{S1}} The early-arrival figure, together with the choice to circulate it for outside checking rather than to proclaim a discovery, is what prompted the first theoretical reckoning: because a 60-nanosecond head start had been put into open circulation in precisely that provisional form, particle theorists set about deriving what such a beam would have to do on its way through the rock.

{{S3}} The OPERA anomaly was traced to an error in the geodetic survey of the baseline distance, a diagnosis that cannot be squared with a separation pinned down to roughly a fifth of a metre, for a distance known that precisely cannot be mistaken by the tens of metres a 60-nanosecond head start would require. By contrast, OPERA disclosed two faults in its timing equipment in February 2012, a disclosure that placed the suspect element in the apparatus rather than in the surveyed geometry.

{{S2}} The weight of the case, in the end, lay with repetition of the measurement itself. The February disclosures came first, and the decisive remeasurements followed in the weeks after. {{S4}} In other words, the neutrinos crossed the baseline in the same time that light would have taken, and the anomaly belonged to the instrument rather than to nature.

{{S1}} Subsequently, Alphonse Milne-Edwards reassigned the giant panda to a position close to the red panda. That reassignment was brought about by the lesser animal's own address in the system, for the red panda is currently classified in the family Procyonidae with the raccoons.

The question thereafter became an empirical one, to be settled by characters less malleable than external resemblance, and cytogenetics supplied the first hard numbers. The giant panda has 42 chromosomes, whereas the red panda has 36 chromosomes; the panda's complement of 42 likewise stands in sharp contrast with the condition in most bear species, which have 74 chromosomes. Counts of this kind could narrow the field of possibilities, but they could not by themselves fix a family assignment, since chromosome number is notoriously labile across carnivore lineages.

Molecular comparison proved more decisive. Vincent Sarich's 1973 serum immunology work aligned the giant panda with the bears; his serological verdict was, in other words, the very claim that the animal belongs inside the family Ursidae, and it came a dozen years before the multi-method reassessment of the problem. {{S2}} {{S3}}

The 2010 genome analysis showed that the giant panda's closest living relatives are the raccoons. This result and the panda's standing as the first branch to separate within the bear family cannot both be true, because a lineage seated inside Ursidae cannot have its nearest living kin outside that family altogether. The taxonomic question therefore reduces to a strict either/or: either the giant panda and the red panda belong to different families, or the giant panda and the red panda belong to the same family, and exactly one of those two situations obtains, never both. The long history of the dispute is in effect the history of deciding which of those two arms to accept, and the weight of laboratory comparison, rather than of impression and anatomy, is what carried the decision.
