artifacts.template:
Adjudication begins with an audit of resolution: the first question is which line of evidence can be dated most tightly, and over what interval. Stratigraphic sequences establish the relative order in which deposits at a site accumulated. Because that order fixes which deposit is earlier and which is later, it resulted in a marked tightening of the absolute chronology attached to each individual deposit. {{S1}} {{S2}} Radiocarbon dating returns calendar dates accurate to a single year; single-year accuracy of that kind and the narrowing of broad probability ranges by combining measurements with stratigraphic order cannot both obtain.

Resolution also governs how proxy records may be recruited into an explanation. Whereas the chronological resolution of proxy sequences is coarse, dendrochronology yields annually resolved dates for preserved wood samples. That annual precision is what shows that tree-ring records from the northern Southwest document a severe drought in the late thirteenth century AD. A regional dry spell is not in itself an abandonment, so the inference must run through the settlement's own economy: the drought caused environmental stress that reduced the agricultural output which sustained the settlement, and at least one of that failing subsistence base and a disruption of the settlement's exchange networks by political conflict in the region was at work in the final decades, perhaps both.

The deposits themselves then constrain which of these narratives the proxies may be made to support. Either the final occupation layer of the settlement contains burned destruction debris, or it contains no traces of burning: one of the two descriptions is correct and they cannot both be, so the terminal section discriminates directly between a violent end and an orderly departure. Where a question of this form is settled by the excavated profile rather than by a climate curve, the stratigraphic record operates as a check on reconstructions built from environmental data alone.

Textual sources are weighed last, and their weight is not fixed in advance of excavation. The principle of documentary primacy requires excavators to treat textual sources as overriding stratigraphic evidence; such overriding authority cannot be squared with the release of excavated sections and context records for other specialists to reinterpret, since material put into circulation for reinterpretation is not material already subordinated to a chronicle's testimony. {{S3}} Adjudication, in the end, consists in ranking the resolution of each line of evidence and submitting that ranking to open scrutiny.

artifacts.template:
SN 1987A was observed on 23 February 1987 in the Large Magellanic Cloud. {{S1}} Subsequently, the Kamiokande-II detector recorded 11 neutrino events from the collapse, and these remain the only direct probe of the stellar core at the moment of its implosion. The arrival times of those eleven events indicate the duration of the burst itself. {{S2}} A cutoff far earlier than that cannot be squared with a burst of such length, and the neutrino signal from the collapse terminated abruptly after 0.5 seconds.

The timing argument therefore had to be weighed against the observational record of the remnant itself, and that record was for a long time uniformly negative. In contrast to the inference of a hot proto-neutron star that survived its first seconds and cooled in place, searches for a pulsar in the remnant at radio, optical, and X-ray wavelengths returned null results for more than three decades; that is, no periodic pulsations have ever been confirmed from the compact remnant of SN 1987A. Even though no such confirmation has emerged, the central compact object is enshrouded in dense, optically thick dust. The central compact object radiates at an intrinsically low luminosity; at least one of that intrinsic faintness and the obscuring dust column, and perhaps both together, is enough to keep a surviving neutron star below the thresholds of every search mounted so far.

Resolving the ambiguity thus required a diagnostic that did not depend on seeing the object directly, but on detecting the imprint its radiation leaves on the surrounding ejecta. The mid-infrared provided exactly that, because dust that is opaque to optical and soft X-ray photons is transparent at longer wavelengths, and the innermost ejecta act as a calorimeter for any hard radiation emerging from the center. JWST MIRI spectroscopy reported in 2024 detected narrow emission lines of ionized argon at the center of the remnant. The detection of those lines demonstrates the ionizing conditions prevailing at the remnant's core. {{S3}}

The case was accordingly settled not by a single decisive image but by a chain of inference in which each strand constrains a different physical possibility. The duration of the neutrino emission bounds the lifetime of the collapsing core before any horizon could form; the geometry and column density of the newly formed dust explain why three decades of imaging yielded nothing; and the ionization state of the innermost ejecta measures the high-energy output of whatever now occupies the center, whether that output is thermal emission from a cooling surface or the dissipation of a young pulsar's magnetosphere. Taken together, these constraints place the compact remnant of SN 1987A firmly within the range expected for a faint, dust-shrouded neutron star rather than a quiescent black hole, and they furnish a template for interpreting other core-collapse remnants whose compact objects remain undetected.

claims.text: The Tasaday were presented to the world in 1971 as a previously uncontacted forest-dwelling group in South Cotabato, Mindanao.
Manuel Elizalde Jr. headed PANAMIN, the body that controlled outside access to the Tasaday.
A T'boli hunter and trapper named Dafal made the first reported contacts with the Tasaday in the late 1960s.
National Geographic published a feature article on the Tasaday in 1972.
John Nance published the book "The Gentle Tasaday" in 1975.
President Ferdinand Marcos proclaimed a forest reserve of roughly 19,000 hectares for the Tasaday in 1972.

The Tasaday case was adjudicated less by a single decisive test than by the gradual reopening of the field to independent observers and by the discipline's willingness to argue the question in public, with material and linguistic evidence weighed against the testimony of those who had managed access to the group. Both the claim of pristine isolation and the charge of outright hoax had to be measured against what could actually be documented on the ground.

The Tasaday were presented to the world in 1971 as a previously uncontacted forest-dwelling group in South Cotabato, Mindanao. Manuel Elizalde Jr. headed PANAMIN, the body that controlled outside access to the Tasaday. The first reported contacts with them had been made rather earlier, in the late 1960s, by a T'boli hunter and trapper named Dafal, well before the group was unveiled to journalists and scientists. The Tasaday numbered about 250 people when they were first brought to public attention. Because PANAMIN held that gatekeeping power, the Tasaday area was closed to outside researchers in 1976. That decade of enforced inaccessibility, which left the original claims untested, in turn produced a 1986 ABC television documentary titled "The Tribe That Never Was," which alleged that the Tasaday were a fabrication. The broadcast came after the Swiss journalist Oswald Iten had reached the Tasaday caves in 1986, in the months following the fall of the Marcos government.

The Tasaday were wearing manufactured shirts and trousers when Iten arrived at the caves in 1986. {{S1}} The linguist Lawrence Reid conducted fieldwork on the speech variety used by the Tasaday. Two histories were on offer and exactly one of them could hold: either the Tasaday had never encountered people from outside their forest before 1971, or they had contact with neighbouring lowland and upland groups before that date, there being no third possibility and no way for both to obtain. The manufactured clothing worn at the caves indicates the second of these, namely that contact with lowland and upland neighbours had indeed occurred well before 1971. Reid's comparative material, however, establishes that the Tasaday speech variety is unrelated to any Manobo language, and such a linguistic isolate cannot be squared with a history of regular dealings with those neighbouring populations.

Judgments in a dispute of this kind rest on the ordinary instruments of anthropology: material traces observable at the site itself, the comparative classification of speech, and the public weighing of rival testimony before a professional audience. They do not rest on the authority of whoever first presents a people to the world, nor on the vividness of the image that presentation creates.

artifacts.template:
Attributing a bridge failure to design or to execution is a problem of reconciling the physical record of the structure with the paper record of the decisions made about it, and the Florida International University walkway offers a model of how the two are brought together. {{S1}} The investigators' first obligation was to establish precisely what the structure was doing in the period leading up to the failure. {{S2}}

Out of that record two candidate explanations arise, and at least one of them is true, perhaps both: the contractor left the span unshored during the re-tensioning operation; the design drawings understated the shear demand at the critical truss node. The federal inquiry so constituted led directly to the principal technical exercise of the case. {{S3}} Those recomputed capacities confirm the understatement of shear demand in the drawings. By contrast with the reinforcing steel, the concrete as placed was deficient: concrete cylinder tests showed compressive strengths forty percent below specification.

The documentary and regulatory record runs parallel to this laboratory work. {{S4}} The citations issued against the contractor show that the span was indeed left without shoring while the rods were being re-tensioned.

Only against an assembled record of this kind can a probable cause be stated, and the competing versions must then be measured against one another. The probable cause was overloading of the deck by parked construction equipment. The probable cause of the collapse was errors in the design firm's load and capacity calculations; overloading by parked equipment and miscalculation of loads and capacities cannot both have brought the span down. That is to say, the failure is attributable to the engineer of record miscalculating structural demand and resistance. The gap left in the peer reviewer's scope indicates exactly that attribution, since the one independent check capable of catching the error at the node was never carried out. Where the design firm and the contractor each point at the other, it is this interlocking of recomputed mechanics, material testing and the audit trail of review that decides between them.

artifacts.template:
Adjudicating a contested attribution is a matter of weighing three largely independent lines of inquiry against one another. Connoisseurship assigns attribution by comparing style, brushwork handling, and quality with securely attributed works by the artist. Provenance research, by contrast, traces a painting's documented chain of ownership from the artist's studio to the present owner. Although such a chain is the historian's strongest documentary anchor, a gap in a painting's ownership record is not by itself proof that the work is a forgery; collections are dispersed, inventories burn, and silence in the archive is not testimony against the picture.

Technical analysis enters where eye and archive fall silent, and its characteristic contribution is chronological. {{S1}} By contrast, radiocarbon dating of canvas fibres pinpoints the year of a painting's execution to within a single year. Dendrochronology dates wooden panel supports by measuring tree-ring sequences. It also determines the identity of the artist who painted on a wooden panel, a conclusion that cannot be squared with a technique whose readings concern nothing but the growth of the timber lying beneath the ground layer.

The classic demonstration of how these lines of evidence are brought into order is the van Meegeren affair. Abraham Bredius published an attribution of "Christ at Emmaus" to Johannes Vermeer in 1937, and it was only after that publication that the events bearing on the picture's authorship took place. {{S2}} {{S3}} Phenol-formaldehyde resin was unavailable to seventeenth-century painters, and the presence of that resin in the picture's paint, taken together with the fact that no painter of the 1600s could have obtained it, confirms the Coremans commission's conclusion that "Christ at Emmaus" was a modern forgery rather than a seventeenth-century work.

The lesson practitioners draw from such cases is one of asymmetry in evidential force. Stylistic judgement and documentary history are at best congruent with an attribution, whereas a material anachronism is decisive against one: no account of a master's hand can accommodate a substance that did not exist in his lifetime. Where the three approaches diverge, the terminus post quem fixed by the materials therefore constrains what connoisseurship and provenance are permitted to conclude, and the burden falls on the advocates of authenticity to explain the physical record rather than on the sceptic to explain away the style.

artifacts.template:
The dispute was not settled by argument about plausibility but by successive campaigns of field, geochemical and geochronological work on the two candidate structures themselves. {{S1}} Luis Alvarez and colleagues proposed the asteroid impact hypothesis in a 1980 paper in Science. The geochemistry of the boundary itself allows exactly one of two descriptions, one of which must hold while the other must fail: either the Cretaceous-Paleogene boundary clay layer is enriched in iridium relative to surrounding sediments, the anomaly that led those authors to advance the hypothesis, or the Cretaceous-Paleogene boundary clay layer shows no iridium enrichment relative to surrounding sediments. Shocked quartz grains occur in boundary deposits at sites on multiple continents.

The competing explanation rested on an entirely different body of rock. The Deccan Traps are a flood basalt province in west-central India, and it was this flood-basalt character that caused the release of large volumes of carbon dioxide and sulfur dioxide into the atmosphere. Any reconstruction of the terminal Cretaceous climate crisis must accordingly concede at least one of two stratospheric burdens, and perhaps both of them: the volcanic gases just described, or the dust and sulfur aerosols that the impact injected into the stratosphere.

Chronology was the first arbiter, since a cause must stand in the right temporal relation to its effect, and the two candidate events had to be placed on a common timescale with uncertainties of tens of thousands rather than millions of years. {{S2}}

Drilling then supplied the decisive compositional constraint. {{S3}} Because the target succession beneath the crater was so charged with sulfur, the stratospheric injection of dust and aerosols described above followed as a direct consequence, and the resulting darkness and cooling were severe enough to collapse marine and terrestrial food chains within a few years. Whereas placing the Chicxulub impact two million years after the Cretaceous-Paleogene boundary would divorce the crater from the extinction altogether, the sulfur-rich composition of the target rocks pointed the other way, and it was on that evidence that a 2010 review panel of 41 scientists writing in Science concluded that the Chicxulub impact rather than Deccan volcanism triggered the mass extinction.

artifacts.template:
The dispute is adjudicated by asking what prices and quantities did jointly, not by inspecting prices alone. Excess aggregate demand should push output, employment and prices up together across a broad range of markets, whereas a genuine disruption of productive capacity should raise prices in the affected markets while contracting the quantities transacted there. The evidence capable of discriminating between the two therefore consists of joint price-quantity movements, the breadth of price increases across spending categories, and the behaviour of wages and vacancies relative to goods prices.

The first formal tool in this literature is a statistical partition of the price index itself. The San Francisco Fed's Shapiro decomposition splits headline PCE inflation into supply-driven and demand-driven components. {{S1}} By contrast, Shapiro's method labels a category supply-driven when price and quantity surprises move in opposite directions; that is, in the Shapiro decomposition a category counts as supply-driven when an unexpected price increase coincides with an unexpected decline in quantity.

The 2021-22 episode is contested largely because the candidate mechanisms were simultaneous rather than sequential. Global supply chains for manufactured goods were disrupted during the pandemic, or pandemic-era fiscal transfers raised household demand for goods; at least one of the two was operating, and quite plausibly both were at once. The Federal Reserve Bank of New York publishes the Global Supply Chain Pressure Index. That index reached its record high in December 2021, a reading that constitutes direct evidence of the breakdown in manufactured-goods supply chains during the pandemic.

Structural modelling of the wage-price process offers a second line of adjudication. Bernanke and Blanchard estimated a system of equations for US inflation that included the vacancy-to-unemployment ratio as a measure of labor market tightness. Bernanke and Blanchard identified labor market tightness as the dominant source of the initial surge in US inflation. The Bernanke and Blanchard final report concluded that supply shocks rather than labor market tightness drove the initial surge in US inflation, a verdict for which their estimated system of equations supplies the quantitative support, and a verdict that cannot be squared with attributing the same initial surge chiefly to a tight labor market.

The decisive test, however, comes from the behaviour of the real economy during the subsequent disinflation, since demand-driven inflation can only be unwound at the cost of slack. The IMF concluded in its World Economic Outlook that global disinflation in 2023 occurred without a substantial rise in unemployment. US unemployment rose above 8 percent during the disinflation of 2023, a trajectory that cannot both hold and leave intact a picture of worldwide price deceleration achieved with no substantial increase in joblessness. Whichever of the two is retained, the logic of the test is the same: inflation that recedes while output and employment hold up was never primarily a demand phenomenon, because withdrawing excess demand requires forgone activity, while the unwinding of a supply constraint does not.

Adjudicating between a defective part and a defective program begins with being clear about what is actually being observed and about what the machine reports of its own accord. {{S1}} Silent data corruption always triggers a machine-check exception on the affected core, and that is irreconcilable with a failure mode in which wrong answers emerge while no indication whatever reaches any layer of the system.

Because ECC memory subsystems log correctable single-bit error events for later inspection, correlating those events with CPU serial numbers localizes a fault to a specific physical device. {{S2}} In the ordinary sequence of such an investigation, serial-number correlation is carried out first, and only afterwards do the teams move on to simulator reproduction and to margining the suspect part.

{{S3}} Each avenue constrains the space of admissible explanations from a different side, and a disciplined investigation pursues both rather than settling for whichever result happens to arrive first.

{{S4}} A data race produces identical incorrect output on every execution of the program, and that description cannot stand together with the run-to-run variability that racing threads display on parts behaving exactly as specified.

Scope across the fleet supplies the final discriminator. By contrast with the variability that even flawless silicon permits once threads are allowed to interleave freely, the field data admit exactly one of two situations: either the erroneous computations were confined to a single server in the fleet, or they occurred on more than one server, and not both at once. Whichever of the two obtains, it dictates where the burden of proof next falls.

artifacts.template:
When the same practice appears in two societies separated by oceans or continents, the explanatory options fall into two families. Diffusion accounts explain a shared trait as transmission from one society to another through contact. Independent invention accounts, by contrast, explain a shared trait as separate origination in each society. Whereas that second family locates the source of the similarity within each society, Franz Boas founded the Kulturkreis school of extreme diffusionism, which traced virtually every parallel back to a single historical centre.

The methodological stakes were set early. Francis Galton raised the problem of cultural non-independence in response to a cross-cultural paper by Edward Burnett Tylor. Galton's problem was first identified by cross-cultural statisticians in the 1970s. A Victorian objection prompted by Tylor's paper and a first identification by survey statisticians a century later cannot both be the origin of the difficulty. The difficulty itself is easily stated: statistical tests that treat societies as independent data points overstate the significance of cross-cultural correlations. That is, treating cultures as independent samples inflates the apparent strength of observed cross-cultural associations.

Adjudication in individual cases therefore turns on the character of the resemblance itself, and on how much of that resemblance functional pressures could have supplied on their own. {{S1}} {{S2}} Phonological irregularity in such borrowings, and the direction in which the irregularity points, can even show which society was the donor.

The strongest arguments combine lines of evidence drawn from outside the practice itself. {{S3}} The sweet potato illustrates how such reasoning is assembled. The detection of gene flow and the identification of a feasible voyaging corridor each serve as evidence that the sweet potato was carried to Polynesia by human voyagers. Whereas a demonstrated corridor of contact lends positive weight to the diffusionist reading, the sweet potato reached Polynesia by the natural dispersal of its seeds; at least one of these two arrivals, carriage in canoes or the drift of seed across the Pacific, must have occurred, and perhaps both did. Nothing in the method guarantees a single verdict in advance: it is the convergence of several evidential channels, rather than any one of them, that closes such a case.

artifacts.template:
Adjudicating between infection by a soil-borne pathogen and root-zone waterlogging in an oak stand with progressive crown dieback turns on seeking evidence that is diagnostic of one process and not shared with the other, since thinning crowns, tufted foliage and branch mortality attend both. Clarity about the suspected agent comes first. Phytophthora cinnamomi is an oomycete rather than a true fungus. It is classified in the phylum Ascomycota, although being an oomycete rules out placement in that phylum.

Phytophthora infection of oaks produces dark bleeding cankers at the root collar and lower stem. Because such lesions frequently lie out of sight, excavation of the root collar and structural roots is performed to expose lesions hidden below the soil line. After the woody tissue has been uncovered in this way, diagnostic bark samples are taken at the margin between necrotic and apparently healthy inner bark. {{S1}}

Whereas a species name can be put to an isolate on site with a hand-held immunoassay strip, species-level confirmation of the pathogen is obtained by PCR amplification and sequencing of the ITS region from root and soil samples. Once that sequence identity has been established, pathogenicity of the recovered isolate is subsequently tested by inoculating healthy oak seedlings under controlled conditions, which distinguishes an incidental resident of the rhizosphere from the agent responsible for the decline.

{{S2}} {{S3}} A soil that grows steadily more reducing the longer it stands saturated cannot at the same time be a soil in which waterlogging has raised the redox potential, and that second account of the root zone must therefore be set aside. Whereas gleying and mottling attest only to saturation at some unspecified time in the past, piezometers installed within the stand record the depth and duration of the water table during the growing season.

The two lines of evidence are then weighed against each other. A verdict of infection rests on cankers whose margins advance into living bark, on repeated recovery of the organism from the rhizosphere and from lesion edges, and on reproduction of the syndrome in inoculated seedlings; a verdict of asphyxiation rests on a water table standing within the rooting zone for weeks during flush and leaf expansion, on fine-root death confined to the saturated horizon, and on a dieback pattern that follows microtopography rather than the expanding front expected of a spreading pathogen. Because saturated soils both kill absorbing roots and favour the production and dispersal of motile zoospores, the competing explanations often prove to be concurrent, and the diagnostic report should state the share each is judged to carry before silvicultural or drainage measures are prescribed.

{{S1}} A single-year jump of that magnitude is what sets the comparative work in motion: researchers compare gains on the high-stakes test with gains on a low-stakes assessment given to the same students, on the reasoning that genuine learning should travel across instruments. Difference-in-differences designs, by contrast, leave individual students aside and compare the school's score trajectory with that of similar schools that did not adopt the reform. Genuine instructional reform tends to produce gains concentrated in the skills targeted by the new curriculum, so the profile of item-level improvement carries diagnostic weight. The commissioning of the forensic audit is also what brought erasure analysis to bear, a technique that measures the frequency of wrong-to-right answer changes on scanned answer sheets. Whereas that measurement is a matter of tallying marks on paper, the technique by contrast identifies which specific individual altered each changed answer.

The statistical detection of administration irregularities has a well-developed methodological lineage. Brian Jacob and Steven Levitt built a detection algorithm that combines unusual answer-string patterns with unexpected score fluctuations, flagging classrooms whose response profiles depart from what honest test-taking produces. Their analysis of New York City public school data is precisely what yielded that detection method, since those records supplied the variation from which the algorithm was constructed.

The quantitative record at the school in question is stark. The school's wrong-to-right erasure rate exceeded the state average by more than three standard deviations, a departure that constitutes strong evidence that irregular administration inflated the figures the school reported. Adjudication, however, need not end with a single winner: at least one of two things is the case, and perhaps both at once — the new instructional program raised actual student achievement at the school, and irregularities in test administration inflated the school's reported scores.

The administrative consequences follow a separate logic, and the record on them admits of only one resolution: either no student's test scores at the school were invalidated, or the state invalidated the test scores of 142 students at the school. Exactly one of those outcomes occurred, and the two cannot both stand. Settling which one obtained requires the documentary trail of the agency's final determination rather than any further statistical modeling, which is why careful treatments of such episodes separate the measurement question from the question of what sanction was ultimately imposed.

artifacts.template:
Attribution in a contested breach begins with the authentication record itself, because the question of who signed on, from where, and by what mechanism is settled by machine-generated artifacts rather than by the parties' competing narratives. {{S1}} Windows Event ID 4625 records successful logons to a domain-joined host, and that coding cannot both be true alongside the assignment of successful logon recording to Event ID 4624; the two mappings rule each other out, so the examiner must determine which identifier the logs actually carry before any conclusion about remote access is drawn.

VPN concentrator logs showed the administrator account authenticating from an IP address allocated to a foreign hosting provider, which confirms the remote interactive character attributed to the session in the logon-type field. The same concentrator data also establishes the geographic finding: impossible-travel analysis flagged two successful logons to the same account from locations 6,000 kilometres apart within eleven minutes, a separation no traveller could cross in that interval.

{{S2}} Badge records placed the administrator off the premises at the time of the 40-gigabyte transfer; that is, the administrator was not physically present in the building when the data was copied out. That absence from the site stands in contrast with the USB device connection artifacts recovered from the workstation registry, which point instead to hands-on activity at the machine.

{{S3}} The administrator's absence from the building when the data left and the attribution of the removal to that departing administrator cannot both be true; the physical-access record rules out the vendor's version of events. What remains for the examiner is to show, from timeline reconstruction, which account was used and whether its use is consistent with a credentialed outsider operating over the concentrator.

{{S4}} Whereas the eighteen days of unobserved intrusion govern the allocation of contractual responsibility between the parties, the GDPR requires a controller to notify the supervisory authority within 30 days of becoming aware of a personal data breach, a period measured from awareness rather than from the moment of compromise. Disciplined forensic practice therefore settles the insider-versus-intruder question on artifact convergence, leaving the contractual and regulatory consequences to follow from the timeline so established.

artifacts.template:
Disputes of this kind are usually traced, in the modern literature, to a single terminological innovation: Bernard Williams introduced the phrase "moral luck" in a 1976 paper. Bernard Williams's paper on moral luck first appeared in the journal Ethics in 1998, a publication record that cannot both stand with the phrase having been coined in a paper of 1976, so one of the two datings must give way. Williams's contribution came first, and only afterwards was Thomas Nagel's essay "Moral Luck" reprinted in his 1979 collection Mortal Questions.

Two commitments organize the ensuing dispute. {{S1}} {{S2}} The control principle is accepted without dissent by contemporary moral philosophers, an unqualified consensus that cannot be squared with the recognition that outcomes lying beyond an agent's control do shape judgments of blame; the two cannot both be true.

The problem is not a recent invention. Book III of Aristotle's Nicomachean Ethics discusses voluntary action, ignorance, and culpability, anticipating by many centuries the modern treatment of culpable ignorance that came after it. {{S3}}

Restated in the idiom of law, that is precisely the principle by which negligence in tort law is assessed against a reasonable person standard of foreseeable risk; whereas quality of will accounts fix blame on the agent's motives, the tort standard sets motive aside and asks only what a reasonable person would have anticipated. Any such retrospective assessment, however, must reckon with a distortion in the assessors themselves. Hindsight bias leads evaluators to overestimate how predictable an outcome was before it occurred, and it is that inflation of predictability which made the harm foreseeable to a reasonably prudent agent at the time of the action. Adjudication therefore rests on a strict either/or: either the harm was foreseeable in just that way, or the harm was not foreseeable to a reasonably prudent agent at the time of the action, and exactly one of these must hold, never both at once. Deciding between the competing accounts of blameworthiness consists, in the end, in settling which of the two obtains.

Proximate cause limits a defendant's liability to harms within the scope of the risk created by the conduct. Although an intervening cause is an event that occurs after the defendant's negligent act and contributes to the plaintiff's injury, foreseeability is the principal test for determining whether an intervening cause is superseding. Any intervening act by a third party automatically severs the chain of proximate causation. A rule of automatic severance and a test that turns on the foreseeability of the intervening event cannot both govern the superseding-cause inquiry, for severance cannot at once be mechanical and contingent on what was foreseeable. The appellate court ruled that an intervening act severs a defendant's liability only when that act is unforeseeable, a holding that shows foreseeability to be the operative measure. Negligent medical treatment of an injury the defendant caused is treated as a foreseeable consequence of the original negligence, which further confirms that foreseeability is what decides whether a later event supersedes.

Where the parties' narratives diverge, the court's first task is to identify the candidate explanations of the physical sequence that the record will support. In the worksite collapse litigation, at least one of two conditions obtained, and perhaps both: the scaffolding at the worksite was improperly secured by the contractor, or the wind speeds during the storm exceeded the scaffolding's design limits. Each possibility carries a different legal consequence, since one locates the hazard in the defendant's own workmanship and the other in a force arriving from outside the enterprise.

The allocation of proof shapes how such a stalemate is broken. The plaintiff must prove causation by a preponderance of the evidence. The defendant bears the burden of disproving causation once negligence has been established. A plaintiff's obligation to carry causation by the greater weight of the evidence and a defendant's obligation to negate causation after negligence is shown cannot both attach to the same element of the claim; whichever party must persuade on causation, the other cannot simultaneously bear that risk of nonpersuasion. Put otherwise, the court determined that the plaintiff retained the burden of proving causation throughout the trial.

{{S1}} After summary judgment has been denied on that basis, trial courts resolve irreconcilable factual accounts by assessing the credibility of the competing witnesses. The practical consequence is that conflicting narratives of how an injury unfolded are rarely disposed of as a matter of law; they are settled by the factfinder's judgment about which version of events the testimony will bear.

Adjudicating between a design defect and improper field installation begins with the documentary record generated by the two parties whose workmanship is at issue. {{S1}} Those factory withstand tests were performed before the in-service failure that overtook the transformer while it was still within its contractual warranty period. Commercially the position is exclusive: either the unit was inside that period at the moment of failure, or the warranty period had expired before the transformer failed, and not both at once.

The technical investigation follows the physical evidence in the order in which it was laid down, the vacuum history recorded at commissioning preceding the gas history subsequently captured in the oil, and the two records are read in that sequence. {{S2}} Fixing that point of initiation in the de-tanked assembly is what produces the mechanical reading of the inner-winding damage, because the location of origin governs whether that damage is attributed to through-fault force. Karl Fischer titration measures the acetylene concentration in transformer oil.

{{S3}} The copper dust and the tilted conductors are in turn what demonstrates inadequate radial clamping to be the design-side mechanism in contention. IEEE C57.12.00 requires power transformers to withstand short-circuit current for ten seconds, and that requirement equally confirms that clamping adequacy falls to the designer rather than to the installer.

{{S4}} Deficient drying in the field operates on the installation side of the boundary; the dielectric clearances in the winding design, by contrast, were insufficient for the applied overvoltage. At least one of two faults is accordingly made out, and perhaps both: the clearance deficiency just identified, or field oil processing that left moisture in the cellulose insulation above the specified limit. In practice the dispute is settled where the damage morphology, the electrical records and the processing documentation converge on one mechanism and exclude the other.

artifacts.template:
Adjudication here begins from a descriptive baseline that neither side contests. Women earn roughly twenty percent of bachelor's degrees in computer science in the United States; in other words, about one in five recipients of a United States computer science bachelor's degree is a woman. What divides socialization-and-structure accounts from preference accounts is not that number but the causal machinery invoked to explain it, and each camp has staked its case on particular bodies of evidence.

The preference side's most cited cross-national result illustrates how fragile such stakes can be. Although Stoet and Geary (2018) reported a gender-equality paradox in STEM education, the standing of that report deteriorated badly under later reanalysis. Their published figures showed that the share of women among STEM graduates was higher in more gender-equal countries, a pattern that cannot be squared with the paradox they named, since the two characterizations of the same correlation cannot both be true. {{S1}} {{S2}} That failure to reproduce is what showed where the trouble lay: Psychological Science issued a correction determining that the original description of the STEM-propensity measure did not match the computation actually performed. The paper's bibliographic fate then admits of exactly two outcomes, one of which must hold while the other cannot: either the Stoet and Geary (2018) article was retracted in full by the journal, or it remained in the published literature with a correction attached.

{{S3}} Whereas that figure summarizes stated vocational interests pooled across inventories, Moss-Racusin and colleagues (2012), publishing three years after the Su synthesis appeared, found that science faculty rated a male-named applicant for a lab manager post as more competent than an identical female-named applicant. Their experiment equally yielded the result that faculty rated identically qualified male and female applicants as equally competent, and that even-handed verdict rules out the competence premium awarded to the male-named file; the two cannot both describe what the raters did.

The pattern across these literatures explains why specialists treat the question as unsettled rather than closed. Correlational cross-national work is only as strong as the construction of its propensity measures, and its evidential weight collapses when the computation cannot be recovered from the published description. Interest inventories establish robust average differences in what people say they want, but they cannot by themselves distinguish preferences formed under constraint from preferences formed freely. Audit experiments that hold credentials fixed bear directly on the structural claim, yet their results concern evaluation at a single career juncture rather than the whole pipeline. Adjudication therefore proceeds by triangulation and by scrutiny of measurement, with no single finding carrying the dispute.

J Harlen Bretz was a University of Chicago geologist who mapped the Channeled Scablands during the 1920s, and that long campaign of field mapping was finished well before he first laid his reading of the landscape before his colleagues. {{S1}} By contrast, Bretz's critics argued that the scablands were cut by ordinary river erosion acting over millions of years, holding that nothing in the region required a departure from the slow processes visible in modern valleys.

The Purcell Trench lobe of the Cordilleran Ice Sheet dammed the Clark Fork River to impound Glacial Lake Missoula, and the catastrophic failure of that ice barrier is what produced the colossal discharge now reconstructed for the scabland channels. Only well after that hostile Washington meeting did Joseph Thomas Pardee identify Glacial Lake Missoula in western Montana as the source of the floodwater. Giant current ripples up to about 15 metres high occur on the floor of the Camas Prairie basin in Montana; bedforms of that stature are built only beneath deep and swiftly moving water, so they cannot be squared with the view that ordinary rivers wore these channels down over millions of years.

Pardee published "Unusual Currents in Glacial Lake Missoula, Montana" in 1942. {{S2}} What anchors a figure of that order is the height to which the floods carried and abandoned their coarsest cargo: the elevation of such debris far above the channel floors is direct evidence that water of the reconstructed volume once filled these valleys to their brims. {{S3}}

Either the Channeled Scablands record only a single flood event, or they record more than one; one of the two must be the case, and both cannot be. The adjudication therefore turned, in the end, not on a preference for sudden over slow causes but on landforms—the ripple fields, the abandoned cataracts, the stranded boulders—whose dimensions only one class of process can produce.

artifacts.template:
Adjudication between structural and agency-centred accounts of democratic erosion rarely turns on a single decisive statistical test. It proceeds instead by specifying what each account predicts about timing, about the identity of the actors who move first, and about variation across comparable settings, and then asking which of those predictions the historical record will bear.

Steven Levitsky and Daniel Ziblatt attribute democratic breakdown to the failure of established elites to act as gatekeepers against authoritarian contenders. Ronald Inglehart and Pippa Norris argued that support for populist parties reflects cultural backlash more than economic insecurity. David Waldner and Ellen Lust published a review of the backsliding literature titled "Unwelcome Change" in the Annual Review of Political Science in 2018. Whereas Levitsky and Ziblatt place the decisive weight on what party leaders do or fail to do at the gate, Waldner and Lust found robust cross-national support for economic inequality as the primary driver of backsliding; and that cross-national verdict on inequality cannot be squared with the Inglehart and Norris conclusion that cultural rather than material insecurity animates the populist vote, for the two accounts of what moves those voters cannot both be true.

Process tracing is used by comparativists to test whether a hypothesised causal mechanism operated in a single case. Scholars use the sequencing of institutional changes relative to economic shocks as evidence for or against structural explanations. By contrast with process tracing's attention to the interior of one episode, paired comparison of countries with similar economic trajectories but divergent regime outcomes is used to isolate the role of elite choice.

Poland's Law and Justice party won the 2015 parliamentary election with more than 60 percent of the popular vote. After taking office that year, the government altered the composition and procedures of the Constitutional Tribunal, and this reworking of judicial appointment and procedure supplies strong confirmation for Nancy Bermeo's diagnosis of the characteristic form that erosion now takes. In Hungary, at least one of two things happened, and perhaps both: the electoral law was rewritten in ways that advantaged the incumbent governing party, or the public broadcasting apparatus came under the control of the governing party; the statute books put the second of those developments in exact terms. {{S1}} The resulting concentration of regulatory authority in partisan hands led the European Parliament to vote in September 2018 to initiate Article 7 proceedings concerning the rule of law in Hungary.

artifacts.template:
The quarrel over the Dark Ages was settled less by a single verdict than by a long reworking of the question, and its terms were set by Henri Pirenne. Pirenne attributed the rupture of Mediterranean trade networks to Arab expansion in the seventh century. His thesis held that the Germanic invasions of the fifth century ended Mediterranean economic unity, and these two datings of the break cannot both be true: a fifth-century terminus for Mediterranean unity rules out a terminus falling two hundred years later with the Arab conquests. Only after that thesis had been fully laid out did a second line of argument enter the field. {{S1}} {{S2}}

The documentary question is in part a matter of simple survival. At least one of two things holds, and perhaps both: the production of written documents declined in the post-Roman West, or large numbers of early medieval documents were destroyed in later centuries. Because the texts could not therefore be made to answer for themselves, the challenge mounted by those historians led directly to the adoption of methods that bypassed texts altogether, and radiocarbon dating allowed early medieval settlements to be dated without reference to written records.

Once material proxies entered the argument, the picture ceased to be uniform. Catalogued counts of Mediterranean shipwrecks fall sharply for the centuries after the fifth century; by contrast, Greenland ice cores show that lead pollution reached its ancient peak during the eighth century. Series of this kind measure different things, exchange in the one case and metallurgy in the other, and the discipline learned to weigh them separately rather than to assemble them into a single index of decline.

{{S3}} Dendrochronology supplies the chronological anchor, and here the evidence admits of exactly one of two readings: either European tree-ring sequences record sharply reduced growth in the 540s CE, that downturn being registered before the epidemic reached the imperial capital, or no tree-ring sequence records a growth downturn in the 540s CE at all. One of these two must hold of the rings, and they cannot both hold together. On the first reading the environmental and epidemiological records interlock closely, and it is that interlocking, rather than the silence of the chronicles, on which the modern verdict rests.

claims.text: Robin Warren observed curved bacteria in gastric biopsy specimens at Royal Perth Hospital in 1979.
Barry Marshall joined Warren's investigation of the gastric bacteria in 1981.
Prevailing medical opinion in the 1970s attributed peptic ulcers to stress and excess gastric acid secretion.
The stomach was widely believed to be too acidic for bacteria to colonize.
The bacterium was first successfully cultured in 1982 after culture plates were left to incubate for five days over an Easter holiday.
Warren and Marshall published letters in The Lancet in 1983 describing unidentified curved bacilli in the human stomach.

The dispute is adjudicated by asking what a given replication design is able to distinguish: a genuinely absent effect, on the one hand, from an effect that depends on conditions the original report never specified, on the other. The Reproducibility Project: Psychology attempted replications of 100 studies drawn from three psychology journals, and the arithmetic of its outcome admits of exactly one reading: either fewer than half of those 100 replications produced significant effects in the original direction, or at least half of them did, and precisely one of the two tallies is the correct description.

Thirty-six percent of the Reproducibility Project: Psychology replications produced statistically significant results in the same direction as the originals. After that figure entered the literature, Gilbert and colleagues published a commentary in Science in 2016 arguing that infidelities in replication protocols depressed the measured replication rate. Anderson and colleagues replied that the critique depended on unsupported statistical assumptions, a reply that rules out the attribution of the low rate to protocol infidelity: the infidelity diagnosis and the demonstration that it rests on unsupported assumptions cannot both stand. The 2016 commentary nevertheless had a lasting methodological consequence, since it drove the construction of multi-laboratory replication designs, which estimate between-site heterogeneity in order to test whether hidden moderators are operating.

{{S1}} Many Labs 2 concluded that cultural differences between participant samples accounted for most of the failed replications. The partial support recovered across those laboratories indicates that some of the original findings that failed to replicate were false positives. The attribution of most non-replications to cultural variation between samples, for its part, confirms that some replication attempts differed from the original studies in procedural details that affected the outcome. Spuriousness in an original result and procedural divergence in its replication are therefore not rival diagnoses between which a choice must be forced: at least one of the two holds in any given failure, and in a substantial share of cases both hold together.

Diagnosis in practice consequently rests on design rather than on dispute, through preregistered protocols vetted in advance by the original authors, many-site sampling, and explicit decomposition of variance into within-site and between-site components. The 2019 National Academies consensus report on reproducibility and replicability concluded that non-replication can stem both from deficiencies in the original study and from unrecognized differences in study conditions, even though the Registered Replication Report on ego depletion recovered a large effect matching the original estimate. The verdict of the decade is accordingly not the triumph of one explanation over the other but a division of labor between them, with the burden falling on whoever posits a moderator to name that moderator and measure its influence.

artifacts.template:
Where the generators and the network operator advance opposing accounts, the question is resolved not by aggregate statistics on the variability of wind and solar output but by reconstructing the disturbance second by second from fault recorders, protection event logs, high-speed SCADA telemetry and the performance standards each plant is registered to meet. Each party's narrative is then required to fit that reconstruction. {{S1}}

Resolving which mechanism was operative therefore begins with the condition of the network and the condition of the plant. At least one of two findings must hold, and conceivably both: the transmission towers were destroyed by tornado-strength winds, or the wind farms' low-voltage ride-through settings were configured below the required capability. The high-speed records then settle what the plant actually did. {{S2}} That rapid withdrawal of generation in turn left the Heywood Interconnector carrying more power than its design limit; that is, power flow on the Heywood Interconnector exceeded its rated capacity. Because the flow stood above the rating, the Heywood Interconnector to Victoria tripped after being overloaded.

{{S3}} The separation was itself brought about by the overloading and consequent trip of the interconnector, which is why investigators treat the interconnector's transfer limit, rather than resource variability as such, as the hinge of the cascade.

{{S4}} The blackout occurred on 14 February 2017. That finding of non-compliance with the registered standards resulted in the Federal Court imposing penalties exceeding 200 million dollars on the wind farm operators.

The methodological lesson is that intermittency and planning or protection deficiencies are distinguished by documentary evidence of what each element was configured to do and what it measurably did at each instant, not by the competing characterisations the parties bring to the inquiry.

artifacts.template:
Before an unusual grammatical feature shared by two languages can be credited to a common ancestor, the competing explanations have to be cleared away one by one, and each of them — inheritance, borrowing, universal tendency, accident — carries its own evidentiary burden. Chance resemblance is one of the explanations investigators must exclude before positing descent. The comparative method establishes genetic relationship through systematic sound correspondences across many lexical items. It is able to do so because basic vocabulary such as numerals and kinship terms is comparatively resistant to borrowing; that resistance is what yields the stable correspondence sets the method requires. Shared irregularities in inflectional paradigms are treated as strong evidence of common descent, since arbitrary morphological residue is improbable as an independent innovation.

A shared typological profile is by itself sufficient proof of genetic relatedness. Such sufficiency cannot be squared with the comparative method's insistence that relationship be demonstrated through systematic sound correspondences across many lexical items; the two standards of proof cannot both govern the practice. Grammatical features are never transferred between languages in situations of contact — a blanket exclusion that cannot be reconciled with what prolonged bilingualism demonstrably does to grammatical structure.

{{S1}} {{S2}} The Balkans confirm this contiguity-based reasoning: Balkan languages from different Indo-European branches share a postposed definite article. The distribution of that article across unrelated branches also indicates that the postposed definite article of the Balkan languages is reconstructed for Proto-Indo-European.

Retroflex consonants in Indo-Aryan languages, by contrast, have been attributed to a Dravidian substrate — an attribution that supplies evidence for the bilingual transmission of grammatical structure sketched above. Such substrate proposals were in circulation long before the field was equipped with explicit methodological controls on contact explanations. {{S3}} What tips the balance in an actual dispute is rarely a single feature, but the alignment of the sound correspondences, the morphological irregularities and the social history of the speech communities behind one hypothesis and not the other.

artifacts.template:
Attribution of acute liver injury to a newly started medication rests on a negative search rather than on any confirmatory test, because drug-induced liver injury is a diagnosis of exclusion. It is for precisely that reason that serological testing for hepatitis A, B, C, and E is performed to exclude viral causes of acute liver injury. In the case at hand the hepatitis E RNA assay admits of only two outcomes, and exactly one of them holds, not both: either the patient's hepatitis E RNA test was negative, or the patient's hepatitis E RNA test was positive. That same exclusionary requirement is what prompts clinicians to measure antinuclear antibody, anti-smooth muscle antibody, and serum IgG to evaluate for autoimmune hepatitis.

Once competing causes have been ranked, adjudication turns on the biochemical signature of the injury itself. {{S1}} Pattern assignment then narrows the field of plausible agents, since individual hepatotoxins carry characteristic signatures on liver biochemistry and on histology. {{S2}}

Severity grading follows pattern assignment and carries the greatest prognostic weight in the adjudication. {{S3}} In practice, a case satisfying that combination of thresholds prompts immediate withdrawal of the suspect agent and close biochemical observation.

Chronology does much of the remaining work. Biochemical improvement after withdrawal of the suspect drug is termed dechallenge and supports drug causality; only afterwards, and in current practice almost never by deliberate design, does the question of reexposure arise, recurrence of liver injury upon reexposure to the same drug being regarded as strong evidence of drug causation. Taken together, the fall in aminotransferases off the agent and their prompt return on renewed exposure show that the newly started medication was hepatotoxic in this patient. Drug hepatotoxicity and contributory liver disease are not competing verdicts here: at least one of the two accounts—the hepatotoxicity of the newly started medication in this patient, or the contribution of an underlying liver disease process to the acute liver injury—must be operative, and both may well be. Expert panels therefore record a probability grade rather than a verdict, and that grade is revised as the biochemical course unfolds.

artifacts.template:
Adjudication in this literature turns on a single inferential problem. Observational estimates of neighborhood effects are vulnerable to omitted-variable bias arising from residential selection, and it was precisely this defect in the observational record that prompted the field to mount randomized housing mobility designs. {{S1}} The demonstration randomized families in twelve metropolitan areas, which is why its results are read as speaking to urban contexts in general rather than to the peculiarities of a single city.

The competing accounts can be stated sharply enough to be tested. At least one of the following must hold, and perhaps both: families living in high-poverty neighborhoods have characteristics that independently depress their children's mobility, or residence in a high-poverty neighborhood causally reduces children's adult earnings. The entire task of the evidence is to apportion weight between these two possibilities, since the raw correlation between neighborhood poverty and downward mobility is equally consistent with either of them doing most of the work.

Raj Chetty, Nathaniel Hendren, and Lawrence Katz linked Moving to Opportunity children to adult tax records, a procedure that allowed earnings to be measured decades after the vouchers were issued. Either the experiment produced no detectable adult earnings gains for any group of children, or it produced detectable adult earnings gains for children who moved before age thirteen; exactly one of these descriptions can be correct, and the other must fail. The tax-record linkage establishes the second of them, showing that the experiment produced detectable adult earnings gains for children who moved before age thirteen. Chetty and colleagues found that earnings gains were concentrated among children who moved after age sixteen, a conclusion that the gains recorded for those who moved before thirteen rule out.

A second line of work rests on administrative data rather than on an experiment. Chetty and Hendren analyzed more than five million families who moved between commuting zones, and the earnings trajectories of their children indicate that each additional year of childhood spent in a higher-opportunity area raises a child's later earnings. In other words, the advantage of moving to a better neighborhood accumulates in proportion to the number of childhood years spent there. Because the gradient is estimated by comparing siblings who were different ages at the time of the same family move, its interpretation does not depend on contrasts between families who move and families who never do.

The methodological lesson drawn from both designs is the same: credible adjudication requires some source of variation in neighborhood exposure that is unrelated to the unmeasured attributes of parents, whether that variation comes from a lottery or from the differing ages of children within a single relocating household. Dose-response patterns in age at exposure now carry most of the evidentiary weight in the field, and descriptive comparisons across neighborhoods are treated as upper bounds rather than as estimates of place effects.

Attributing a collaborative-robot injury either to a sensing defect or to improper deployment begins with the normative framework against which both the machine and the installation are judged. {{S1}} ISO 10218 requires every collaborative robot to be surrounded by fixed physical fencing, a requirement that cannot be squared with the standing of power and force limiting as a recognized mode of collaborative operation, since a mode premised on permitted human contact and a mandatory barrier that excludes all contact cannot both be in force for the same machine.

Although the standards expressly contemplate power and force limiting as a legitimate way of running a cell, that permission does not by itself settle where responsibility lies, so the documentary trail left by each party has to be reconstructed. {{S2}} The investigation then compares what the machine was rated to do with what the installed task actually demanded of it.

{{S3}} After the controller's log has been retrieved, a pressure and force measurement device is used to reproduce the contact event at the incident location. The readings obtained in that reproduction show that the measured contact force exceeded the biomechanical limit for the worker's forearm.

The diagnostic fork turns on whether the protective function responded at all. Either the force-limiting function triggered a protective stop during the contact with the worker, or the force-limiting function triggered no protective stop during that contact; one of the two must be the case, and they cannot both be. A stop that fired, but only above the tabulated limit, directs attention to how the application was configured, whereas a contact that ran its course without any stop points to the sensing chain itself.

{{S4}} Where such drift has accumulated in the installed machine, the consequence is the second branch of the fork: the contact proceeds and no protective stop is triggered at all, a signature that separates a latent sensing fault from an aggressive but functioning configuration. Torque-based estimation of contact force is unaffected by errors in the declared payload mass — an immunity that cannot be squared with the derivation of external contact force from joint torque readings, since a misdeclared mass is carried directly into the torque balance and emerges there as spurious or vanished contact force. The apportionment of fault therefore rests on whether the trip threshold measured after the event corresponds to the threshold the installation was designed around.

artifacts.template:
When stylometric indicators and archival documents point toward different authors, scholars do not simply tally the two bodies of evidence against each other; they ask which has been properly controlled, and they test the weaker against the stronger. The contested case of the Funeral Elegy illustrates the procedure in detail. {{S1}} The Stationers' Register entry for the elegy names William Shakespeare as its author, and it was precisely because the documentary record carried that name that Donald Foster argued in a 1989 study that William Shakespeare wrote the elegy.

Subsequently Foster compiled a computerized database of Shakespeare's vocabulary called SHAXICON, designed to track the poet's lexical habits across his working career. Foster released SHAXICON as open-source software in 1996. Whereas the compilation of that database was an immense scholarly undertaking in its own right, the database was never made publicly available for independent verification; that permanent unavailability cannot be squared with an open-source release in 1996. The episode shows why adjudication turns on the auditability of quantitative evidence quite as much as on the results it yields.

The methodological demands of stylometry explain this asymmetry between the two kinds of proof. {{S2}} {{S3}} Without such a benchmark, a measured resemblance to one candidate remains uninterpretable, since the features in question may be no more characteristic of Shakespeare than of a dozen contemporaries writing in the same mode.

That requirement for a properly constituted control corpus led Foster to concede in 2002 that Shakespeare was not the author of the elegy. In other words, Foster publicly abandoned his claim of Shakespearean authorship of the elegy in 2002. His withdrawal confirms that William Shakespeare did not write the Funeral Elegy. At least one of that conclusion and the further proposition that John Ford did not write the Funeral Elegy must hold, and perhaps both do. Adjudication of such disputes therefore proceeds by subjecting each line of argument to the other's discipline: title pages and register entries are examined for what they can and cannot certify, while computational results are credited only when the underlying data and the comparative controls are open to re-examination by other hands.

artifacts.template:
Attributing a swath of structural damage to one mechanism rather than another is a forensic exercise, and when the public's first account of a funnel does not match what investigators find on the ground, the dispute is settled by the physical record rather than by recollection. The National Weather Service dispatches survey teams to inspect wind damage after severe thunderstorm events. Once those teams have reached the affected neighborhoods, they use aerial imagery and drone photography to map the geometry of damage paths, documenting the orientation of each fallen tree and displaced roof panel; only after that mapping is complete does the assignment of an intensity rating on the Enhanced Fujita scale take place. {{S1}}

{{S2}} By contrast, tornadic winds leave a convergent pattern of fallen trees and scattered debris, with material drawn toward a narrow axis instead of being flung away from a single point of impact. This difference in geometry, preserved in the orientation of debris for weeks after the event, is the most decisive diagnostic available to a survey team, because it records the direction of the wind at the moment of failure rather than an observer's impression of it.

{{S3}} The radar archive supplies a second and independent line of evidence: Doppler radar velocity data can show a rotational couplet of inbound and outbound winds near a tornado, and such volume scans are reexamined frame by frame against the timing of the damage. Eyewitness accounts of funnel clouds, on the other hand, are frequently unreliable in low-visibility or nighttime conditions, which is why survey teams treat them as the weakest element in the case file.

Even so, the testimony is not what settles the matter in the case at hand: the survey found that debris and trees fell inward toward the centerline of the damage path along the full length of the track. That is to say, the debris and treefall pattern along the damage track was convergent. Such inward convergence cannot be squared with the conclusion that the structural damage was produced by straight-line downburst winds; a track whose debris leans toward its own axis and an origin in spreading surface outflow cannot both be true of the same swath, so the mapped geometry, and not the first reports phoned in from the neighborhood, is what carries the determination in the final public statement.

artifacts.template:
The controversy is standardly framed as one between cognitivism and non-cognitivism about moral discourse. Cognitivism holds that moral judgments express beliefs, whereas non-cognitivism holds that moral judgments express conative states such as approval and disapproval. Adjudication accordingly turns on how moral utterance is to be characterized, and at least one of the following must hold, perhaps both: moral judgments express the speaker's beliefs about how things are; moral judgments express the speaker's desires or preferences, which is simply the non-cognitivist thesis put in other words.

A further question concerns the metaphysical commitments taken on by the fact-reporting side of the debate. Moral realism asserts that moral facts obtain independently of human attitudes; that is to say, on moral realism, whether a moral fact holds does not depend on what anyone approves of. The strength of the realist option is usually measured by whether such attitude-independent facts can be accommodated within a defensible account of the natural world.

The classical statement of the attitude-expressing view belongs to the logical positivist tradition. A.J. Ayer defended emotivism in Language, Truth and Logic. Ayer maintained that moral statements are literal descriptions of natural facts; yet an emotivist treatment of moral language and a construal of moral statements as literal descriptions of natural facts cannot both be correct, since a sentence whose function is to evince feeling is thereby ruled out as a description of how nature stands.

{{S1}} The embedding objection to expressivism was first formulated by Immanuel Kant; this origin cannot be squared with Geach's appeal to the Fregean separation of a sentence's content from the force of its utterance, for the objection cannot have been first framed in two such different settings. The requirement that expressivists supply meanings for moral sentences occurring inside conditionals and inside arguments led Simon Blackburn to develop quasi-realism, which is designed to earn the right to moral truth-talk within an expressivist framework.

A final consideration frequently taken to settle matters comes from the error-theoretic middle path, which concedes the surface grammar of moral discourse while denying that any moral property is instantiated. Either Mackie's error theory classifies moral judgments as truth-apt, or Mackie's error theory classifies moral judgments as lacking truth-aptness: one of these must be the correct description of the theory, and it cannot be both. How that question is answered determines whether the error theorist counts as an ally of the fact-reporting camp about the semantics of moral language while opposing it about moral metaphysics.

artifacts.template:
{{S1}} The RAPID array was deployed across 41°N in 1992, a deployment history that cannot be squared with the beginning of continuous monitoring at 26.5°N in April 2004; whatever the true chronology of the moorings, these two accounts of when and where the array entered the water cannot both be correct, and settling the question of trend versus variability depended on knowing which record was actually in hand.

{{S2}} The cable-based series across the Straits of Florida had already been accumulating for more than a quarter of a century before that winter's collapse in transport, so the extreme event arrived late in a much longer history of transport measurement rather than at its outset.

{{S3}} Although the reported rate of decline was steep enough to invite attention as a secular signal, the ten-year RAPID record was too short to distinguish a forced trend from natural variability; in other words, a decade of array measurements could not separate anthropogenic weakening from internal fluctuations.

Model experiments showed that a single decade of monitoring is sufficient to detect an anthropogenic overturning trend. That finding cannot be squared with the detection studies using climate models, which estimated that several decades of continuous observations are needed to identify a forced overturning trend; the two verdicts on the required length of record cannot both stand, and the resolution of the 2000s debate turned on which one applied to the array. The fact that the 2000s decline sits within the simulated spread of internally generated variability is what shows the 2009–2010 downturn to have reflected short-term variability rather than a long-term weakening trend, and precisely this reasoning led a review of the RAPID observations to that determination.

Whereas the array-based appraisal assigned the 2009–2010 event to short-term variability, the indirect reconstructions that reach beyond the instrumental era point instead toward a sustained, long-run decline of the circulation. {{S4}}

artifacts.template:
Adjudication between doctrinal and political explanations of a religious movement's expansion begins with the prior question of how fast, and along what curve, the movement actually grew. {{S1}} Applied backward from the fourth century, that figure indicates that Christians made up roughly ten percent of the Roman Empire's population by 300 CE.

The force of such a reconstruction depends on assumptions that must be made explicit before any causal verdict is reached. Either Stark's model applies a constant rate of growth across every decade of the period, or it applies a rate of growth that varies from decade to decade; one of the two must be the case, and they cannot both hold. Roman imperial census records supply direct annual counts of Christians across the provinces, and the existence of such direct enumeration cannot be squared with treating dated tombstones as the best available index of how far the movement had reached. {{S2}}

{{S3}} The documentary basis for weighing that thesis is the sequence of imperial measures themselves. Constantine granted Christian clergy exemption from compulsory civic obligations. The Edict of Milan of 313 CE made Christianity the official religion of the Roman Empire. The Edict of Thessalonica of 380 CE established Nicene Christianity as the official faith of the Roman Empire, an enactment that came decades after the clerical exemptions, and one that cannot both stand and allow the settlement of 313 to have already conferred official status on the religion.

By contrast with that legislated establishment, Manichaeism functions in the literature as a comparative case of a movement that expanded without durable imperial backing. Even granting the force of that comparison, the decisiveness that MacMullen ascribed to imperial favor after 312 is not thereby overturned, since the Manichaean diffusion was neither as rapid nor as institutionally entrenched as the Christian one. What settles disputes of this kind, then, is not the testimony of apologists or of hostile observers but the fit between a dated series of material remains and a model of growth whose parameters can be stated numerically and tested against the chronology of state action.

artifacts.template:
The controversy over the thylacine's demise turned on whether deliberate persecution by settlers or pressures already acting on the species carried the greater weight, and resolving it required a single shared chronology rather than rival anecdotes. The thylacine was a marsupial carnivore endemic to Tasmania at the time of European colonisation, an insular restriction that followed from its disappearance from mainland Australia approximately 3,000 years ago. Any credible attribution therefore had to account for an animal that entered the colonial period as an island endemic, with no continental reservoir from which local losses could be replenished.

Genomic sequencing of thylacine specimens revealed low genetic diversity predating European arrival. The sequencing drew on museum skins and skeletal material held in Australian and European collections, and the resulting portrait of the island population's genetic structure has become a fixed reference point in assessments of the species' resilience, since a narrow genetic base limits the variation available to any population confronting unfamiliar pressures.

The institutional record of persecution is unusually well documented. The Van Diemen's Land Company offered private bounties on thylacines from the 1830s, and only decades afterwards did the Tasmanian parliament introduce a government bounty, in 1888. Because that statutory scheme attached a standing cash value to every animal killed, it paid out 2,184 claims before it was discontinued in 1909. The Tasmanian bounty scheme paid out more than 15,000 claims, a total that cannot be squared with the 2,184 entered against the government scheme; the two tallies cannot both be true.

Settlement also reshaped the island's interior, and at least one of two consequences followed there: thylacine habitat in the Tasmanian Midlands was converted to sheep pasture, or prey availability for thylacines declined across the settled districts of Tasmania, and perhaps both held at once. Either consequence would have narrowed the margin within which a large carnivore could persist in the pastoral belt.

A distemper-like disease was reported among Tasmanian carnivores in the early twentieth century. {{S1}} Those early twentieth-century reports of sickness among the island's carnivores supplied the evidence on which the 2013 modelling study rested its conclusion that an introduced disease epidemic was the necessary primary driver of the extinction. The published assessment of the competing hypotheses determined that disease was not a necessary component of the extinction and identified bounty-driven hunting as the dominant cause, a determination that the population-viability modelling itself demonstrates; and that determination and the verdict that an epidemic was indispensable cannot both be true, so the attribution rests with the bounty campaign.
