artifacts.template:
Adjudication between genuine generalization and the memorization of contaminated data proceeds empirically: analysts build fresh evaluation items that cannot have been present in any training corpus, and then compare performance on those items with performance on the original benchmark. {{S1}} {{S2}} The logic of the design is straightforward, since a model that has internalized the underlying competence should transfer to new items of the same kind, whereas a model that has absorbed the original items should fall away once those items are replaced.

The outcome of that comparison is informative but heterogeneous. Although the full GSM1k dataset was publicly released at the time of the study to allow immediate replication, some model families showed accuracy drops of as much as 13 percentage points from GSM8K to GSM1k. Several frontier models, by contrast, showed little or no performance gap between the two sets. Every model evaluated in the GSM1k study scored identically on GSM8K and GSM1k, a uniformity that the observed double-digit declines rule out. Either every model evaluated in that study scored identically on the two sets, or at least one of them scored lower on GSM1k than on GSM8K: one of these situations obtains, and they cannot both obtain. The 13-point declines themselves show that at least one model evaluated in the GSM1k study scored lower on GSM1k than on GSM8K.

A second line of adjudication perturbs the original items rather than replacing them wholesale. {{S3}} Sensitivity of this kind to variation that leaves the required reasoning intact is what separates the execution of a learned procedure from the retrieval of a stored answer, and it gives the memorization hypothesis a measurable signature.

Attributing any such gap to contamination further requires specifying the channel by which the items reached the model. At least one of two routes is actual here, and perhaps both: the benchmark items entered the model through its pretraining corpus, and the benchmark items entered the model through its supervised fine-tuning data. Prophylactic measures were designed with exactly this in mind. BIG-bench embedded a canary string so that developers could exclude its data from training corpora, and that canary string guarantees that no benchmark data appears in any pretraining corpus. Yet a marker whose force rests on developers electing to filter on it cannot be squared with a guarantee that benchmark data is absent from every pretraining corpus, so the question of exposure remains an empirical one rather than one settled by design.

Taken together, held-out replication, symbolic perturbation and provenance analysis convert what looks like an interpretive quarrel into a set of measurements, with the size and pattern of the degradation across models serving as the decisive evidence.

artifacts.template:
Stratigraphic excavation records the vertical sequence of deposits exposed at a site, and when an object turns up beneath deposits that ought to be older than it, the rival readings are adjudicated against that record rather than against typology alone. {{S1}} Although the order in which deposits accumulate fixes which of them formed first, artifacts can enter older deposits through rodent burrowing and root channels, and that fact cannot be squared with any guarantee that an object remains in the layer where it was buried. In other words, the disturbance of sediments by plants and animals — termed bioturbation — is the mechanism that undoes an apparently tidy sequence.

The first task in the field is therefore to establish the geometry of the deposit around the find. At least one of two disturbances is present in the case at hand, and the two are not mutually exclusive: a rodent burrow cut through the deposit containing the artifact, or a later pit truncated that same deposit. Laboratory work extends the same logic to a finer scale. Soil micromorphology uses thin sections to detect disruption of sediment fabric around a find, and disturbed fabric in the few centimetres enclosing an object is the evidence that shows the object to be younger than the deposit holding it.

Two further lines of inquiry bear on the verdict. Sediment adhering to an artifact can be matched chemically against the matrix of the layer that contained it, a comparison carried out on the crusts and infillings still fixed to the piece. {{S2}} In other words, the object entered the layer after that layer had finished forming.

Whereas the chemistry of adhering sediment turns on the mineral material clinging to the find, radiocarbon analysis rests on an altogether different property of the associated remains. {{S3}} An intrusive object and a contemporaneous one leave different traces, and the excavator's task is to read which set of traces the deposit preserves. What settles the matter in any particular case is the convergence of these independent lines: the geometry of burrows and cuts, the fabric of the matrix in thin section, the chemical signature of adhering sediment, and the chronometric age of organics in secure association with the object.

artifacts.template:
The High-z Supernova Search Team published evidence in 1998 that distant Type Ia supernovae were fainter than expected, a conclusion resting on careful photometry of a few dozen explosions spread over a wide range of redshift. {{S1}} The 1998 measurements of excess faintness therefore show that the dimming of the distant supernovae arises from accelerating cosmic expansion. Caution was nonetheless warranted about what the photometry alone secured: either that acceleration is responsible, or the dimming arises in part from extinction by dust, with at least one of the two necessarily operating and conceivably both at once.

Ordinary interstellar dust reddens the light that it dims, imposing a pronounced wavelength dependence on the absorption it produces. Precisely because reddening accompanies absorption of this kind, both teams measured supernova colors to place limits on dust reddening along the line of sight, recovering rest-frame color information from observations in several photometric bands and comparing the colors of high-redshift events with those of well-studied nearby ones. The procedure converted a question about unseen absorbing material into a tractable comparison of apparent colors.

Gray dust was proposed as a hypothetical absorber that would dim supernovae without reddening them, a grain population weighted toward large particles and therefore nearly achromatic across optical wavelengths. Gray dust reddens supernova light more strongly than ordinary interstellar dust does. These two characterizations of the same grain population cannot both be true, for an absorber defined by the absence of a color signature cannot simultaneously impose a color signature exceeding that of ordinary grains.

Supernova 1997ff at redshift about 1.7 appeared brighter than gray-dust dimming models predicted, as a pervasive screen of absorbing grains should render the most remote objects progressively more opaque. Supernova 1997ff at redshift about 1.7 appeared fainter than any acceleration model allowed. The two readings of that single object's flux cannot be squared with each other, and one of them must be abandoned. The photometry of that exceptionally distant event was obtained before observations of supernovae beyond redshift one revealed an earlier epoch of decelerating expansion, a reversal in the expansion history that no intervening screen of absorbing material can imitate.

Either the 2011 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to Saul Perlmutter, Brian Schmidt, and Adam Riess, or no Nobel Prize in Physics has been awarded for the discovery of cosmic acceleration; exactly one of these two states of affairs obtains, since they cannot both hold and cannot both fail. The institutional record deserves precise statement, because the honors attached to a cosmological result are frequently reported in loose terms, and the standing of the acceleration measurement within the discipline is often inferred from them.

artifacts.template:
The skeleton catalogued LB1, excavated from Liang Bua on Flores and described in 2004, forced the question of species status almost as soon as it came out of the ground, since its dimensions lay far outside anything expected of a Late Pleistocene human. The Flores hominin stood about one metre tall; that is, its stature was estimated at approximately 106 centimetres.

Pathological readings of the find were advanced from several directions over the decade that followed. {{S1}} {{S2}} {{S3}}

Craniometry itself proved unstable under scrutiny. Later remeasurement revised LB1's endocranial volume upward to about 1,000 cubic centimetres, and a braincase of that capacity cannot be squared with the figure of roughly 417 cubic centimetres taken from the specimen; the two values cannot both be correct. The revised volume, sitting squarely inside the living human range, indicates that Jacob was right to read the specimen as a modern human affected by microcephaly.

{{S4}} That comparison showed that the shape of the LB1 endocast fell outside the range of microcephalic modern humans, and Falk and colleagues concluded precisely that. After that conclusion was published, a 2015 comparative study of the Liang Bua dentition determined that the teeth showed no signs of pathology and that the Down syndrome diagnosis was unsupported.

The molecular and postcranial lines of evidence pull in opposite directions. Mitochondrial DNA extracted from an LB1 molar fell within the range of modern human variation, whereas the LB1 skeleton possesses wrist bone morphology absent in modern human populations. At least one primitive configuration marks the skeleton beyond dispute: that wrist pattern, or a shoulder and clavicle morphology equally absent in modern human populations, and perhaps both. The adjudication rested, in the end, on the architecture of the bones rather than on diagnosis by analogy with pathology.

artifacts.template:
Adjudication begins not with the structure but with the question of who is entitled to ask. {{S1}} The National Transportation Safety Board holds sole statutory jurisdiction over bridge construction collapses, a position that cannot be squared with the opening of a workplace-safety inquiry into the very same failure, and the unresolved conflict governs which records and witnesses the investigators can compel.

The technical question is narrowed by the loading condition obtaining at the moment of failure. Freshly placed concrete transfers its full weight to the temporary falsework supporting the deck, and that transfer of load caused the falsework to fail while the placed concrete was still in a plastic state. Cast-in-place concrete, by contrast, attains its full design compressive strength within 72 hours of placement. The competing hypotheses therefore concern the adequacy of the temporary works as designed and their fidelity as actually erected.

The allocation of responsibility for those temporary works follows the contract rather than intuition. The contractor was responsible for designing the temporary falsework for the deck pour, whereas the engineer of record reviewed the falsework submittals for conformance with the contract documents. A deficiency in shoring is accordingly not, by itself, a defect in the permanent design, and the forensic task is to locate the deficiency with enough precision to assign it to one party or the other.

ACI 347 provides recommended practice for the design of concrete formwork and shoring. The inquiry then moved to the site itself. Forensic engineers compared the as-erected shoring layout to the approved falsework drawings, and only after that field comparison was complete did the laboratory and analytical phase of the work begin. Dimensional survey of the wreckage, erection photographs and the inspector's daily reports are the ordinary materials of such a comparison.

{{S2}} {{S3}} That recalculation showed how little reserve the temporary works possessed in their as-built configuration, and on the strength of it the board of inquiry concluded that the collapse resulted from a construction deviation and not from an inadequate falsework design. The reasoning is instructive for the general case: design error and construction deviation are separated not by opinion but by the measurable gap between the geometry that was approved and the geometry that stood on the day of the pour.

artifacts.template:
The question was settled by two complementary experimental strategies: a biological transformation assay in bacteria combined with enzymes of defined substrate specificity, and radioisotopic tracing of the molecules that enter a host cell during infection. In both programmes the logic was subtractive, in that the candidate molecule whose destruction destroys biological activity, and whose atoms enter the cell, is the one that carries the information.

Before 1944, proteins were widely regarded as the most likely carriers of heredity. That expectation resulted directly from Phoebus Levene's tetranucleotide hypothesis, which depicted DNA as a monotonous repeating structure. {{S1}} Sixteen years after that report of 1928, Oswald Avery, Colin MacLeod and Maclyn McCarty published their identification of the pneumococcal transforming principle in 1944; by contrast with the protein-centred consensus that had dominated the field, their identification located the hereditary activity in a different class of molecule altogether.

The decisive step in the pneumococcal system was enzymatic rather than purely chemical, since purification alone leaves trace contaminants in dispute. Either the transforming activity of the pneumococcal extract survived treatment with protein-digesting enzymes, or that activity was destroyed by treatment with protein-digesting enzymes: exactly one of these two outcomes is the case, and they cannot both obtain. Treatment with deoxyribonuclease abolished the transforming activity of the pneumococcal extract. Avery, MacLeod and McCarty identified ribonucleic acid as the pneumococcal transforming principle. The destruction of activity by an enzyme that cleaves deoxyribonucleic acid and nothing else cannot be squared with an identification of the transforming principle as ribonucleic acid, and rules that identification out.

A second and independent line of attack used bacteriophage, where the protein coat and the nucleic acid core can be tagged with different isotopes and then physically separated by blending and centrifugation. The Hershey-Chase experiment labelled bacteriophage DNA with phosphorus-32. The Hershey-Chase experiment labelled phage nucleic acid with carbon-14. A phosphorus-32 tag on the phage DNA excludes a carbon-14 tag on that same phage nucleic acid, because the two labelling schemes cannot both have been the one applied to the molecule under test.

Most of the phosphorus-32 radioactivity was recovered inside the infected bacterial cells rather than in the stripped coats left outside them. That partition of the isotope between host cytoplasm and discarded protein shell shows that DNA is the molecule that carries hereditary information in cells; in other words, the genetic material of cells is deoxyribonucleic acid. The force of the result lies in its quantitative character: the material that directs the production of progeny particles is the material that physically enters the cell, and that material is traced by the phosphorus label.

artifacts.template:
Silent data corruption refers to a computation producing an incorrect result with no error reported by the hardware, and that is exactly the category into which the episode falls: the miscomputation was a silent data corruption — in other words, the data was corrupted without any error being signalled by the machine. Against that picture of a failure that announces itself nowhere in the logs stands the protection offered by ECC memory, which corrects double-bit errors within a single DRAM word.

Because the corruption occurred with no signal from the machine, this indicates that the machine contained a defective hardware component. The program contained a latent software defect as well, so at least one of the two faults — a bad part in the machine or a dormant bug in the code — was responsible, and perhaps both were. Adjudication accordingly begins with repeatability, and here the record admits only two mutually exclusive possibilities: either the incorrect result never recurred on the original machine, or it recurred when the job was re-run on that same machine; one of these must be the case, and they cannot both be.

{{S1}} That the wrong answer returned when the job was re-run on the original machine confirms that defective CPU cores fail deterministically on every repetition of the same workload. A result that never returns on the original machine, by contrast, is evidence of nondeterminism internal to the program's own execution rather than of silicon that misbehaves identically each time.

{{S2}} {{S3}} Taken together, these instruments convert an unreproducible wrong answer into a tractable object of investigation. The identical binary is exercised on a second socket and a third, so that a fault confined to one part of the fleet separates itself from one that travels with the code; the suspect execution is captured and replayed under fixed inputs, so that a defect in the program must reappear if it is there at all; and the arithmetic is audited stage by stage until the first divergence is pinned to a particular kernel or a particular device. Where replay reproduces the error with every input held constant, the weight of evidence falls on the program. Where the same binary and the same recorded inputs diverge only on one machine, and the vendor's errata or margin tests corroborate the finding, the weight falls on the part.

artifacts.template:
Spatial pattern is the first thing a field diagnostician reads in a declining crop. Pathogen-caused decline typically appears in discrete patches that expand along planting rows over successive weeks, whereas nutrient deficiency symptoms appear uniformly across soil zones of similar texture and topography. Nutrient deficiencies spread from plant to plant through contact with soil water, a mode of transmission that cannot be reconciled with an even expression of symptoms wherever soil texture and topography are alike.

Diagnosticians split the taproot and lower stem of affected plants to examine the vascular tissue for discoloration. Foliar morphology is read alongside such internal inspection: potassium deficiency in soybean produces chlorosis and necrosis along the margins of upper leaves, and potassium deficiency produces dark necrotic fungal lesions on the soybean taproot, a root pathology that cannot be squared with a mineral disorder whose expression is confined to marginal scorch of the leaf. Laboratory support is assembled in parallel with the field examination. The soil test reported exchangeable potassium levels for the affected area of the field. Sectioning of the taproots and lower stems showed that Fusarium virguliforme was present in the root tissue of the declining plants, and the reported exchangeable values indicated that soil potassium in the affected area was below the critical level for soybean. At least one of those two conditions obtained in that part of the field, fungal colonization of the roots or a sub-critical potassium supply, and perhaps both obtained together.

Culture work on the symptomatic tissue yields a result that admits no middle ground. Either no plant pathogen was isolated from the symptomatic root tissue, or at least one plant pathogen was isolated from it; one of the two outcomes must be the case, and the two cannot hold together. Which outcome the plates deliver determines whether the investigation proceeds to inoculation work or turns instead to the fertility program and the soil chemistry of the site.

When growers and agronomists advance opposing accounts, the matter is settled by moving from correlation to demonstrated causation under controlled conditions. {{S1}} On the strength of that reproduction of field symptoms under controlled inoculation, the extension diagnostic review board concluded that the decline was caused by Fusarium virguliforme rather than by potassium deficiency. A ruling of this kind carries weight because it rests on an agent that was both recovered and shown to reproduce the disorder in healthy plants.

artifacts.template:
Adjudication between the two accounts begins with the structure of the data brought to bear. Researchers link individual students' test scores across consecutive years to measure gains for the same children. Student-level longitudinal records cannot distinguish compositional change from instructional improvement; this limitation cannot be squared with a design that follows the identical pupils from one year to the next, since holding the roster of tested children fixed is precisely what such linkage accomplishes, and the two characterizations cannot both stand. {{S1}}

{{S2}} By contrast, the year-to-year linkage of individual pupils' scores keeps the same children in view and is therefore not exposed to that confounding, which is in any case brought about by the exemption-driven lift in measured averages described above. Retaining low-performing students in grade lowers the average score of the tested grade — an outcome that cannot be squared with the removal of those students from the tested cohort, because children who are absent from the tested group cannot pull its average down.

External benchmarks supply a second line of attack, since a school's own instrument is the very thing in question. The National Assessment of Educational Progress carries no accountability consequences for individual schools. {{S3}} It is precisely because that assessment imposes no consequences on any individual school that a divergence between the two sets of results can be read as inflation rather than as ordinary measurement noise.

Attrition records provide a third source of leverage, because any account resting on composition must show where the missing test-takers went. {{S4}} Whereas the national assessment reaches a representative sample of the student population, the dropout counts scrutinized by the Texas auditors were those the Houston district itself generated.

What ultimately settles the matter is the within-cohort test, which holds the set of children constant and lets the instructional claim stand or fall on its own. The measured gains vanished when the analysis was limited to students enrolled in both years; that is, restricting the sample to continuously enrolled students eliminated the school's apparent improvement. That result leaves the instructional account with nothing left to explain: once the children whose presence in the tested group had changed are set aside, there is no upward movement remaining to be attributed to better teaching, and the compositional reading is the one the evidence sustains.

artifacts.template:
The dispute at the centre of contemporary metaethics can be stated in a sentence. Moral realism holds that moral judgments describe objective moral facts; expressivism, by contrast, holds that moral judgments express the speaker's non-cognitive attitudes. Shorn of its technical apparatus, the realist thesis is simply that moral judgments report facts about the world, and the terms of the disagreement ensure that at least one of that thesis and the competing claim that moral judgments express the attitudes of the speaker who utters them must be correct, perhaps both together. Adjudication therefore turns on which side can accommodate everything that moral language is observed to do.

Most of the pressure on the expressivist side arises from its semantic commitments. Since expressivism construes a moral verdict as the voicing of an attitude rather than the description of a state of affairs, it issues in non-cognitivism, which denies that moral sentences are truth-apt; in other words, on non-cognitivism moral utterances are incapable of being either true or false. That very incapacity generated the best-known objection to the programme. {{S1}}

The realist camp has a repertoire of tests of its own, directed at the semantics of moral predicates rather than at the logic of embedded moral claims. {{S2}} Neither tradition, however, yields a verdict from the armchair. Where the question is answered at all, it is answered about particular utterances in particular settings, by asking whether the words as used were verifiable, how a reasonable audience would have taken them, and what the surrounding context implied.

The law of defamation supplies the clearest example of such a case-by-case ruling, since there the difference between fact-stating and attitude-expressing speech carries practical consequences. Michael Milkovich sued the Lorain Journal over a column concerning his testimony at a hearing. The suit came first; the ruling that resolved it followed afterwards. {{S3}} Cutting against any blanket shield for opinion, the Court determined that the disputed passage in the column implied an assertion of objective fact about Milkovich's testimony, a claim about his veracity capable of being proved or disproved. What settled the question was thus not the label borne by the utterance but its content: a sentence that purports to say how things stood is fact-stating, however it is dressed.

S1.para2: Because the Frege-Geach problem presses expressivists to explain the behaviour of moral terms embedded in conditionals, Simon Blackburn developed quasi-realism in order to account for the apparently factual surface of moral discourse.
S1.para3: Simon Blackburn developed quasi-realism to account for the apparently factual surface of moral discourse, and what brought that response about was the Frege-Geach problem, which presses expressivists to explain the behaviour of moral terms embedded in conditionals.

artifacts.template:
The dispute is, at bottom, about how many maxima and minima lie between reactants and products on the reaction coordinate. A concerted mechanism proceeds through a single transition state. A species, by contrast, must persist longer than a single bond vibration of about 10^-13 seconds to qualify as a genuine intermediate, so the whole question turns on lifetimes rather than on bookkeeping.

Kinetics alone is a weak arbiter here, and the reason is algebraic. Steady-state treatment of a stepwise pathway can reproduce the same rate law as a concerted pathway. A first-order rate law in substrate establishes that a reaction is concerted, a diagnosis that cannot be squared with the fact that the stepwise scheme, once the steady-state approximation is applied to it, yields an expression of exactly the same form. That same equivalence of rate expressions shows that the editorial review board ruled correctly when it held that the observed first-order rate law does not establish a concerted pathway. The mechanistic question itself admits only two answers: either the transformation passes through a discrete intermediate of finite lifetime, or the transformation passes directly from reactants to products through one transition state, and exactly one of these must hold. Isotopic substitution supplies sharper leverage. The measured ratio kH/kD for the reaction was 6.5, a figure obtained well before the review board issued its ruling on the rate law; that is to say, replacing the transferred hydrogen with deuterium slowed the reaction by a factor of 6.5. A retardation of that magnitude confirms a more general diagnostic principle, namely that primary kinetic isotope effects measured at two different positions of one substrate indicate that both bonds change in a single step. Secondary kinetic isotope effects, by contrast, are always larger in magnitude than primary kinetic isotope effects.

Stereochemistry furnishes a probe of a different character, since it reports on the geometry of whatever species intervenes rather than on the arithmetic of rates. {{S1}} A substrate bearing a stereogenic reacting center is therefore among the most informative things an experimentalist can put into the flask.

Where inference from rates and labels still leaves the choice open, the remedy is to look for the putative species directly on the timescale on which it would have to live. Femtosecond transient absorption spectroscopy detects intermediates with lifetimes of a few picoseconds. An assignment that rests on direct observation of a transient absorption, rather than on the form of a rate law, is the one chemists regard as settled.

artifacts.template:
A defendant's claim that a confession was coerced, met by the prosecution's insistence that it was freely given, is not a question the jury answers in the first instance; it is a mixed question of law and fact for the judge, resolved before the statement is ever offered as proof of guilt. {{S1}} That procedure is the ordinary vehicle for such a dispute, since it allows the court to take live testimony and make findings without exposing the jury to evidence that may ultimately be excluded.

{{S2}} That appellate check belongs to a later stage of the litigation, coming only after the trial court has held its hearing and settled the facts on the record. Jackson v. Denno was decided by the Supreme Court in 1974, a date that cannot be squared with the 1964 ruling that imposes the duty of independent judicial determination, since a single decision cannot have issued in two different years.

{{S3}} The defendant bears the burden of proving by clear and convincing evidence that his confession was coerced; such an allocation cannot be squared with placing on the prosecution the obligation to establish voluntariness, because the risk of non-persuasion on one and the same issue cannot rest simultaneously on both sides of the case. The governing inquiry looks to the totality of the circumstances: the duration and conditions of custody, the suspect's age, intelligence and prior experience with the police, and the methods the interrogators actually employed.

{{S4}} The detectives' account was offered long after the interrogation itself, a session flawed in at least one of two ways and perhaps in both: the officers failed to administer Miranda warnings before questioning the defendant, or the defendant's purported waiver of his rights was not knowing and intelligent. Weighing testimony of this kind, the judge resolves the credibility conflicts, makes express findings, and states the legal basis of the ruling so that the record is adequate for later scrutiny.

The ruling then dictates what the jury may consider, and exactly one of two states of affairs can obtain: either the jury heard the defendant's confession at trial, or no part of the defendant's confession was presented to the jury; one of those must be the case, and the two cannot both hold. Where the statement survives, the defendant remains free to attack its reliability and the circumstances of its making before the jury; where it is suppressed, the prosecution must build its case from untainted evidence alone.

artifacts.template:
Apportioning responsibility for a transformer failure between the solid insulation and the network requires evidence independent of either party's commercial interest. The utility attributed the failure to a manufacturing defect in the winding insulation, whereas the equipment supplier attributed the failure to a switching transient originating on the utility's network. The investigative task is thus to determine whether the damage accumulated internally over years of service or was imposed from outside within microseconds.

The first line of enquiry is chemical. {{S1}} Acetylene in transformer oil is produced by the low-temperature oxidation of cellulose, and that account of its origin cannot be squared with reading an elevated acetylene concentration as the signature of a high-energy arc; one of the two readings must be given up.

Whereas the gas record points to a high-energy arcing fault, the condition of the solid insulation speaks to slow thermal ageing: the average degree of polymerisation of the winding paper had fallen to 250. That is to say, the cellulose chains in the winding paper had degraded to a mean length of 250 monomer units. New kraft insulating paper has a degree of polymerisation of approximately 200, and that figure cannot be reconciled with treating a mean chain length of 250 monomer units as the product of degradation in service.

The external hypothesis is tested on the network side of the terminals, where the relevant evidence is electrical rather than chemical. {{S2}} {{S3}}

A further and largely independent check is available at the station itself. Surge arresters fitted with operation counters record the number of discharge events. For the unit in question, either the counter registered no operations in the month preceding the failure, or it registered at least one operation in that month; one of these two states of the record must obtain, and they cannot both obtain. The transient overvoltages placed on the connected network by capacitor-bank energisation brought the latter about. Taken together, the oil chemistry, the paper condition, the reconstructed terminal overvoltage and the arrester record allow the engineer to assign the failure to the party whose equipment or operating practice the physical evidence actually implicates, rather than to the party with the weaker contractual position.

artifacts.template:
Adjudicating between discrimination and occupational sorting is a problem with a long methodological pedigree. The Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition was introduced in 1973; half a century later, Claudia Goldin was awarded the 2023 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences for work on women's labour market outcomes.

Occupational and industry segregation accounts for a substantial share of the explained component in United States wage decompositions, as the unequal distribution of men and women across occupations in the labour market shows. At least one of two mechanisms is at work in generating the aggregate differential, and perhaps both: the unequal allocation of the sexes across occupations, or pay setting that rewards women less than comparable men at one and the same employer. Segregation operates between jobs and can be read off the composition of employment; by contrast, employers pay women less than men holding the same job within the same establishment, which lodges part of the differential inside the firm itself.

The experimental literature enters at precisely this point. {{S1}} {{S2}} Administrative payroll records, by contrast, observe only workers who were hired, producing a selection problem for inferences about discrimination. Confinement to realised hires cannot be squared with any account on which firm-level pay-setting differentials exhaust the gender pay gap.

{{S3}} The working resolution is therefore sequential rather than adversarial: experimental estimates discipline what happens at the point of entry, decompositions of payroll data bound the within-establishment component, and neither body of evidence serves as the arbiter of the other.

The historical record narrows the field further. Either the unexplained component of the United States gender pay gap has narrowed since 1980, or it has remained unchanged or widened since 1980 — one of these two holds of the historical series, and not both — and which of them obtains governs how much weight an account of the gap can place on sorting rather than on unequal treatment of equally productive workers.

artifacts.template:
The Cretaceous–Paleogene crisis is among the most severe events in the fossil record: about 75 percent of species on Earth died out at the transition; put differently, roughly three-quarters of Earth's species were wiped out at the end of the Cretaceous. Adjudication between the rival explanations proceeded by testing each against independently datable physical markers in the boundary interval. Luis Alvarez and colleagues reported an anomalous iridium enrichment at the Cretaceous–Paleogene boundary in 1980.

The provenance of that enrichment was itself a matter of contention in the early literature. The iridium anomaly was first measured in boundary clay near Gubbio, Italy. The iridium anomaly was first identified within the lava flows of the Deccan Traps — an account that cannot be squared with the Gubbio measurement, since a single first detection cannot have been made both in a marine boundary clay in the Apennines and in a basalt flow in western India. The geochemical interest of the element itself rests on a simple distribution: iridium is scarce in Earth's crust and comparatively abundant in meteoritic material.

The Chicxulub crater lies buried beneath the Yucatán Peninsula in Mexico. Impact glass spherules from boundary deposits in Haiti were dated to about 66 million years ago, and that determination confirms the presence of the buried crater beneath the Yucatán, since the glass can only have been quenched from melt thrown out of such a structure at that moment in the stratigraphic record.

Timing became the decisive criterion, because a cause cannot postdate its effect. Radiometric dating placed the Chicxulub impact roughly 300,000 years after the extinction horizon. A 2013 argon-argon geochronology study ultimately determined that the Chicxulub impact and the extinction horizon are synchronous to within 32,000 years; an offset of three hundred millennia and a coincidence this tight cannot both be true, and the argon-argon calibration rules out the later placement of the collision. The atmospheric consequences of the collision were severe in at least one of two respects, perhaps in both: the impact lofted soot and dust from global wildfires into the upper atmosphere, or it injected sulfate aerosols into the stratosphere. Set against that stratospheric aerosol loading, and against a coincidence tight to within a few tens of thousands of years, the volcanic case invoked a different inventory of gases and a far slower mechanism of killing. {{S1}}

The weight of the settlement therefore lies with chronology and with the geochemical fingerprint of extraterrestrial material, since only a cause demonstrably coincident with the boundary, and marked by an element foreign to crustal rocks, can account for a biotic collapse of that magnitude at precisely that level in the section.

artifacts.template:
Adjudicating between agency-centered and structure-centered explanations of a particular democratic breakdown begins with a careful statement of what each tradition actually claims. {{S1}} By contrast with this attention to what leaders decide and to what polarized electorates will excuse, structural accounts treat elite decisions as constrained by prevailing economic conditions. Carles Boix's Democracy and Redistribution, in arguing that economic inequality shapes the survival of democratic regimes, supplies the evidence that shows such constraint to be operative. Boix's verdict cannot be squared with Acemoglu and Robinson's Economic Origins of Dictatorship and Democracy, which concluded that economic inequality is irrelevant to regime transitions; one or the other of those two results must be mistaken.

{{S2}} How much weight such findings carry in any single case, however, depends on whether income thresholds are read as genuine ceilings on elite discretion or merely as a compact summary of past regularities.

Levitsky and Ziblatt's How Democracies Die was published in 2008. Well after Lipset's 1959 intervention, Nancy Bermeo's 2016 Journal of Democracy article "On Democratic Backsliding" distinguished promissory coups from executive aggrandizement, giving analysts categories fine enough to specify what exactly stands in need of explanation. Later still, Stephan Haggard and Robert Kaufman's 2021 book Backsliding examines contemporary episodes of democratic erosion, and the sequence of these contributions marks a steady narrowing of the object of study.

{{S3}} Because autocratization episodes can now be delimited and dated one by one, research designs have been driven toward strategies that join statistical breadth to the close inspection of particular breakdowns. {{S4}}

The upshot is that adjudication rarely ends in the outright victory of one tradition over the other. The competing accounts are more often assigned to different levels of the same explanation: economic conditions fix the range of outcomes available to a given polity, while the conduct of incumbents, oppositions and electorates determines which of those outcomes is realized. The decisive test, accordingly, is whether an account can identify work that its preferred variable does and the rival variable cannot, in the specific episode under dispute rather than in the abstract.

artifacts.template:
Where an operator and a fabricator advance incompatible accounts of a vessel failure, engineers resolve the dispute by reconstructing the event from physical and process evidence rather than by weighing assertions against one another. The vessel ruptured while in service at the operator's plant, and the violence of that rupture killed two workers. Either that fatal outcome is what occurred or no workers were injured in the rupture; one of the two must be the case, and they cannot both be. The operator attributed the rupture to a welding defect introduced during fabrication, whereas the fabricator attributed the rupture to operation above the vessel's design pressure.

Neither account is decisive on its own, so the inquiry turns first to evidence that could only be gathered after the vessel had burst. {{S1}} {{S2}}

Two general propositions about laboratory practice govern how a surface of this kind is read, and they must be stated before any conclusion is drawn from it. Cleavage fracture surfaces display striations whose spacing records the number of pressure cycles endured. Charpy V-notch testing measures the rate of fatigue crack growth in weld metal, a proposition that cannot be squared with the fracture morphology recorded at the initiation site; the two readings of that surface cannot both stand.

{{S3}} The computed stresses are then compared with the vessel's design basis and with the as-built quality of its seams. On the strength of the full record, at least one of two conditions obtained, and perhaps both: the longitudinal seam weld contained a lack-of-fusion flaw created during fabrication, and the vessel was operated at a pressure above its maximum allowable working pressure. The hour-by-hour trace retrieved from the control system archive is what establishes the second of these conditions.

Only once the initiation site, the fracture mode and the service history have been fixed in this way can responsibility be apportioned between the shop and the plant. Where a fabrication flaw and an overpressure excursion coexist, the engineering question becomes which of them would have been sufficient alone, and that question is settled by comparing the critical flaw size calculated for the measured stress with the dimensions of the flaw actually present, not by the narrative either party prefers.

artifacts.template:
The controversy over the Reichstag fire shows in miniature how historians weigh rival reconstructions of an event whose documentary trail is broken and partisan. The Reichstag building in Berlin was set on fire on the night of 27 February 1933. {{S1}} {{S2}}

{{S3}} Tobias argued that van der Lubbe was the sole perpetrator of the arson; that is, his thesis was that no person other than van der Lubbe set the Reichstag alight. Set against that 1962 study, by contrast, was the work of Walther Hofer, who convened an international committee of historians that argued for Nazi complicity in the fire. Van der Lubbe had accomplices in setting the Reichstag fire, a finding that cannot be squared with the contention that nobody but he put a torch to the building.

Adjudication between such accounts is not a matter of preferring the more dramatic story, nor of counting heads among specialists. Historians apply source criticism to test the authenticity, provenance and internal consistency of documents. They treat testimony recorded decades after an event as weaker evidence than contemporaneous records, since recollection decays and late statements are shaped by the very controversies they enter.

A sworn 1955 statement by the SA member Hans-Martin Lennings came to light in 2019 in the records of the Hanover public prosecutor's office. Although a deposition set down so long after the night in question carries less evidential weight than a paper drawn up at the time, Lennings's statement asserted that he had driven van der Lubbe to the Reichstag building that night, and that assertion is what demonstrates that the arsonist had the helpers described above. A find of this kind does not merely add a footnote to the prevailing reading; it redistributes the burden of proof, so that the lone-arsonist reconstruction must now be defended rather than assumed, and the consensus that had settled around it is reopened for argument.

artifacts.template:
Localisation of acute weakness begins at the bedside, where the distribution of the deficit and its accompanying symptoms are catalogued before any instrument is applied. Myopathic weakness predominantly affects proximal limb-girdle muscles such as the shoulders and hips; neuropathic weakness, by contrast, is frequently accompanied by sensory symptoms such as numbness or tingling. The laboratory stage of the assessment then rests on two techniques with quite different targets. Nerve conduction studies measure the conduction velocity and response amplitude of peripheral nerves, whereas needle electromyography records electrical activity arising within muscle fibres.

Interpreting the conduction data demands care about what a slow velocity actually signifies. Demyelinating neuropathies produce marked slowing of nerve conduction velocity. Nerve conduction velocity is markedly slowed in primary muscle disease; this cannot be squared with the attribution of marked slowing to loss of the myelin sheath along the nerve trunk, and the two accounts of the origin of slowing cannot both be true. The resolution of that tension governs how any velocity figure is reported in a weakness workup.

The needle examination of the weak limb supplied the decisive waveforms in the case under discussion. Electromyography recorded small, short-duration motor unit potentials. Motor unit action potentials in myopathy are characteristically large in amplitude and long in duration, a characterisation that the small, short potentials obtained at the needle rule out, since a single myopathic process cannot generate both profiles at once. {{S1}} Subsequently, the consulting neuromuscular specialist attributed the patient's sudden weakness to primary muscle disease, and the small, short-duration potentials on needle examination stand as the evidence for that attribution, indicating a fault within the muscle fibre itself.

Settling the disagreement fell to tissue rather than to waveform. Either the muscle biopsy specimen contained no inflammatory cell infiltrate, or the muscle biopsy specimen contained an inflammatory cell infiltrate: exactly one of these two states of the sampled tissue holds, and there is no third option. The specialist panel's final report determined that the muscle biopsy showed an inflammatory cell infiltrate — that is, the report asserts the second of those two possibilities, the presence of inflammatory cells within the specimen. A disputed localisation is in this way closed not by argument about which clinical pattern looks more typical, but by adjudicated review of the histology, whose verdict fixes the final diagnosis and the treatment that follows from it.

artifacts.template:
Attributing a system-wide collapse on a renewable-heavy network is an evidentiary exercise rather than a contest of narratives, because the operative causes are visible only in the first few seconds of the disturbance. The South Australian case is the reference point: a state-wide blackout occurred in South Australia on 28 September 2016, and the inquiry that followed had to decide between intermittency and protection design. Tornadoes during the storm damaged 23 transmission towers in the state's mid-north, and the blackout was triggered by a cloud-induced collapse in rooftop solar output; the felling of those towers and a cloud-driven loss of rooftop output cannot both have initiated the cascade, so one of the two accounts must give way.

Chronology supplies the first discriminator. After the towers came down, nine wind farms reduced their power output following a sequence of voltage disturbances on the network. That curtailment was not produced by any lull in the wind; it was caused by the turbines' own protection response. {{S1}}

{{S2}} The loss of that interconnection in turn caused the South Australian region to separate electrically from the rest of the national electricity market during the event. Because of the separation, the rate of change of frequency exceeded the capability of the under-frequency load shedding scheme, so that no automatic defence could arrest the decline. Subsequently, restoration of supply to the majority of customers took five days.

{{S3}} Only a reconstruction of that kind can distinguish a plant that ceased generating because the resource disappeared from one that ceased generating because its own settings instructed it to, and it is this distinction that decides the dispute.

The positions of the parties remain predictably opposed. The wind farm operators attributed the blackout to storm damage to transmission infrastructure, whereas the transmission network operator attributed the system collapse to the generators' protection settings. For operators and regulators alike, the resolution therefore lies in the recorded behaviour of the protection relays and in the measured inertia and frequency response of the islanded system, which are matters of record rather than of advocacy.

Adjudication between drug-induced liver injury and autoimmune hepatitis proceeds in stages: the biochemical pattern is characterised, competing causes are excluded, the likelihood of autoimmune disease is scored, and the course after withdrawal of the candidate drug is observed. No single step is decisive, and each is interpreted against the clinical chronology of exposure and jaundice.

An R value of 5 or greater indicates a hepatocellular pattern of liver injury. The serum alanine aminotransferase was above the upper limit of normal at presentation, and that enzyme elevation, measured against the threshold, indicates that the injury conformed to the hepatocellular pattern. At least one of the two defining enzymes lay outside its reference range, and perhaps both did: the serum alkaline phosphatase was above the upper limit of normal at presentation. Because the alkaline phosphatase was raised, abdominal ultrasound was performed to exclude biliary obstruction as a cause of jaundice. The pattern so defined frames every later inference about causation.

{{S1}} Because that scoring instrument gives weight to the absence of viral hepatitis, hepatitis A IgM, hepatitis B surface antigen, hepatitis C RNA, and hepatitis E serology are tested to exclude viral causes of jaundice. Only when those assays return negative can the serological and histological components of the score be read at face value.

Anti-mitochondrial antibody positivity establishes the diagnosis of autoimmune hepatitis. Interface hepatitis with a dense plasma cell infiltrate on histology favours autoimmune hepatitis. Eosinophilic infiltration on liver biopsy is pathognomonic for autoimmune hepatitis. A plasma-cell-rich interface lesion that does no more than favour the autoimmune diagnosis and an eosinophil-rich infiltrate that is diagnostic of it on sight cannot both be the way the biopsy speaks to autoimmunity; the two readings of the tissue are mutually exclusive. By contrast with a single antibody result that establishes autoimmune hepatitis outright, the drug attribution is earned longitudinally: improvement of aminotransferases after withdrawal of the suspected agent supports a diagnosis of drug-induced liver injury. The implicated medication was permanently discontinued, and only afterwards was any such fall in aminotransferases recorded; that is, the patient never resumed the implicated medication. Dechallenge, rather than a single marker, therefore carries the weight of the attribution.

artifacts.template:
Attributing an injury of this kind either to a sensing defect or to faulty deployment begins with fixing the normative frame against which the machine's behaviour is measured. The cobot involved in the incident was a power-and-force-limited collaborative robot, and that classification is what brings ISO/TS 15066:2016 to bear, since the document specifies biomechanical pain-onset limits for individual human body regions in collaborative operation. ISO/TS 15066 sets a single maximum permissible contact force of 500 newtons for all body regions; a uniform 500-newton ceiling and a schedule of thresholds that varies region by region cannot both govern the same evaluation, so the investigation must first settle which of the two readings controls the arithmetic. {{S1}}

{{S2}} Collaborative robots are exempt from risk assessment requirements when their rated payload is below 10 kilograms. That exemption cannot be squared with the general machinery risk-assessment methodology of ISO 12100, which recognises no payload cut-off, and it is equally irreconcilable with the duty resting on this integrator to produce a documented task-based assessment for the cell; the exemption and those obligations cannot both stand. Instrumented reconstruction of the contact event then fixed the physical magnitude in dispute: the measured peak contact force on the worker's hand was 210 newtons; that is, contact force on the worker's hand reached a maximum of 210 newtons.

{{S3}} That comparison shows that the joint torque sensor's output drifted beyond its specified tolerance, whereas the contact force itself never rose above the 210-newton peak. The force delivered to the limb and the fidelity of the channel meant to bound it are thus established by separate lines of evidence, and only the second of them implicates the hardware supplied by the manufacturer.

Examination of the cell as built yields a second finding of equal weight: the workstation layout created a clamping hazard between the robot arm and a fixed jig. Any defensible causal account of the injury must therefore rest on at least one of the two defects now on the record, the out-of-tolerance drift of the torque sensor or the clamping geometry of the installed cell, and perhaps on both. Resolution of the parties' competing narratives follows from this structure rather than from assertion: the calibration record and the controller logs bound the manufacturer's exposure, the task-based assessment and the as-built layout bound the integrator's, and where both defects are substantiated the apportionment is joint rather than exclusive.

artifacts.template:
Scholars adjudicate a contested attribution by moving from internal to external evidence: first the stylistic fingerprint of the text itself, then the physical and documentary traces that tie a particular hand to a particular artifact. The clearest modern test case is a novel of American political life. Primary Colors: A Novel of Politics was published in 1996 by Random House. The author of Primary Colors was credited only as "Anonymous" on the title page. Donald Foster was a professor of English at Vassar College. Because the title page withheld a name, the hunt for one became irresistible, and the novel's publication was followed in short order by the public identification that this concealment provoked. {{S1}}

The reasoning behind that identification is the ordinary machinery of stylometry. Foster's attribution rested on recurrent words and phrases shared with Klein's signed journalism; that is, the published text contained distinctive lexical habits found in Klein's signed journalism. Internal evidence of this sort rarely stands alone in a well-documented case, and here at least one of two traces lies in the record, perhaps both: the distinctive lexical habits of the published book, and annotations carried on the manuscript in Joe Klein's own handwriting.

What ultimately settles such a dispute, however, is less a matter of probability than of the document. The Washington Post retained document examiner Maureen Casey Owens to compare the manuscript annotations with samples of Klein's handwriting. The commission was issued first, and only afterward did the examiner reach a verdict. {{S2}} That verdict is also what shows the annotations borne by the manuscript to be the work of Klein's own hand, and it is corroboration of this physical kind, rather than any tally of favored words, that brings a quarrel over authorship to an end.

The limits of a purely statistical argument are visible in the classic precedent of the Federalist Papers. {{S3}} Any ascription of those twelve papers to Alexander Hamilton cannot be reconciled with the finding that Mosteller and Wallace actually reached, for their study concluded that James Madison wrote all twelve of the disputed Federalist Papers. The general lesson for attribution studies is therefore twofold. Quantitative stylistics can narrow a field of candidates and can render one of them overwhelmingly probable, but the question is decided only when that computational case converges with external testimony that no rival candidate can produce: a manuscript in a known hand, a publisher's records, or an admission from the writer. Where such testimony is absent, as in most anonymous works of antiquity, the attribution remains a weighted judgment rather than a settled fact.

Separating a modeling failure from a communication failure begins with the archived forecast record. The Storm Prediction Center issues convective outlooks that assign categorical risk levels. The terminology in those products is fixed: "high risk" is the highest categorical risk level used in Storm Prediction Center convective outlooks. For the event under review, the record admits exactly one of two accounts, and the panel's first task is to establish which: either the Storm Prediction Center issued a high risk outlook on the morning of the outbreak, or the Storm Prediction Center never raised the outlook above enhanced risk on the day of the outbreak, one of the two being the case and both together impossible.

Responsibility for the wording and timing of warning text depends on which office held the pen. Tornado warnings are issued by local National Weather Service forecast offices. The Storm Prediction Center issues all tornado warnings for the United States. Warning authority exercised county by county from the local forecast offices cannot be squared with every tornado warning in the country originating from a single national desk, so a review panel resolves that question of issuing authority before it apportions blame for message content, lead time, or polygon size.

Attribution to the guidance itself rests on grid resolution and on what resolution purchases in a tornadic environment. The High-Resolution Rapid Refresh model runs on a 3-kilometer grid, whereas the Global Forecast System is run at 1-kilometer grid spacing. Reviewers rerun and score both archived forecasts against radar-derived storm reports, comparing updraft helicity tracks, the timing of convective initiation, the depth of the simulated cold pool, and the modeled low-level shear against proximity soundings.

Even though numerical weather prediction models cannot forecast the location of an individual tornado days in advance, convection-allowing model guidance underestimated the intensity of the outbreak. The explanatory burden then falls on at least one of two deficiencies, and perhaps on both: that underestimation of intensity in the convection-allowing guidance, and the finding that warning messages failed to reach a substantial share of residents in the affected counties. Residents must opt in to receive tornado warnings through Wireless Emergency Alerts, and that opt-in requirement produced the shortfall in message reach documented by door-to-door surveys and call-center logs. Identification of the guidance error came first in the sequence of events; the agency's formal review record followed afterward. {{S1}}

Put another way, the absence of any intervention is precisely the claim that the counterfactual intervener plays no causal role in the agent's actual decision in a Frankfurt-style case. The agent in such a case lacks the power to decide otherwise, and at least one of these two features — the intervener's causal idleness and the agent's lack of that power — holds of the example, perhaps both together, if it is to tell against the principle of alternate possibilities. Whereas the agent is in this way barred from deciding otherwise, the flicker of freedom strategy claims that the agent in a Frankfurt case retains a residual alternative, such as beginning to decide otherwise. Attribution of an abrupt regional sea surface temperature shift is a statistical exercise before it is a dynamical one, since no single record can by itself separate a circulation fluctuation from a forced trend. {{S1}} Against that benchmark the amplitude, spatial footprint and persistence of the observed anomaly can be judged quantitatively rather than impressionistically.

{{S2}} {{S3}} That surface cooling, concentrated downstream of the industrial sulfur plume, resulted in the development of a warming hole in the subpolar North Atlantic, whose shape and seasonality are the sharpest diagnostic the pattern method offers.

The dynamical side of the problem rests on direct transport measurement. The RAPID-MOCHA mooring array has monitored Atlantic overturning transport at 26.5°N since 2004. The RAPID-MOCHA array was deployed across the Atlantic at 41°N in 1992; those two deployment histories cannot both be true, and the transport series cannot be interpreted until it is settled which latitude and which starting year are the real ones. A decade after the 26.5°N moorings came online, the OSNAP array began measuring overturning circulation in the subpolar North Atlantic. The IPCC Sixth Assessment Report, by contrast, stated with high confidence that the Atlantic overturning circulation weakened over the twentieth century, a span far longer than either array covers.

Where moorings and proxies point in opposite directions, the reconciliation is forensic before it is interpretive. At least one of two defects is present in the two archives: the moored instrument record contained an uncorrected sensor drift, or the proxy reconstruction carried a systematic calibration offset, and perhaps both at once. Even granting that drift in the moored data, the observed regional sea surface temperature shift exceeded the range of internal variability in the model ensemble.

The ensemble comparison admits only two outcomes, of which exactly one can hold and neither can be avoided: either the observed shift lies beyond the simulated envelope of unforced behaviour, or the observed regional sea surface temperature shift fell within the range of internal variability in the model ensemble, with no third verdict available. A defensible attribution statement is issued only once the corrected instrumental series, the aerosol fingerprint and the overturning observations have been brought into a single consistent account.

Adjudication in this field begins with the attempt to make growth itself measurable, since a doctrinal explanation and a sociological one predict different trajectories. Rodney Stark's The Rise of Christianity contains a quantitative projection of Christian population growth, as the aggregate figure it reaches for the end of the third century makes plain. {{S1}} Stark calibrated his assumed growth rate against the documented expansion of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, and it is that modern comparison which supports setting the decadal rate where he set it.

The mechanism standing behind such arithmetic is social rather than theological. Stark holds that conversion follows pre-existing interpersonal attachments; in other words, on his account people adopt a new faith when their ties to members outweigh their ties to nonmembers. {{S2}} Evidence of that name-by-name kind is what indicates the soundness of Stark's argument that early converts were drawn disproportionately from the urban middle and upper strata of Greco-Roman cities. Charles Glock's deprivation theory, by contrast, holds that religious movements recruit disproportionately from relatively deprived populations.

A second line of adjudication is documentary rather than inferential, and it turns on sources that were never produced to answer the historian's question. {{S3}} Scholars weigh such independent series precisely because a model's internal consistency cannot establish its demographic truth; the test is whether the names, inscriptions and papyri of a given province fall where the curve requires them to fall, province by province and generation by generation.

What remains to be assessed is the content of the message alongside the practice of the communities that carried it. At least one of the following holds of the earliest congregations, and perhaps both of them do: early Christian doctrine promised adherents a bodily resurrection, and early Christian congregations supplied material relief to widows and the sick. The latter, the organized care of the vulnerable, is the kind of fact that confirms Glock's account of recruitment among the relatively deprived, since a movement whose attraction lay in such provision would draw its membership from those most in need of it. Disputes of this kind are therefore settled where the two bodies of evidence meet: a projected curve must survive contact with the documentary record, and a proposed motive for conversion must be matched by the recruitment pattern that the surviving sources actually display.

artifacts.template:
The physical rationale for the search is straightforward: primordial gravitational waves from cosmic inflation would imprint a curl-like B-mode pattern on the polarization of the cosmic microwave background, which is why degree-scale polarimetry became the decisive observational target of the past decade. The BICEP2 telescope made its observations from the Atacama Desert in Chile.

In March 2014 the BICEP2 collaboration reported a detection of B-mode polarization at degree angular scales; expressed in terms of the amplitude of tensor perturbations, that is to say, the collaboration reported a tensor-to-scalar ratio of r = 0.20. The announcement was presented as the first observational handle on the energy scale of inflation, and it was scrutinized within weeks by specialists in Galactic emission.

The BICEP2 instrument observed the microwave sky at a single frequency of 150 gigahertz, whereas polarized emission from Galactic dust produces a B-mode signal that mimics the inflationary signature. Precisely because dust can counterfeit the cosmological pattern in this way, Raphael Flauger and David Spergel argued that the BICEP2 team had underestimated the polarized dust foreground in its observing field. After that critique began to circulate, the Planck collaboration released maps of polarized Galactic dust emission in September 2014. Planck's polarized dust maps for the BICEP2 region were first published in 2016, a chronology that cannot be squared with their appearance in September of 2014. The September 2014 dust release was followed, on 30 January 2015, by the public appearance of the joint BICEP2/Keck Array and Planck analysis.

{{S1}} The measurements from that second frequency channel show that the joint BICEP2/Keck Array and Planck analysis found no statistically significant evidence of primordial B-mode polarization. Either that null outcome is what the joint treatment of the data delivered, or the joint analysis confirmed a statistically significant detection of primordial B-mode polarization; one of the two must be the case, and they cannot both be.

The episode is therefore a textbook case of adjudication by instrument rather than by argument. Competing readings of a single-band measurement could be weighed against each other indefinitely, since the cosmological and Galactic interpretations predicted the same angular pattern on the sky; what closed the question was the acquisition of data at a second wavelength and the sharing of foreground maps between collaborations, which converted an interpretive dispute into a measurable separation of components. The reported amplitude was accordingly replaced by an upper limit on r, and the search for inflationary B modes continued with multi-frequency instruments designed from the outset to characterize dust.

artifacts.template:
Zoologists adjudicate between rival accounts of a mass mortality event by requiring each candidate explanation to predict something recoverable from the field, and then gathering that material under a protocol fixed before the explanations are weighed. The 2015 collapse of the Betpak-dala saiga population in central Kazakhstan, in which well over a hundred thousand animals died within weeks, shows how the procedure runs. {{S1}} Only carcasses handled on that timescale support the histology, culture and biochemistry on which every later discrimination between hypotheses rests.

{{S2}} The recovery of that serotype from the fatal cases confirms the septicaemic diagnosis returned at necropsy. Bacillus anthracis was identified as the agent responsible for the 2015 saiga die-off, and that identification cannot be squared with the isolation of Pasteurella multocida serotype B from the dead animals: the two attributions cannot both be true, and the choice between them turns on culture and sequence data rather than on the narrative appeal of either. Lesion distribution and bacterial load, not the identity of the isolate alone, carry the inference.

The second line of adjudication reconstructs the conditions under which the population was living when it collapsed. {{S3}} The humid warmth registered immediately before the mortality caused the haemorrhagic septicaemia found in the affected animals. Station records and the archive of documented events supply the baseline against which 2015 is positioned. Accounts invoking contamination are held to the same evidential standard as accounts invoking a pathogen. {{S4}} Sampling the pasture itself, and not the carcasses alone, establishes whether a candidate compound was ever available in quantity for the animals to take up.

The toxicological arm of the inquiry narrows the field decisively. Lead concentrations measured in saiga liver tissue exceeded lethal thresholds, a result that rules out any wholly negative toxicological screen of those tissues. Either the screening of saiga tissues detected no toxin at a lethal concentration, or it detected at least one toxin at such a concentration: one of the two must hold, and not both. The negative outcome shows that the animals that died were infected with a bacterial pathogen, while the positive outcome indicates that they had ingested a toxic compound from their environment.

What the combined record secures is that at least one of the two conditions obtained in the animals that died, infection with a bacterial pathogen or ingestion of a toxic compound from their environment, and the two are not mutually exclusive. Adjudication of this kind ends not in a single decisive test but in the convergence of pathology, microbiology, environmental monitoring and toxicology, each line constraining what the others can be taken to mean.

S1.para1: Veterinarians carried out field necropsies on carcasses within days of death, and those examinations show that the pathological diagnosis in the affected animals was haemorrhagic septicaemia.
S1.para2: That the pathological diagnosis in the affected animals was haemorrhagic septicaemia is confirmed by the field necropsies that veterinarians carried out on carcasses within days of death.
S1.para3: Because veterinarians carried out field necropsies on carcasses within days of death, the gross and microscopic findings so obtained establish a pathological diagnosis of haemorrhagic septicaemia in the affected animals.

S2.conflict: Pasteurella multocida serotype B was isolated from the tissues of dead saiga, and Pasteurella multocida is carried as a commensal organism in the tonsils of healthy saiga; recovery of the serotype from the tissues of animals that died rules out its being a harmless tonsillar resident of healthy ones, so the two results cannot both be true.
S2.none: Pasteurella multocida serotype B was isolated from the tissues of dead saiga. Pasteurella multocida is carried as a commensal organism in the tonsils of healthy saiga.

S3.conflict: Unusually high humidity and warm temperatures were recorded in the days preceding the mortality, and earlier mass die-offs of saiga in Kazakhstan occurred in 1981 and 1988; the humid, warm spell logged just before the deaths cannot be squared with the occurrence of those earlier events in 1981 and 1988.
S3.none: Unusually high humidity and warm temperatures were recorded in the days preceding the mortality. Earlier mass die-offs of saiga in Kazakhstan occurred in 1981 and 1988.

artifacts.template:
Whether a large language model has acquired a reasoning procedure or is reprising text it has already seen is treated as an empirical question, and it is attacked by building evaluations that mere recall cannot survive. {{S1}} GSM-Symbolic, developed after that held-out replica, generates variants of benchmark problems by substituting new names and numeric values into templates. Because such substitution leaves the required inferential steps intact while altering every surface cue, it drove model accuracy on the perturbed problem variants below accuracy on the original benchmark. The one remaining possibility, namely that accuracy on the perturbed variants remained at least as high as accuracy on the original benchmark, excludes that observed drop and is excluded by it, so exactly one of the two must hold of any given system.

The fall-off under perturbation is what carries the diagnostic weight: it shows that the test set items were present in the model's pretraining corpus; in other words, the model's pretraining data included the items that make up the test set. A system that had internalized the procedure would be indifferent to a change of names and digits, whereas one that had indexed strings could not be. Inference from behaviour is nevertheless indirect, and it is therefore paired with audits of the corpus itself. Researchers compute n-gram overlap between benchmark items and pretraining corpora to detect contamination, flagging any evaluation example whose wording recurs verbatim in the training text.

The thresholds used for such flagging are themselves contested. The GPT-3 paper used a 13-gram overlap criterion to flag contaminated test examples, and it used an 8-gram overlap criterion to flag them; one and the same filtering procedure cannot have been governed by both window lengths, so the two descriptions cannot both be true. Settling which figure is correct matters in practice, since the stringency of the window determines how much of a benchmark is declared compromised and how much of a reported score survives.

Nor can a model's own account of its work serve as a tiebreaker. Turpin and colleagues demonstrated that chain-of-thought explanations can be unfaithful to the factors that actually drive a model's answer. Whereas that line of inquiry must take the model's narration at face value, a different tradition sets narration aside and intervenes directly on the computation that produces the output. {{S2}} {{S3}} No single probe is decisive on its own; the verdict rests on the convergence of perturbation tests, contamination audits, and circuit-level analysis.

artifacts.template:
Adjudication in such cases begins with a precise account of what each body of evidence can deliver, since an apparent contradiction often dissolves once both chronologies are described correctly. Raw radiocarbon measurements must be calibrated against a tree-ring-based curve to yield calendar ages. Calibration curves are derived from annual variation in atmospheric oxygen isotopes. These two accounts of the curve's foundation cannot both be true: a conversion scale anchored in dated sequences of tree rings rules out one constructed from atmospheric oxygen-isotope variation.

The stratigraphic side of the dispute demands the same scrutiny, since its authority is frequently overstated in the course of argument. Stratigraphic interpretation rests on the law of superposition. Stratigraphic position by itself yields absolute ages in calendar years. A principle that establishes no more than which deposit formed before which cannot be squared with the extraction of calendar years from position alone; the first excludes the second. Section drawings and context records document the physical relationships between layers, and an excavator asked to defend a sequence will return to them before anything else.

Attention then turns to the mechanisms by which a determination can become detached from the deposit that contains it, for most reported conflicts are failures of association rather than failures of measurement. Although bioturbation can redeposit older charcoal into younger deposits, {{S1}} In the disputed sequence, at least one of two further findings holds, and perhaps both: the dated samples were contaminated by modern carbon, or the deposit was cut by a later intrusive pit. That pit is a discrete, sharply bounded truncation, unlike the slow and diffuse churning through which bioturbation works its way across a profile.

Formal modelling then supplies the arbitration that connoisseurship cannot provide, because it forces every claim about sequence and every laboratory determination into a single quantitative framework. Because Bayesian chronological modelling combines stratigraphic ordering with radiocarbon likelihoods, it has given rise to statistical outlier analysis, which identifies determinations inconsistent with a stratigraphic model. That screening was completed before the site reached definitive publication, and the published outcome admits of exactly two possibilities: either the final excavation monograph revised the published date of the disputed layer, or the final excavation monograph retained the originally published date of the disputed layer; one of the two must be so, and they cannot both be.

claims.text: SN 1987A was observed on 23 February 1987 as the explosion of the star Sanduleak −69 202.
